zangs kyi rus sbal gyi kha nas 'bab pa'i rdzing bu zhig gi nang du lus po 'khrur bcug der gsod lugs la sogs pa zhig byed pa yin snyam tsa na gos chen gyi na bza' mang po gsol nas kho'i rgyal phran byed du bcug gnyis bros nas phyin/ gcig ni rgyal phran byas nas bsdad/ stag gzig gi rgyal po de yang 'bri gung gi phyogs su phyag 'tshal ba dang bstod pa mang po byed cing 'dug pa de mtshon par byed pa'i g.yon ngos kyi dkar po 'di ni stag gzig gi rgyal po thal mo sbyar ba yin no// khrom ge sar dmag gi rgyal khams na phar la jo bo thugs rje chen po dngos su 'jig rten du byon nas sems can gyi don byed pa yin zer ba'i snyan pa byung*/ khrom ge sar dmag gi rgyal po des dkyus kha mthar khan bya ba'i rnyed par dka' ba'i rin po che sna bdun lan gsum 'bri gung du bskur nas byung bas de mtshon par byed pa la de'i rgyab kyi ljang gu de ni khrom ge sar dmag gi rgyal po lag na rin po che thogs nas 'bul bar byed pa yin no// de ltar mtha' bzhi'i rgyal po bzhis kyang gsol ba 'debs pa na/ bod kyi rgyal po lta ci smos/ des de'i ling tshe bshad zin to// de dag gis don mdor bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa/ thub pas rang bsngags kha ba can ljongs su// yun ring 'tsho gzhes tshad med phrin las kyis// dpag med 'gro ba'i don mdzad 'jig rten mgon// dus gsum 'gran zla bral la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya ba yin no// de lta bu'i mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di dag gang gis brjod pa dang*/ thos pa dang*/ mthong ba dang*/ dran par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang mtshungs pa med pa'i mgon po de nyid kyi phrin las kyis bsdus nas rgyud smin pa dang grol bar mdzad cing byang chub la 'god par nges so// rtag par bzhugs pa'i pho brang du gshegs yang zhal snga nas rgyal po zla 'od kyi rnam par thar pa la brten nas phrin las bstan pa 'di dag gang gis mthong ba dang thos pa dang dran pas yid skyo ba tsam mam tha na rna lam du yang grags pa tsam thams cad nga yi gdul bya yin pas nga nyid kyis smin cing grol bar byed de/

sangs rgyas kyi sar 'khrid pa yin pas 'di rnams 'khor bsdus pa'i thabs yin ces gsungs pas mdzad pa 'di thos pa de dag kyang don dang ldan pa yin no// brjod pa de dag kyang don dang ldan pa yin no// thos pa de dag kyang don dang ldan pa yin no// dran pa de dag kyang don dang ldan pa yin no// de dag gi don mdor bsdus nas tshigs su bcad pa/ gus pas gsol ba gang btab chos kyi sku// mthar thug mnyam nyid bde chen mdzad pa yi// mtshungs med 'gro mgon chos rje rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// zhes bya ba yin de lta bu'i mdzad pa'i rnam par thar pa 'di ni lho brag mkhar chu'i ri khrod du grub thob mang po'i bsti gnas nags stod brag ri yi dkyil mthong*/ dpal ldan ngad phu ba'i bzhugs gnas sa li dpal phug sangs rgyas kyi gling du ban dhe shes rab 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba lags so// 'di bris dge bas 'gro ba ma lus kun// kun mkhyen mnyam med chos rje rin chen gyi// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor gyur nas kyang*// bla med chos kyis 'gro ba 'dren par shog// /

04) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa rma bya seng ge ma// oṃ swa sti// gnas 'og min 'bri gung pho brang nas// rje 'gro mgon bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// dpal 'khor 'das dbang phyug rin po che// yab mtshungs med chos rje'i bkra shis shog /khyed 'dir tshogs dad ldan skyes bu rnams// rkyen rnam rtog mtshan mas ma g.yengs par// sems dad pa'i mos gus chen po yis// gtam snyan pa'i dbyangs 'di de ring gson// spyir stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi// dbus gling bzhi'i snying po 'dzam gling 'dir// skyabs thub pa chen po'i bstan pa la// dus ngan pa tha ma'i snyigs dus su// thugs brtse bas 'gro ba'i don gzigs nas// da rtsod pa med pa'i rdo rje 'chang*// pha mnyam med sangs rgyas ye shes sku// dpal 'bri gung bla ma rin chen byon// rje 'gran zla med pa'i sprul sku de// 'bri dam pa chos phyug klung du 'khrungs// don sgrub pa zla shod stod du mdzad// mthar yon tan ngam shod klung du rdzogs// yul dbu ru byang phyogs sa yi char// khong 'jig rten lha mi kun gyis mchod// gzho 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du// 'khor 'bum phrag bye ba'i tshogs pa bskyangs// 'phral mnga' ris bod la spyod yul mdzad// sku snyan pas 'jig rten yongs la grags// bod gangs chen dbus su dpal 'bar bas// yul 'dzam gling mtha' bzhi'i longs spyod 'dus// rje dus gsum mkhyen pa'i rin po che// skyabs 'gro mgon bla ma dam pa de// dus rtag tu mnyam nyid ngang la bzhugs// las rgyu 'bras rten 'brel mngon du gyur// shar mngon dgar gsungs pa'i dam chos gsan// nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams gzigs// gtsor sangs rgyas rnams dang dgongs pa bstun// 'khor sems dpa' rnams kyis gdong grogs mdzad// phyogs tha dad sprul pa du ma dang*// sku rnam 'phrul bkod pa du ma bstan// ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams sprin ltar 'dus// mgon chos skyong tshogs rnams bran ltar bkol// sde chen po'i lha srin dam la btags// mtho nam mkha'i nyi ma rtod la mnan// gdong bstan pa'i dgra bo gar log btul// shar mi nyag rgyal khams srog las skyabs// bya rgod po gnam la 'phur ba la// sgom ting 'dzin gnyug ma'i 'od gsal btab// dma' na rag dmyal ba gting nas drangs// 'dir sems can sangs rgyas sa la bkod// khong 'jig rten sdug bsngal rnam gzigs nas// thugs tshad med snying rje chen po yis// gzhan 'gro don mdzad par bzhed dgongs nas// pha mtshungs med chos rje rin chen de// yul 'phrang bu'i gnas su byon tsam na// lha gnyen po bar lhas gshegs sun bgyis// gnas byang phyogs rgyud du gshegs tsam na// gnyan chen po thang lhas bsu ba byas// byang nam ra'i ri la bzhugs tsam na// lha tshangs pa'i rgyal pos gsol ba btab// dpal phag mo gru ru byon tsam na// nub u rgyan mkha' 'gros spyan 'dren byas// dbus yar lung mthil du byon tsam na// lha yar lha sham pos 'bul ba byas// 'khor khri phrag mang pos mngon sum du// klu gzi chen gus pas zhabs la gtugs// dus gnyen po khyad par 'phags pa la// shar rma chen spom ras sna drangs pa'i// bod mnga' ris lha 'dre thams cad kyis// don zab cing rgya che'i dam chos zhus// tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu skyong ba la// klu ma dros rgyal pos sbyin bdag byas// mtho bcu gsum gung gi lha rnams kyis// chos gsung tshe me tog char pa phab// 'og rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu rnams kyis// don dgos 'dod kun sgrub bar chad bsal// steng bar snang gnod sbyin ma lus pas// thugs ci bzhed gter mdzod thams cad phul// rje lha mi kun gyi mchod pa'i gnas// pha mnyam med dpal ldan spyan snga ba// khong sa steng slob ma'i mchog gyur pa// da bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas 'dus// lha brgya byin tshangs pas sna drangs pa'i// da lha klu gnod sbyin bye ba 'dus// khong dbu se dang nyag ses sna drangs pa'i// da grub thob brgya stong mang po 'dus// khong gtsag rtsang gnyis kyis sna drangs pa'i// da mtshan nyid tshogs dpon brgya stong 'dus// khong thag ma dang dwags pos sna drangs pa'i// da 'dul 'dzin tshogs dpon brgya stong 'dus// khong skyo dang dpon gyis sna drangs pa'i// da bka' gdams tshogs dpon brgya stong 'dus// khong gnubs dang 'phags pas sna drangs pa'i// da rgya bod lo tsā brgya stong 'dus// khong kre rngog gnyis kyis sna drangs pa'i// da sngags pa'i tshogs dpon brgya stong 'dus// khong bdud rtsi dang bal pos sna drangs pa'i// da rnal 'byor tshogs dpon brgya stong 'dus// khong lho byang rje sgom bsod nams can// da sa bdag rgyal po brgya stong 'dus// khong brtul zhugs sdom pa gsum ldan pa'i// da sgom chen bye ba dung phyur 'dus// spyir snga phyi kun tu zhabs drung du// 'khor 'dus shing lhags pa de dag la// lar grub thob grags pa grangs las 'das// lar mkhas btsun dge bshes grangs las 'das// lar chos nyan ston pa grangs las 'das// lar mthu chen sngags pa grangs las 'das// lar rnal 'byor dge bsnyen grangs las 'das// lar phyogs bzhi'i yon bdag grangs las 'das// spyir siṅgha gling pa tshun chod nas// rgya khyi than mi nyag yan chad kyi// 'khor 'dus pa'i skye bo mi rnams la// lha mi min 'dus pa grangs las 'das// zhal dngos su mjal ba ma yin te// yul kha che'i bla mas sna drangs pa'i// rgya dkar nag paṇa chen brgya stong gis// sku che ba'i yon tan du mas bstod// phyi mtha' yi rgya mtshor nye ba na// khong bskos pa'i rgyal po bzhi gnas pa// shar rgya nag gtsug gi rgyal po des// 'dir bdug spos sman gyis mchod pa phul// lho rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po des// 'dir spyi bo thod kyis zhabs la gtugs// nub stag gzig nor gyi rgyal po des// 'dir gus pas gtugs cing dad pas bstod// byang ge sar dmag gi rgyal po des// 'dir g.yu dngul mu tig me tog phul// smad mi nyag 'ga' yi rgyal po des// 'dir gos chen gser sogs 'bul ba byas// stod mnga' ris kha ba can ljongs su// yul pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal po rnams// chos 'bul ba zhabs tog dpag med pas// 'dir mnyes par byas shing yun ring bsten// lar zhabs tog 'bul ba mtha' med pas// spyir rgyal po'i zhabs tog rtsis las 'das// spyir zhang blon zhabs tog rtsis las 'das// spyir yon bdag zhabs tog rtsis las 'das// spyir lha 'dre'i zhabs tog rtsis las 'das// spyir bu slob zhabs tog rtsis las 'das// spyir rgya bod hor gsum mtha' dag nas// da brgya 'bul stong 'bul rtsis las 'das// mtho spyi gtsug nor bu 'dzam gling rgyan// khong 'jig rten chen po thams cad kyis// zhabs pad+mo'i gdan la spyi bos reg

/pha skyabs mchog sangs rgyas rin po che// da dkar po'i rgya la grags tsam na// rje 'gro ba'i re skong chos char 'bebs// zhal gang mthong lam zin don chen grub// dpal mahā bo dhi'i sprul par grags// da nag po'i rgya la grags tsam na// dgung nam mkha'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis// lus gus pas btud cing mchod gyur pa'i// dpal mañju shrī yi sprul par grags// da khyi shad hor la grags tsam na// 'khor bye ba dung phyur dge sbyong can// skyabs mgon med 'gro ba yongs kyi dpal// dpal ār+ya pa lo'i sprul par grags// da mnga' ris bod la grags tsam na// rje sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid sku// dpal drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen du// 'dir rtsod pa med par yongs su grags// lho 'dzam bu gling 'dir ma gtogs pa// phyogs gling gsum 'jig rten gzhan dag na// lha gnod sbyin dri za'i tshogs rnams kyis// pha 'jig rten mgon po'i yon tan brjod// gnas ri rab steng gi lha rnams kyis// sems dang bas 'dud cing bsngags pa smra// 'og sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kyis// lus gus pas thal sbyar gsol ba 'debs// rje mthong ba don ldan rin po che// rje thos pa don ldan rin po che// rje dran pa don ldan rin po che// rje tshogs gsog zhing mchog rin po che// rje che 'bags che 'tshengs rin po che// rje chung 'bags chung 'tshengs rin po che// rje dbang gi rgyal po rin po che// rje sgro skur med pa rin po che// rje mtshan mchog don ldan rin po che// rje skyu ra sangs rgyas rin po che// rje mgon med skyabs gnas rin po che// rje dug gsum nad sel rin po che// rje 'khor ba'i mtsho skem rin po che// rje bde skyid yon tan rin po che// rje sangs rgyas thob mdzad rin po che// rje rin chen de yi zhal snga nas// khyed dad dang ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams// 'dir kho bo'i zhal mthong gsung thos shing*// gnas bla dbye'i thang la phyin pa kun// tshe phyi ma ngan song med do gsungs// gzhan mtshan thos dran par gyur pa dang*// sems mos dang gus pa'i bsam pa yis// khong nga phyir bya ba byed pa rnams// da srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol lo gsung*// spyir dngos sam brgyud pa thams cad du// las rgyu 'bras phra bas 'brel ba dang*// zhwa sgom zhwa mgo la bzhag tshad kyang*// mthar cis kyang sangs rgyas thob par nges// khyed dad dang ldan pa'i skyes bu rnams// pha 'gro mgon bla ma de phyogs su// de sngon chad bya ba ci byas pa// tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi don chen 'grub// dus gnas skabs de ring phyin chad kyang*// rje de la gus pas gsol ba thob// gsung thos pa'i chos bzhin nyams su longs// dus gtan gyi don chen 'grub par nges// gangs ti se lho phyogs 'phags pa'i yul// chab sin dhu dal gyi 'bab pa'i klung*// ri gangs chen lho phyogs si ta'i 'gram// mtha' gar log sog po'i yul dbus su// stod mnga' ris chos kyi rgyal po mchog

/bla ya rabs rje 'bangs thams cad dang*// da dad sgom gra mas sna drangs pa'i// khrom 'dus pa'i skye bo mi rnams la// gnas ri khrod rnal 'byor sgrub pa po// don sbyangs stobs spyod pa rgyal ba'i sras// yab chos rje'i nyer gnas spyan snga bas// khong grogs mched kun la de skad smras// rgyal ba yab sras khyod sku ci 'dra ba// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs// khyod kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog /khyod la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs der// nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang*// chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/// / 05) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa mthong ba don yod ma// oṃ swa sti// rje mthong ba don yod kyi zhabs la 'dud// khyed 'dir tshogs kyi lha mi thams cad kun// rkyen rnam rtog gi spros pas ma g.yengs par// snyan lhan ne dbang po gtad nas kyang*// tshig snyan pa'i gtam 'di gsan par zhu// gnas byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs// lho 'dzam gling snying po yul dbus 'dir// dpal ma ga dha ru grags pa de// rje sangs rgyas 'dus sku'i bzhugs gnas yin// 'khor dgra bcom bye ba'i pho brang de// gzho 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod yin// khong der bzhugs kyi bla ma rin chen de// sngon thog med dus nas sangs rgyas shing*// don sku yi rol pa bsam yas kyang*// ma mkha' mnyam sems can don slad du// klung 'bri rgyal dam pa chos phyug gi// gnas grong khyer chen po tsu ngur bltams// khyod dgung lo brgyad du lon pa'i tshe// dpal badz+ra bhai ra'i rnam thar gzigs// rtsibs rlung mo che na bzhugs pa'i tshe// zhing 'khor 'das me long lta bur mkhyen// dpal phag mo gru ru byon pa'i tshe// 'khor thams cad de ring rdzogs so gsung*// nub e chung phug na sgom pa'i tshe// chos phyi nang rten 'brel mngon du gyur// byang nam ra'i glag mor bzhugs pa'i tshe// gnyan chen po thang lhas bsu ba byas// bya nam mkha'i dbyings la 'phur ba'i tshe// sgom ting nge 'dzin la dran pa gnas// dpal rdo rje gdan du bzhugs pa'i tshe// dgra du ru ka yi dmag tshogs bzlog

/chos zab mo gsung bar bzhed pa'i tshe// steng lha phrug rnams kyis bskul ma btab// rta cang shes bang sna bskul ba'i tshe// gsung tshig gcig bsgyur bas go ba blangs// rgyang ring por mtshan tsam thos pa'i tshe// bla mi nyag rgyal pos mchod pa phul// yongs de 'dra'i bla ma rin chen de// 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du// sngar ma byung phyis kyang mi 'byung zhing*// dus da lta lhar bcas 'jig rten na// rje de 'dra bzhugs pa mi srid pas// dpal u dum wā ra lta bu yin// yongs de 'dra'i bla ma rin po che// zhal mthong bar dka' 'o rin po che// gsung thos par dka' 'o rin po che// yongs bka' drin che 'o rin po che// da brjed thabs med do rin po che// mi bdag dang 'gro drug sems can la// skyabs gzhan na med do 'gro ba'i mgon// de lta bu'i bla ma rin chen de// lho 'dzam gling snyan pas kun khyab cing*// spyir bod khams kyi snang ba dbang du bsdus// rgya dkar nag hor bod la sogs kyi// mi che dgu ring bcu drung du tshogs// rdzas dngos po dgos dgu'i mchod par phul// 'khor phyogs gcig 'dus pa bdun khri la// rab tshe 'dir sangs rgyas thob pa mang*// 'bring sa bcu'i dbang phyug man chad nas// dbang sems nyid rtogs pa yan chod la// 'khor khri phrag bye ba bsam yas kyang*// kun 'dus pa'i gtso bo gnyos chen yin// mched gus 'bul rgyal sras ldam bhi pa// 'phrin las mtha' yas mkhan chen dang*// mtshan yongs grags dpal chen 'dzam gling rgyan// sras nye dbang rgyal po chen po ni// dpon sgom pa rdo rje seng ge dang*// rdo rje gdung 'dzin rgyal po dang*// mi chen po gyur pa'i dpal bzhi dang*// khong rtsod med kyi grub thob chos sdings pa// ngag smra ba'i seng ge spyan snga ba// thugs 'od gsal rtsal thon dgon dkar ba// bsod nams rgya mtsho ras chen dang*// khong skyes bu chen po sog pa'i mtshan// pra dz+nyā nam mkha' ngad phu ba// 'jam dbyangs zung gcig rnam gnyis dang*// rigs mthon po gser pa brag thog pa// khong de la sogs pa'i grub thob rnams// mtshan che long brjod pa grangs mi lang*// spyir bu slob gnam gyi skar ma tsam// de 'byung gnas pho brang dam pa de// zhing rgya mtsho kun gyi gtsor gyur pa// gnas gzho stod dpal gyi 'bri gung yin// rje sangs rgyas kyi rgyal po de na bzhugs// skyabs dam pa'i lha chos de na yod// grogs 'phags pa'i dge 'dun de na yod// lha dkon mchog gi mchod pa de na yod// don 'khor 'das kyi bde skyid de na yod// rgyu tshogs gnyis kyi zhing sa de na yod// gang yod pa'i 'bul sa de na yod// su med pa'i zhu sa de na yod// rdzas 'dod dgu'i longs spyod de na yod// lar ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo de na yod// gnas de kun gyi yin lugs bshad tsam na// gang bsags pa chung la blo gros zhan// khyod mig med 'jig rten phal pa rnams// mi bden brdzun yin min the tshom za// sngar ma mthong bas ni yus kyang yus// khyed gnyis 'dzin the tshom ma byed dang*// yang ngo mtshar gyi ltad mo 'di 'dra yod// khrom lha mi 'dus shing tshogs nas kyang*// mgrin gcig tu gsol ba btab pa'i tshe// rje sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal po des// sku gzi mdangs 'od dang bcas nas kyang*// dbus dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor du// gdan seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa'i tshe// sa chen po rab tu g.yos pa dang*// 'od 'ja' tshon 'khrug cing spos ngad ldang*// lhas me tog rdzas kyi mchod pa ni// steng mkha' la char tshogs babs pa 'dra// gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan bla re dang*// sgra snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs yod// de rmongs pa'i longs spyod ma lags te// rje sangs rgyas lnga yi bdag nyid yin// lar dngos grub bar chad rang dbang che// ri de la gnas sam phyin pa yis// khong srog chags grog sbur la sogs kyang*// gnas ngan song gsum du mi ltung ba// rje 'gro mgon de yi zhal bzhes yin// rgyang ring por gnas pa'i mos gus can// rgya dkar nag gting du yod na yang*// rje nga dang 'bral ba med pa yin// dus rtag tu bka' stsal gsungs pas na// lar bsam pa de dang ma bral na// tshe 'phos ma thag tu sangs rgyas kyi// zhing bde ba can du skye bar nges// bdag rmongs pa'i pho tshod ma lags te// rje bla ma dam pa'i bka' stsal gcig

/lung bde bar gshegs pa'i mdo rgyud gnyis// khyod rnal 'byor pa yi nyams myong gsum// chos rten cing 'brel ba'i lo rgyus bzhi// khong tshad ma bzhi pos de skad gsung*// rje bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// spyir mtshan thos ngan song gsum las bsgral// sgos zhal mthong gsung thos thar pa bgrod// gzho 'bri gung mthil du gang shi yang*// gnas ngan song gsum du gtong re skan// don nges pa'i dbu bsnyung chen po bzhes// yang bstan bcos rin chen dbang phyug nas// dpal nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po las// mi mang yang rung la nyung yang rung*// tshig smras pa nyon dang dge 'dun rnams// blo gtad na ting 'dzin mi skye re// mgo bskor nas ngan par gtong re shi// don nges pa'i bka' stsal gnyis pa yin// yang nga yi drung du lhags pa yi// khyod phyogs ris kyi dge 'dun byon pa rnams// phyag sor bcu brang la bkram nas kyang*// mi nga 'dir ci la yong ba yin// don snying nas yang yang bsam par gyis// khyed nga la bsam nas yongs ba yi// mi tshan sde rigs yul phyogs kyi// 'dir chags sdang khe grags ma byed par// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus dang*// dam pa'i chos la so nam gyis// nga yi a pha a ma dang*// a pho a nu la sogs kyang*// gnyen 'brel gyi gdung sems ma bskyed la// khyed kyi don chen 'grub pa yin// thog mar khyed rnams smos ci dgos// khyed kyi pha ma la sogs kyang*// mthar tshe yi 'du byed thug pa na// gdung ba'i shugs kyis khyed dran cing*// de yi rkyen gyis nga dran nas// mtshams sbyor de dang 'grogs pas na// rnam shes bla mar 'pho ba yin// gnas ngan song gsum du mi ltung ba// de cis kyang nga 'bu'i gnyer kha yin// don nges pa'i bka' stsal gsum pa'o// spyir sdug bsngal 'khor ba mtha' med kyang*// rje de phyir 'brangs dang mos pa rnams// zhing 'di nas tshe 'phos gyur pa na// rje 'gro mgon drung du phyin par 'gyur// yab 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa// rje sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyal po de// sngon 'das dus bskal pa grangs med na// stong 'khor los bsgyur rgyal chos kyi gtso// mtshan rtsibs kyi mu khyud ces bya bar// sku skye ba bzhes par gyur pa'i tshe// sras stong dang rtsa gcig bltams nas kyang*// dgung mtshan mo gcig gi bsam gtan gyis// don byang chub snying por sangs rgyas pas// dpal klu rigs sgrol ma zhes bya ba// rje sangs rgyas rnams kyi rgyal por gyur// de nas de dag 'dul bar mkhyen nas// sras de dag gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor de dag thams cad la/

'chi ba dang*/ mi rtag pa dang*/ las rgyu 'bras dang*/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams bden pa bzhi'i tshul gyis rgya cher gsungs nas/ sras stong po de dag rim gyis rab tu byung ste nges par byung ba'i tshul khrims phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan zhing*/ de ma thag la las ni dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob/ la las ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob/ la las ni chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag pa thob/ la las ni rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu thob nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa dang*/ mu med pa dang*/ tshad med pa dang*/ gzhal du med pa rnams su sems can gyi don byed do// rgyal bu gzhon nu de ni rgyal srid dang*/ btsun mo la chags nas rab tu byung ma nus te/ yab kyi bka' las cung zhig 'gal na yang*/ dam pa gnyis pa'i bdag nyid du gyur pas/ nyes pa bshags par bya ba'i phyir du 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser zhun ma las grub pa'i gdugs shin tu rgya che zhing ngo mtshar ba/ baiḍār+ya zhun ma'i sham bu btags pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi phra bkod pa/ rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i yu ba can/ de lta bu stong rtsa gcig byas nas yab sras stong rtsa gcig po la phul te/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na khyed yab sras thams cad kyi 'khor dang*/ sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams dang*/ gdul bya dang*/ phrin las thams cad dang mnyam par gyur cig ces smon lam btab bo// de'i tshe de'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa klu rigs sgron ma gang yin pa de ni/ da lta nga nyid yin la/ rgyal bu gzhon nu gang yin pa de ni khyod yin gsungs pas/ rje btsun chos sdings pa yin par gda' 'o// da lta gser gdugs 'di lta bu grub pa yang*/ sngon gyi rgyu mthun yod pa yin gsungs so// de nas khong rang gis zhus te/ sras stong po de dag las zhabs drung 'dir ci tsam bzhugs zhus pa dang*/ nyid kyi zhal nas 'di na gcig kyang ma bzhugs te/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rnams na sems can gyi don mdzad ces bka' bstsal to// yang bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas/

sngon gyi slob dpon 'phags pa'i sku// da lta nga lus ma yin gyi// sngon gyi slob dpon 'phags pa'i chos// da lta nga yi thugs la bzhugs// bka' stsal de ltar gsungs pas na// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa yang*// khong nyid yin par nges pa'i phyir// gshis kyi dge dang mi dge gang*// gcig la gcig gi gnas med cing*// slob dpon chen po 'phags pas kyang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// de spyad las ni mi dge zhes// de thugs kyi dgongs pa mthun pa yin// 'di tshig tu brjod pa sla na yang*// don gyi go ba dka' ba yin// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa ba yin// dgag sgrub gnyis kyi so mtshams yin// mkhas pa'i skye bo 'khrul sa yin// skyon yon gnyis kyi gab sa yin// spyang po mgo bo 'khor sa yin// dpa' bo gom pa 'khyor sa yin// 'di la yin lugs mang po yod// chos 'di yi gsang tshig ma go na// ji ltar skyes bu'i rtsol ba yis// chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong nyams su blangs gyur kyang*// nyin par mtshan 'gros byed pa ste// su dang su 'thab mi shes pas// ngas kyang rdo zhig 'phangs zer ltar// dper na shar du 'gro ba la// nub kyi phyogs su kha bltas nas// shar du phyin par mi 'gyur zhing*// ci tsam bgrod cing ring ba'i phyir// de bas nyams len ma shes na// dam chos spyod pa'i yus po che// ma mthong gi g.yang sa chen po der// ltung bar 'gyur ba rtsa na yod// de bas nor 'khrul med pa yis// theg pa'i 'jug sgo bdam pa gces// yang slob dpon chen po 'phags pa yis// bag chags dag las byung bas na// bag chags sa bon dag tu 'dod// bag chags rjes mthun tshogs pa las// srid pa'i myu gu skye bar bzhed// bla ma rin chen zhal snga nas// 'khor bar lus 'khor sems 'khor la// gzhan gyi 'dod lugs mang na yang*// nga 'bu gang yang mi bzhed de// rgyu rkyen las skyes rnam rtog gi// bag chags lus su 'khor bar bzhed// don de gnyis dgongs pa gcig pa yin// de snga rabs 'das pa'i mtshon pa tsam// lar de dang 'dra ba mtha' yas mchog

/me long lta bu'i ye shes la// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// 'phel 'grib med pa'i bsam pa can// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// yab 'jig rten mgon po'i bzhugs tshul ni// bskal par brjod kyang mi lang na// 'jam dbyangs mgon po lta bu yi// sa bcu rnams kyi spyod yul min// gang gzhan pa rnams ni smos ci dgos// mdo rgyud zab mo'i rjes 'brangs nas// lung dang rigs pa'i gtan tshig gis// sangs rgyas yin par bsgrub par yang*// slob ma'i mos gus ma gtogs pa// yin min rtsod pa ma mchis te// mi mchog seng ge de nyid kyis// 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la// nga las gzhan na bla ma med// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// nga nyid yin pa'i bka' stsal gsung*// yang 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// skyes rabs rnam thar thams cad kyang*// rdo rje'i gsung tshig de la bya// 'on kyang yab kyi bzhugs tshul ni// ngas ni shes pa ma yin te// ma 'ongs dus na rjes 'jug rnams// lhag par spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir// ji ltar gsungs kyang phrin las yin// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi// thog mar byon pa kun gyi gtso// dpal rdo rje 'chang chen de nyid ni// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// tshe dang srog dang dbang thang dang*// longs spyod dus kyi gnad rnams la// dbang bsgyur dbang byed dbang thang can// sde snod gsum gyi snying 'byin zhing*// rgyud de bzhi yi srog phyung bas// 'khor 'das kun gyi zhag nyab kyang*// ngoms pa med pa'i gsol dang can// phyi nang gsang gsum rten 'brel rnams// skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen rnams la// snang ba rgyas pa'i mnga' thang can// byang chub snying po'i shing drung du// dung phyur bye ba'i bdud tshogs la// 'jigs med ye shes rdo rje yis// nyam nga med pa'i rang mthong can// lhun grub ye shes rgya mtsho nas// dgos 'dod yid bzhin char 'bebs shing*// phangs pa med pa'i sbyin pa yis// 'dzad pa med pa'i longs spyod can// phun sum tshogs pa lnga yi bdag

/dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' med la// cis kyang mgu bar mi nus shing*// gang la dga' ba'i sems gcig la// shin tu mnyes par sla ba yis// bskur rgyags spangs pa'i bdag nyid can// sangs rgyas kun gyi yul la 'jug /sems can kun gyi khams la 'jug /rtag tu 'khor 'das gnyis la rol// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis mi thub cing*// rnam 'phrul bkod pa mtha' yas pa// rab 'byams rdo rje rgyal po yin// de lta bu'i bla ma dam pa de ni/ 'dir srod kyi dus la gshegs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ tho rangs shar phyogs rdul dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing du/ mgon po phag mo gru pa'i spyan sngar byon nges te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa yin gsungs so// gzhan yang dga' ldan na rje btsun byams pa'i bla mar bzhugs kyang 'khor gyi tshul du mdzad nas/ jo bo rje dang*/ rje btsun chen po dang rnam gsum gyis mdo rnga bo che'i dgongs pa zhu zhing bzhugs so// yang rje sgam po pa'i zhal slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhas pa sdengs pa zhes bya ba/ grub thob mngon par shes pa rgya chen po mnga' ba/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma skal ba bzang mo dang dngos su gtam pa zhig gi zhal nas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma nas rgyud de 'di skad gsung*/ bla ma de la bsten yun thung ba dang*/ zhal ma mthong ba dang*/ mos gus byed pa rnams/ mya ngan dang sme sngags ma byed dang*/ bla ma des khyed la byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ thugs rjes bzung bar 'dug ngas ni shes pa ma yin te/ mkha' 'gro mas de skad gsungs gsung*/ da lta yang shar phyogs khyab gdal chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing zhes bya ba na/ sa gzhi thams cad gser zhun ma las grub pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyis spras pa'i seng ge'i khri chen po'i steng du rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i snying po'i dpal gyi ze ba can gyi cod pan gyi rtse mo na/ rdo rje'i sku'i mchog bla na med pa de ni/

rang byung gi dge slong sku mdog dkar po'i tshul can/ sku gzi mdangs dang ldan zhing zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pas/ bdag cag thams cad la byin gyis rlobs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ 'khor dge slong 'bum phrag mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la/ theg pa sna tshogs kyi chos gsung zhing bzhugs so// skabs skabs su 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la bka' stsal pa/ da lta 'dzam bu'i gling na nga'i rjes su 'brang zhing rjes su zhugs pa rnams/ tshe'i dus byed pa na nga yid la byed de skyes bu stobs po che lag pa brkyang ba dang skum pa'i tshad tsam gyis nga'i drung du phyin par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// de ma thag tu phyag g.yas pa gser gyi kha dog can bsod nams brgya'i mtshan dang ldan pa/ gzi brjid 'od 'phro zhing dpal 'bar ba/ spyi bo'i gtsug tu bzhag nas/ bu khyod bde bar 'ongs sam zhes gsungs zhing mnyes par 'gyur ro// des na bdag cag thams cad kyang*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus la// ltem rkyang dang bar chad ma shor na// tshe 'phos par bar do ma mchis par// 'gro mgon rin chen zhabs drung du// skad cig nyid la phyin par nges// de bsam pa'i rang gzugs 'gro ba yin// dge slong chos kyi 'byung gnas ltar// smon lam gyi dbang gis thugs rjes 'dzin pa yin// de la 'jam dpal mtshan brjod las// sems can kun gyi yid ltar mgyogs// zhes pa 'di lta bu la dgongs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams bsam zhing srid pa len pa yang*/ gnad 'di yi don go gcig pa yin// rje 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dus phyis bzhugs tshul mtha' yas pa// bdag rmongs pa'i spyod yul ma yin kyang*// yid spro ba'i cha tsam smos pa la// chos lung rigs rtogs par ldan pa yi// khyed skyes bu chos kyis spyan can la// 'gal 'khrul snang na bzod par bzhes// yab 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// chos rnam thar mthong ba don yod 'di// gang mthong dang thos pa'i sems can rnams// rje de dang 'bral ba med par shog

/don 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das dge ba yis// ma 'gro drug 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams// rkyen 'ching ba kun las grol nas kyang*// don mthar thug ye shes thob par shog /rje rin po che 'bri gung pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam par thar pa mthong ba don yod ma zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong shes rab 'byung gnas kyis sbyar ba rdzogs so// rnam thar 'di bris bsod rnams kyis// pha mas gtso byas sems can rnams// ma rig mun pa rab spangs nas// ye shes sku lnga rgyas par shog /bla ma'i rnam thar spyod par shog /chos rje'i go 'phangs thob par shog// /

06) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa zad mi shes pa'i za ma tog bkod pa// na mo rat+na gu ru// bde gshegs dgra bcom zla med rdzogs sangs rgyas// 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i ye shes yon tan ldan// lha mi'i ston pa kha lo rab bsgyur ba// mtshungs med rgyal ba rin chen dpal la 'dud// sems nyid nyon mongs rnyog ma rab dwangs shing*// sna tshogs snang ba'i gzung 'dzin sgribs pa spangs// dbyer med shes rab thabs la longs spyod pa// mkhas pa legs par zhugs pa'i tshul 'di mthong*// 'di ni lhun grub spros bral chos kyi dbyings// rnam dag 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo zhing*// skyon med sangs rgyas yon tan kun rdzogs pa// mnyam med 'gro mgon chos rje bla ma lags// de ni byang chub sems mchog rin chen sku// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mtshan rab dpal gyi gzhi// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus rnams 'dren pa// 'jig rten phyogs bcur khyab par bzhugs pa lags// de ni spros med ma skyes mi 'gag gsung*// tshangs dbyangs kun nas snyan pa chos kyi sgo// sgra skad rgya mtshos the tshom rab sel ba// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par grags pa lags// de ni mi g.yo rtag tu mnyam gzhag thugs// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma 'dres gsal bar gzigs// sgrib bral ye shes mkhyen pa lam me ba// 'khor 'das kun gyi ngo bor mnyam pa lags// de ni srid zhi'i yul la gnas mi mnga'// zag med yon tan phung po'i rgyan dang ldan// dbang bskur rgyal po 'byor ba'i mchog sbyin pa// dus gsum sems can grol bar gshegs pa lags// de ni lhun grub 'bad pa'i rtsol ba bral// brtse chen thugs rje chen po'i lcags kyu can// lus can 'gro ba mi gtong smin mdzad pa// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du bzhugs pa lags// de ni dus gsum dus med 'gyur ba med// thog mtha' med pa'i dang por byang chub pa// sems can khams dang mnyam pa'i skur snang zhing*// phyi ma'i mtha' yi bar du rtag pa lags// de ni rab 'byams chos dbyings rgyal ba'i zhing*// rang bzhin dag pa rin chen rgyu las grub// kun bzang mchod sprin sna tshogs rab bkram pa// yon tan bkod pa'i zhing na snang ba lags// de ni thugs dgongs chos las skyes pa'i sras// skyon med sbyangs pa shin tu dul ba'i 'khor// yon tan tshogs rdzogs dgongs pa kun sgrub pa// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus su rol pa lags// de ni spyod yul sna tshogs mtha' la spyod// spyod pa'i yul mtha' spyad pas 'dzad pa med// yul dang yul can dbyer med rnam par grol// yang dag mtha' ste mnyam nyid spyod pa lags// de ni gdul bya'i las kyi snang ba ltar// dag dang ma dag zhing dang 'dus pa'i tshogs// snying po byang chub bkod pa kun bstan kyang*// dbyer med nyes skyon nam yang med pa lags// de ni shin tu zhi zhing rab dul ba// mi sdug 'jigs su rung ba khros pa'i tshul// ji srid gzugs kyi mthar thug de dag kun// so sor mthun par chos dbyings mnyam pa lags// de ni gsung gcig nam mkha'i mthas klas pa'i// 'gro ba'i mos pa ji bzhin ston par mdzad// ston pa de dag chos nyid dbyings su gzhol// mtha' yas gsung dbyangs de ltar sgrogs pa lags// de ni sems shing phyi rol rgyu ba med// 'khor bar 'jug pa'i 'du byed zad gyur kyang*// rgyu las 'bras bu'i phrin las ma 'gags nas// ye shes rol pa'i dbang phyug chen po lags// de ni 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// yod med gnyis ka med par thugs su chud// spros pa'i mtshan ma rdul tsam mi mnga' zhing*// chos sku yon tan mdzad par bcas pa lags// de ni brtan g.yo phra ba'i rdul rnams la// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyan gyi bkod pa ston// de dag phan tshun ma sgribs gos pa med// bsal dang bzhag pa med par 'dug pa lags// de ni sku gcig khong du mtha' yas shing*// zhing khams kun tu gcig pa'i sku des khyab// de bzhin thugs gsung yon tan phrin las rnams// re res mkha' mnyam ma lus snang ba lags// de ni rgyal ba gcig pa mchod gcig pa// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho sprul pa mi zad mtshan// kun kyang mtshan gyi 'khor lor byin brlabs nas// gang gis thos pa phyir mi ldog pa lags// de ni bdag gis bdag nyid sprul par mdzad// bdag gis rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu sgrub// sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// bdag nyid bdag la mchod cing bstod pa lags// de ni kun nas zhal la kun nas spyan// kun nas phyag dang kun tu gshegs pa'i zhabs// kun tu spyod pa bsam gyis mi khyab sgo// yon tan 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa lags// de ni spyir yang snang ste de bdag nyid// yod pa ma yin de ni med pa'ang min// gnyis ka ma yin gnyis med las grol ba// smra bsam brjod med mtha' las 'das pa lags// de ni gang ltar bltas kyang mi mthong zhing*// gang ltar bltas kyang de ma gtogs pa med// blo gros chen po'i sems dpa' de mthong ste// dbyer med mnyam nyid bde legs 'byung gnas lags// de ni snod kyi 'jig rten gzhag par mdzad// bcud kyi 'gro ba du ma bkod par mdzad// 'phel 'grib mi rtag dus kyi 'gyur ba dang*// sna tshogs rkyen gyis bdag med ston pa lags// de ni gdul bya'i blo gros rim gyis khrid// blo snod ci tsam dag pa'i sprul pa dang*// bsod nams rgyu dang mthun pa'i phrin las rnams// lhun grub 'bad pa med par mdzad pa lags// de ni ye shes sngon 'gro sems can don// dus las yol ba nam yang mi srid de// thugs rje'i spyan gyis rgyun mi 'chad par gzigs// bsnyel ba med pa'i dran pas dgongs pa lags// de ni sems can gcig 'ga' ma dmigs kyang*// 'gro ba'i don phyir byang chub thugs bskyed cing*// thabs tshul rten 'brel du ma'i sgyu 'phrul gyis// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i mtsho las sgrol ba lags// de ni 'khor bar rtag tu bzhugs na yang*// 'khor ba'i skyon gyi ma gos pad+ma bzhin// 'dod pa dag las rnam par grol ba'i thugs// 'khrul pa med par 'jig rten skyong ba lags// de ni 'gro ba'i khur rnams pha rol phyin// srid par ngal zhing skyo dang dub pa med// ci tsam skyed pa'i don mchog cher grub pa// 'dir ni phyi bzhin bde dang skyid pa lags// de ni sems can re re'i don gyi phyir// mdzad pa'i rnam 'phrul nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// bskal pa mang por phyogs bcur ston mdzad kyang*// chos nyid 'khrul pa med par rgyu ba lags// de ni mnyam nyid dbyings las mi g.yo bar// srid gsum gnas la dbang byed bde chen po// las dang nyon mongs bdud kyi dkyil 'khor las// rten cing 'brel 'byung thabs kyis mtshon pa lags// de ni shes bya'i dngos po ji snyed pa// de snyed rgyu dang bcas pa'i sprul par mnyam// de kun sangs rgyas mdzad pa mchog mdzad kyis// mdzad med rtsol dang bral ba'i rang bzhin lags// de ni sems can rnams kyi spyod pa'i tshul// thabs mkhas kun la mi 'jug gcig ma mchis// thogs pa med pa sna tshogs theg pa'i sgo// dbyer med chos tshul gcig tu ston pa lags// de ni bskal pa rgya mtshor rab tu ston// zhing khams mtha' yas phra ba'i rdul du 'dzud// mi mtshungs mdzad pa dpag med bstan gyur kyang*// de dag mi 'khrul gshis la gnas pa lags// de ni 'gro ba'i rtog pa ma lus pa// skad cig nyid la mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'jug

/phan tshun ma 'dres mos pa ji bzhin du// cho 'phrul chen po 'khor la ston pa lags// de ni bsam gyis mi khyab ting 'dzin la// bzhengs dang bzhugs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sku yi spyod pa rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa// rgyal sras rnams kyis dpag par dka' ba lags// de ni sku gsung thugs dang phrin las dang*// 'khor dang zhing dang yon tan bkod pa'i tshogs// gcig dang tha dad ma yin blo las 'das// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bsngags pa mi zad lags// de ni nam mkha' lta bu kun la khyab// mtsho ltar dwangs shing zab pa'i bdag nyid can// rin chen lta bur dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhing*// lhun po lta bur kun tu mdzes pa lags// de ni rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams kyi gtso// sems dpa' rgya mtsho rnams kyis lung bstan pa// rang rgyal rgya mtsho rang byung rtogs par byed// nyan thos rgya mtsho 'khrid pa'i ded dpon lags// de ni bla med chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur// gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa'i bud shing bsreg pa'i me// theg dman khur gyis dub pa'i ljon shing dang*// mi 'jigs bsnyengs dang bral ba'i seng ge lags// de ni tshangs dbang gtsug gi rin po che// lha dbang brgya byin lha min pham pa'i dpal// klu dbang rnams la mi 'jigs sbyin pa'i skyabs// gnod sbyin dbang po bsrung ba'i gter chen lags// de ni mi mchog rkang gnyis ston pa po// gdul dka'i gdug pa 'dul ba khro bo'i rgyal// ngan song skye gnas sbyong ba thabs kyi mchog /mgon med gnyen bral rnams kyi rten gnas lags// de ni 'gro ba'i gnyid log sad byed rnga// mya ngan zug rngu 'byin byed bdud rtsi'i chu// nyon mongs gdung ba sel byed zla ba dang*// mi shes mun sel nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lags// de ni dug gsum nad sel sman gyi gtso// srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod pa'i ral gri mchog /bdag 'dzin 'khrul 'khor bshig pa'i rdo rje dang*// lta ngan the tshom gcod pa'i mtshon cha lags// de ni 'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol ba'i gru// sdug bsngal pha rol sgrol ba'i zam pa dang*// log lta ngan 'gro 'gogs pa'i sgo gtan te// 'chi bdag gshin rje 'joms pa'i gshed ma lags// de ni mi mthun bgegs rnams bsal ba dang*// thar par 'gro ba'i them skas nyid yin la// bde chen gling du 'khrid pa dge ba'i bshes// ma nor lam ston 'jig rten sgron me lags// de ni rang rig chos nyid bskyed pa'i pha// 'khor 'das yon tan bskyed pa'i ma yin la// phan dang bde ba ster ba'i gnyen gcig po// sangs rgyas sa la 'god pa'i bla ma lags// de ni mthong thos dran par gyur pa yang*// gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba kun ldan zhing*// srid pa'i sdug bsngal ma lus zad pa dang*// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob pa lags// ma dros rgya mtsho dal gyis 'bab pa'i klung*// gangs chen ri sul 'dzam bu tri sha'i drung*// de ni thugs dgongs sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pas// gus pa'i stobs kyis tshig tu de ltar brjod// bzhugs tshul 'di ni lan gcig thos pas kyang*// bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig mang po yi// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal phyir bsnyil nges gyur cing*// 'dzin cing klog dang ston pa smos ci dgos// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun tu bzang po reg gyur cig

/skyabs 'gran gyi do med 'dzam gling rgyan// grags pas stong gsum yongs la khyab// rtsod med rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// pha 'jig rten mgon po'i zhabs la 'dud// dus rtag tu bsam rgyu khyed las med// byin gyis rlobs shig thugs rje can// snying gi mun pa bsal nas kyang*// sems spros bral du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// rnam par thar pa zad mi shes pa'i za ma tog bkod pa zhes bya ba ri'i rgyal po gangs can gyi lho phyogs kyi ngos su/ shākya'i dge slong shes rab 'byung gnas kyi legs par smras pa dbyangs kyi bstod pa rdzogs so/// / 07) ༄// 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi bstod pa byang chub rdul bral ma// na mo gu ru/ byang chub snying po rdul bral zhing khams su// rang byung rgyal ba yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas// mtshungs med chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor ba// thub dbang 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib gsum rab rib mkha' ltar rnam par dag /mkhyen gnyis spyan ldan sgrib med ye shes kyis// dus gsum shes bya ma lus rnam gzigs pa// kun mkhyen 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// nyes tshogs mya ngan 'khor ba'i chu bo brgal// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rig pa'i pha rol son// mnyam nyid mi 'khrul zhi bar rtag gnas pa// bde gshegs 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// srid pa kun sbyor nyon mongs 'ching ba gcod// shes bya'i bud shing bsregs pa chos kyi sku// mi bzad bdud dpung sde bcas rab bcom pa// rgyal ba 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// sdug bsngal srid gsum 'brog dgon 'khyams pa yi// 'jig rten ston pa kha lo sgyur ba po// zhabs sen lhar bcas cod pan rtser blangs pa// 'dren pa 'bri gung rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// dgongs pa rnam dag bka' dang mthun pa yi// ma nor lam ston dge ba ci bsgrubs pas// sa bcu'i mgon po 'bri gung rin chen gyi// bstan pa dar zhing yun ring gnas gyur cig

/ma dros mtsho 'gram du spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa nyid kyis mdzad pa'o/// / 08) ༄// brgyud 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*// gangs ti se shel gyi gzhal yas na// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa la gsol ba 'debs/ gnas nub phyogs o rgyan gyi gzhal yas na// yum rdo rje phag mo la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bya rgod phung po'i ri bo na// mgon bstan pa'i bdag po la gsol ba 'debs// steng dga' ldan lha yi gzhal yas na// mgon byams chen rgyal ba la gsol ba 'debs// nub bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// mgon tshe dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// gnas pad+ma 'od kyi gzhal yas na// o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs// shar ri bo ta la'i rtse mo na// yi dam thugs rje chen po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga na// yi dam 'phags pa 'jam dpal la gsol ba 'debs// gnas lcang lo can gyi pho brang na// mgon gsang ba'i bdag po la gsol ba 'debs// dbus seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng na// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la gsol ba 'debs// shar glang chen bsnol ba'i khri steng na// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol ba 'debs// lho rta mchog bsnol ba'i khri steng na// bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan la gsol ba 'debs// nub rma bya bsnol ba'i khri steng na// bcom ldan snang ba mtha' yas la gsol ba 'debs// byang mkha' lding bsnol ba'i khri steng na// bcom ldan don yod grub pa la gsol ba 'debs// dbus dag pa bde chen gyi gzhal yas na// yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// shar mi 'gyur gnas pa'i gzhal yas na// yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// lho gter 'byung yid bzhin gyi gzhal yas na// yum rin chen mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// nub shes rab btsun mo'i gzhal yas na// yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gzhal yas na// mgon dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'debs// gnas dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad na// mgon grub chen brgyad po la gsol ba 'debs// gnas phyogs bcur ri khrod kyi dgon pa na// grogs rdo rje spun tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// gnas tsā ri dkyil 'khor gzhal yas na// nang gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs la gsol ba 'debs// gangs zur gsum dung gi gzhal yas na// yum lha sman mched lnga la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bka' dang dam tshig gi gzhal yas na// yum a phyi mched gsum la gsol ba 'debs// gnas bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod na// dpal ma mgon lcam dral la gsol ba 'debs// nged gsol 'debs dang 'gro drug la byin gyis rlobs// rgyud yongs su dag par mdzad du gsol// rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsal tu gsol//

ces pa 'di nyid ya rtse rgyal po'i pho brang du/ spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa nyid dang*/ rgyal po yab yum sras gsum gyis mdzad pa'o/// / 09) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag bsdus pa rin po che spungs pa'i phung po dri ma med pa// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sku gsung thugs// gnyis med mchog gyur ye shes ngo bo nyid// 'jig rten rnam 'dren yang dag lam ston pa// bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bde chen zung 'jug shes rab thabs kyi bdag /'khor 'das dbang phyug bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang*// 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor sna tshogs snang ba'i sku// dpal ldan lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs chen phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// rnam dag lam mchog legs par gsungs pa'i chos// bka' ltar rjes grub 'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thub pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas shing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa srung mdzad pa// chos skyong srung ma mthu chen thams cad kyis// dus rnams rtag tu bkra shis rgyal gyur cig /'dir srid pa gsum du u dum wa ra'i me tog ltar mthong ba dang rnyed par dka' ba/ 'jig rten du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po dngos su byon pa'i bla ma chos rje rin po che 'bri gung pa zhes yongs su grags pa de/ e chung du sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i dus su/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyi gter mdzod ni brnyes/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad ni pham par mdzad/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel ni mngon sum du gyur nas/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba smin grol mdzad pa dang*/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs tog mdzad par bzhed de/ thugs dam las bzhengs shing yul dbu ru byang phyogs su byon nas/

dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu bskyangs pas/ sku'i snyan pa dang grags pas 'dzam bu'i gling khyab par gyur cing*/ sa chen po'i steng 'di na yod pa'i grub thob rnams dang*/ mkhas pa rnams dang*/ chen po rnams dang*/ rgyal po rnams dang*/ skye dgu thams cad ni zhabs drung du lhags/ lha dang mi'i longs spyod/ rdzas dang yo byad/ zang zing gi dngos po thams cad kyang spyan sngar 'dus/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi rten rnams dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi rten rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' gsung rab rnams dang*/ rten khyad par du 'phags pa thams cad kyang phyag tu byon/ rten 'brel gyi mthu stobs thogs pa med pas/ rgya dkar po dang*/ rgya nag po dang*/ khyi than dang*/ me nyag dang*/ sog po hor gyi yul dang*/ bod khams thams cad bde ba la bkod pa'i phrin las kyi sgang la bab pas na/ sngon sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dus kyi dgongs pa 'khrungs pa mngon du gyur cing*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar gyi zhabs tog dang*/ rjes su 'brangs pa'i bu slob rnams kyi mgo thon pa'i rten 'brel la dgongs pas/ thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang mdzad par bzhed de/ bal yul na mkhas pa sprul pa'i lha bzo ma ṇi bha dra zhes bya ba bos nas/ gong slad du 'jig rten na 'di 'dra ba'i rten mi bzhugs pas/ thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchod rten chen po bla lhag tu gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs ma lus pa dang*/ spyir sngags mtshan nyid med pa thams cad kyi lha'i sku can/ rnam pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gcig tu bzhugs pa'i tshul du bzhengs so// de'i lha re re yang 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyis bzhugs tshul ma gzigs pa mi mnga' ba dang*/ de'i mdzad pa'i khyad par gyi chos zab mo'i gnad ma gsungs pa med pa dang*/ gsungs pa de dag kyang bka' mdo rgyud rnams dang mi mthun pa med pa/

dgongs pa thun mong ma yin par gyur pas/ thugs kyi bzhed pa dang mthun pa ma byung tshe/ lan bcu gsum re re tsam gyi bar du bshig cing bskyar nas legs par mthar thug par mdzad pa dang*/ de'i mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad spyir chos skyong ba'i srung ma thams cad dang*/ khyad par du rgyal po rnam thos sras kyis dngos su lung bstan nas mthun pa'i rkyen bsgrubs pa dang*/ klu chen po rnams kyis bar chad med par srungs pas/ lo bcu gnyis kyis gser phra dang bcas pa ma lus pa tshar ro// dus der 'dzam bu gling gi bu slob/ rje btsun byams pa'i 'khor 'dus pa dang mnyam pa thams cad dpal gyi phag mo grur sdud cing*/ bkra shis sgo mang gdan 'dren par dgongs pa la/ 'dir lam la mi shong zhing 'degs par dka' bas/ chu'i klung gnad drangs na klu chen po rnams kyis spyan 'dren pas/ mi yul du mi bzhugs par dogs te/ sa'i steng nyid nas gdan 'dren pa'i shoms mdzad pa la nye ba na/ phyi nang gi rten 'brel sna tshogs pa'i stobs kyis/ ngam shod du chos rnams dang bkra shis sgo mang bzhugs na/ kha smras dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'khrugs long gi gzhir gyur nas/ skye bo mang po ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i las gsog par dgongs te/ snang ba dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po dang*/ mi snang ba chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad la bkas gnang nas/ gdung rten bkra shis 'od 'bar dang*/ chos thams cad phag mo gru nas spyan drangs shing*/ chos rnams rje phag mo gru pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ shar dwags lha sgam por phul nas bzhugs so// bkra shis 'od 'bar ni rje 'gro ba'i mgon po nyid kyis thog mar mtshon pa mdzad nas/ dge slong snam sbyar bgos pa dpag tu med pas/ mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing gzho'i lung pa spos dris khyab par byas nas/ spyan snga nyid nas kyang phyag gis gdung rten gyi mdo li mdzad nas/

thang la bsu ba mdzad de/ mthil du gdung rten gyi zhabs tog tu sgo mang bsgrigs nas steng du bzhugs shing*/ yun ring zhig du mchod pa rgya chen pos mchod cing bzhugs pa la/ thugs kyi dgongs pas rgyal ba phag mo gru pa rnams kyi ched du gdung rten gyi bzhugs sa zhig gzhan du mdzad par bzhed kyang*/ phag mo gru pa nyid de ma 'dod nas/ bkra shis 'od 'bar mtha' rtsa nyid du phar la spyan drangs te/ thang la yun ring du 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyis gshegs skyel rgya chen po mdzad do// de'i shol du sgo mang gi steng du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i rten phyag na bzhugs tshad rnams kyi bzhugs gnas/ gdung rten gcig mdzad par bzhed de/ de yang rgyu gser dngul 'ba' zhig la byas na mthar sdig rkyen du 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ dngos po rin po che bzang po mang po song yang*/ sdig rkyen du mi 'gyur bar phyogs gcig tu byas pa'i tsha gser can/ dpal bkra shis mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i mchod rten 'di bzhengs nas/ gdung rten gyi rab gnas dang nang rdzongs gong du mdzad do// de nas dus phyis sgo mang gi nang rdzongs mdzad pa la/ 'di la sngon nas dgongs pas/ sgo mang la ni gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis dge sbyor rgyud la skye ba'i rten 'brel dang*/ ldum rdzings kyi chos skyong srung ma rnams la gsol ba btab pas drag po'i las 'grub pa dang*/ klu la char 'bebs pa dang ra hu las ser ba 'bebs pa dang*/ nor gyi lhas nor sbyin pa la tshegs med par 'byung ba'i rten 'brel mdzad par bzhed pa mnga' yang*/ bkra shis sgo mang la gsol ba btab pas/ dge sbyor skye ba dang*/ rjes la mthil 'dir dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang*/ rdzas dang yo byad kyi longs spyod dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi 'chad pa'i rten 'brel sgrig pa dang*/ rab tu gnas pa khyad par can 'di mdzad do// de rnams kyi phyag len gyi zhabs tog la bdag rang gis bgyis pas/

'dir nang rdzongs kyi bzhugs tshul cung zad che long tsam zhig phyi ma'i skye bo rnams kyis shes par bya ba'i phyir smos par bya'o// de la spyir thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang 'di dum bu gsum du brdzangs pa la/ thog mar gdung rten gyi 'khor lo yan chad 'di la/ phyi rin po che sna tshogs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bar du ruṣ+ka bzang po ba glang gi ko ba mthug shos tsam du byugs pa la/ de'i nang du me nyag gi rgyal po zla rgyas kyi ring la/ yul der de bas lhag pa byung ba med pa'i dzhai k+ṣim bzang po gzhal yas khang gi tshul du byas pa'i nang du/ rten rnams gdan dang gdugs dang na bza' dang mchod par bcas pa bzhugs pa la/ dang po nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs pa rje phag mo gru pa'i sku'i nang du/ rin po che dang*/ spos dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi pho brang rim pa gsum gyi dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa rabs bdun nam/ brgyud pa'i bla ma bdun mtshon pa'i rnam grangs/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel sta mgo ma bdun dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur gyi nang du bzhugs pa dang*/ rje mar pa'i gdung dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur gyi nang du bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i dbu skra dkar po dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra nag po dang*/ gtso bor rje phag mo gru pa'i tshems dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur la bzhugs pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan 'bum dang*/ gzungs chen bzhi la sogs pa gzungs byin rlabs can rnams gser gyis bris pa/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi snal ma'i gur gyi nang du bzhugs shing*/ srin rte'u sna dang gos chen dang dar bzang po'i na bza' can rnams kyi bar bar du gser dngul bai ḍūr+ya la sogs pa rin po che'i phye ma rnams dang*/ tsan dan go shir+ṣa dang*/ sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa'i dri rnams dang*/ ga pur dang gur gum la sogs pa'i sman bzang po rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi lo ma dang*/

shing gi 'bras bu la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams dang rten rnams bzhugs so// tog gi nang du snga ma kho na ltar/ rin po che sna tshogs pa dang*/ spos dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi pho brang rim pa gsum gyi nang du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mtshon pa'i rnam grangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bcu gsum zab chen gyi gur du bzhugs pa dang*/ rje btsun mar pa'i gdung zab chen gyi gur la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung zab chen gyi gur la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung dang dbu skra za 'og gi gur la bzhugs pa dang*/ gtso bor rje sgam po pa chen po'i tshems zab chen 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi mtshan 'bum dang*/ tog gi gzungs thams cad dar chen la dri bzang pos bris pa/ srin rte'u sna dang dzhai k+ṣim gyi snal ma spungs pa'i nang du bzhugs pa/ bar bar du gser dngul dang bai ḍūr+ya la sogs pa'i rin po che'i phye ma rnams dang*/ tsan dan go shir+ṣa dang*/ sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa'i dri rnams dang*/ ga bur dang gur gum la sogs pa'i sman bzang po rnams dang byang chub kyi shing dang*/ lo ma dang*/ 'bras bu la sogs pa bkra shis pa'i rten rnams bzhugs so// 'khor lo'i nang du snga ma bzhin du/ rin po che sna tshogs pa dang spos dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi gzhal yas khang rim pa gsum gyi nang du bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong mtshon pa'i rnam grangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel brgya phrag bcu spos kyi nang du bsdus pa/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi lo ma brgya stong mang po phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dang*/ ma bsdebs pa la sku bris pa dang ma bris pa rnams dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi 'bras bu mang po dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi na bza' dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/

gnas chen po brgyad kyi sa'i mchod rten gos chen rdo rje rgya gram la bzhugs pa dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can gyi gdan dang*/ gdugs can 'ga' zhig dang*/ rje btsun mar pa'i gdung mdog dkar po phye mar bzhugs pa ring bsrel can dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po mi las phyag 'ju ba'i shing la bzhengs pa'i sku/ rje btsun nyid seṅge la bcibs pa ras kyi na bza' can/ thugs kha na rje btsun nyid kyi tshems bzhugs pa/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can dang*/ gos can la sogs pa'i na bza' bzhugs pa dang*/ rje btsun mi la'i phyag na bsnams pa'i ḍā ma ru dar dpyangs sna tshogs pa dang rgyan du mas brgyan pa na bza' dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung dkar po dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gsol zhal spen rtsa la bgyis pa dri bzang pos byugs shing bkra shis pa'i sman dang rdzas kyis bkang ba/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i dbu skra dang*/ na bza'i dum bu rnams dang*/ chags sgrogs yun ring du mdzad pa phyugs gcig dri bzang pos bsgos shing dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung dang dbu skra dang*/ na bza' dang*/ sku mtshal dang*/ zhabs dreg rnams re re zhing dzhai k+ṣim gyi snal ma'i gur dang*/ 'bras bu can gyi gzhi la bzhugs pa na bza' dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i rgyan drug sag ti dmar po'i gzhi la du ru skas byugs pa la bzhugs shing rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan pa dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i sku rked la bzhugs pa'i dril bu dang*/ de'i cha rdo rje zhig sman dang spos kyis bar brdzangs shing dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi gdung mang po dang*/ gdung thal rnams dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/

jo bo chen po'i stag gi bzhugs gdan dri spos kyis bsgos pa dang*/ jo bo chen po'i phyag gi ḍā ma ru glang po che'i rus pa las byas pa dri bzang pos byugs shing kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dar dpyangs can/ zab chen la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pas mdzad pa gar gyi nyams dgu la sogs pa gser gyis bzhengs pa dang*/ mtshan brjod la sogs pa gser gyi po tir mdzad pa las/ de'i glegs shing khyi than nas byung ba shel las bgyis pa/ khyi than gyi rgyal khams kyi rin du mi chog pa la/ gzhi gser las byas pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku brgya bcu rtsa gsum bzhengs pa dang*/ na bza' dang glegs thag dzhai k+ṣim las byas pa dang*/ gos chen bzang po rnams la dri bzang pos bzhengs pa'i srog shing rten pa la sogs pa 'khor lo'i gzungs dpag tu med pa bzhengs pa rnams dang*/ gser gyi 'phags pa sdud pa dang*/ mtshan brjod la sogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' gser gyis bzhengs pa rnams dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs te/ rten dang chos dzhai k+ṣim la bzhugs pa de re re yang srin rte'u sna 'jam pos gsol ba dang*/ de dar 'jam pos gsol ba dang*/ de gos chen bzang po dang*/ za 'og rim pa du mas gsol ba dang*/ bar bar du gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig dang*/ mu men dang*/ byu ru dang*/ shel dang*/ pad+ma ra ga dang*/ mar gad dang*/ in+d+ra nī la dang*/ g.yu dang*/ me shel dang*/ chu shel dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa gzhan rnams dang*/ ga pur dang*/ gur gum dang*/ 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa sman dang*/ tsan dan go shir+ṣa dang*/ sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa dri spos rnams kyis brdzangs nas/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi gsol zhal 'brug rgya ba legs pa gcig chab tsha zi po los bkang ba dang*/ gsol sder kha 'phyongs legs pa gsol zhib sbrang kar dang sbyar bas bkang ba dang*/ mchod pa'i dngos po ngo mtshar can dpag tu med pas mchod nas/

gser gyi chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i rnam pa/ pa tra dang ldum rdzings dang bzo gnas du mas brgyan pa zhig gdan du phul nas bzhugs te/ de rnams ni dum bu dang po'o// //gnyis pa bre man chad kyi bum stod smad pad+ma dang bcas pa de yang phyi rin po che sna tshogs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bar du du ru ka bzang po mthug srab ba glang gi ko ba tsam du byugs pa'i nang du/ khyi than gyi yul gyi za 'og rgyal bu le no'i ring la byung ba la/ de las lhag pa med pa'i zab chen rdo rje ma zhes bgyi ba/ kha dog sna lnga pa las rigs gsum byas pa'i kha dog bco lnga pa mi'i las 'das pa lha rdzas su grub pa/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi thugs dgongs las byung ba'i na bza'i pho brang zhu lub tu byas pa'i nang du/ bre dang pad+ma'i bar du/ nang tsan dan mchog tu gyur pa phyi dzhai k+ṣim gyis g.yogs pa'i skor bu la zab chen dang*/ dar chen gyi bcud thag gis mi 'chug par phyogs bzhir bsdams nas/ thog mar bre'i gdong gis zur rnams kyi nang na/ rje phag mo gru pa'i sku lugs ma bla ma me nyag sgom ring gis bzhengs pa/ rje gong ma nyid kyi rab gnas dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs dam mkha' spyod ma dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ yang bla ma chen po'i thugs dam rje phag mo gru pa'i sku dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ yang sku gcig ste rje gong ma nyid kyi rab gnas bdun bdun tsam bzhugs dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa gsum dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje rgya gar ma byin rlabs can/ me nyag gi rgyal khams bde ba'i rten 'brel mdzad pa'i dus su gsol ba btab pa la ut+pa la'i gdugs can dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu la can la bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan rgya gar ma thub pa chen po dang*/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa ngo mtshar can zab chen kyi gdan dang na bza' dang gdugs can 'ga' zhig dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems kyi dum bu the'u chung tsam zhig dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can gyi gdan dang gdugs dang mchod pas mchod pa dang*/

rje phag mo gru pa'i chos gos snam sbyar sku mtshal dang bcas pa gur gum gyis gsol zhing*/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can dang*/ gan dar 'od dmar po can la nang byas shing*/ phyi jus sngon po'i g.yogs can/ zab chen dang gos kyi na bza' du ma gsol ba dang*/ bre'i gzungs dar chen la dri bzang pos bris pa dpag tu med pa rnams tshan bzhir byas te/ dzhai k+ṣim dang na bza' dpag tu med pa can rnams dang*/ de dag gi bar bar du spos rnams dang*/ rin po che rnams dang*/ sman rnams dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rnams kyis gang bar byas nas bzhugs so// bre de dang bum stod 'brel pa can gyi dbus drang po der/ thugs dam rin po che'i gdung rten dang*/ slob dpon rtsi lung pa'i thugs dam 'jig rten mgon po nyid la gnang ba dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi ma hā bo dhi dang gsum bzhugs pa la/ dang po thugs dam gdung rten rgyu rin po che sna tshogs pa las byas pa khru gang ma/ du ru ka la sogs pa'i dri dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can gyi pho brang rim pa gsum gyi nang du/ tog dang 'khor lo la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa mtshon pa'i rnam grangs/ sta mgo'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel mang po dang*/ sog gi tshems kyi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ tsha rong gi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ 'jang gi tshems kyi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ sha ping gi tshems kyi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ 'dan gyi tshems kyi ring bsrel dang*/ sing ga gling gi sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel mang po dang*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel gzhan dag mang po dang*/ 'phags pa dgra bcom pa'i ring bsrel mang po dang*/ spyir ring bsrel bgrang gis mi lang ba rnams/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi snal ma'i gur 'od kha dog lnga pa can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung dang dbu skra dang phyag zhabs sen mo dang*/ sku mtshal dang*/ na bza'i dum bu rnams dzhai k+ṣim gyi snal ma'i gur kha dog lnga pa la bzhugs pa dang*/

rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra dang*/ phyag zhabs sen mo dang*/ na bza' dang*/ sku mtshal dang*/ zhabs dreg dang*/ zhabs rde'u rnams na bza' dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur dang*/ srin rte'u sna 'jam po la bzhugs pa dang*/ gtso bor bum stod du rgya nag po'i rgyal po'i mdzod nas byung ba'i shel gyi snod ngo mtshar can dri bzang pos bkang ba'i steng du bzhugs pa/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi dbu zhu'i nang du bzhugs pa/ dngul sku chung ngu bzhugs pa'i pho brang*/ dngul gyi ga'u ya khebs la 'khor lo'i gdung rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i tog can yod pa/ ma khebs la mu tig gi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa du mas brgyan pa/ nang logs su dri bzang po legs par bsgos pa'i nang na/ rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu'i gdung chen po gser gyi glegs ma'i nang du bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i tshems bzhi gser gyi glegs ma'i nang na bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i 'phel gdung chen po ngo mtshar can gser gyi glegs ma'i nang na bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhabs rjes dang dbu skra dang*/ phyag zhabs sen mo dang*/ sku mtshal dang*/ thugs dam dang*/ zhabs dregs thams cad dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur la bzhugs shing mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mchod rten gyi gzungs chos zab mo legs pa tshad dang ldan pa grangs su ldan pa bzhengs pa rnams dzhai k+ṣim gyi gur la bzhugs pa dang*/ de dag gi bar bar du nor bu rin po che me shel dang*/ chu shel dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ gser la sogs pa rin po che rnams dang*/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa'i dri rnams dang*/ 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa'i sman rnams dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi 'bras bu rnams dang*/ mchod pa thams cad kyi nang gang bar mchod nas/ phyir cod pan dang dzhai k+ṣim gyi gdan dang*/ gdugs dang*/ na bza' gos chen dang*/ zab chen dang*/ srin rte'u sna rim pa grangs mang pos gsol nas bzhugs so// de dang mnyam par slob dpon rtsi lung ba'i thugs dam gdung rten nyi zla can brgyar brkyang khru gang lhag pa'i nang na/

de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel la sogs pa brgyud pa gong ma rnams kyi rten rnams dang*/ khyad par du rje sgam po pa'i dbu skra mang po dang*/ phyag zhabs sen mo dang sku gdung mang po dang*/ sku mtshal phul gang tsam bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra dang phyag zhabs sen mo dang*/ sku mtshal rnams dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung cag ge'i sum gnyis lhag bzhugs te/ de yang bu slob thams cad 'dus nas gdung bgos pa'i gros byas nas/ de thams cad mnyam por bgos shig zer ba la/ slob dpon rtsi lung ba de bu chen zhabs tog can lags pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ mnyam par bgos pa'i su dang su mnyam pas snyoms zhes gsung nas/ phyag gnyis bsgrad nas gdung spungs pa de la chus tshad cig bsnams pa la/ bu slob sus kyang cang zer bar ma nus nas/ de'i lhag ma de thams cad kyi bgos pa la yang slob dpon rtsi lung ba des/ 'o na lung pa'i mi chos dang lha dam/ rje gong ma de dang chos 'brel yod tshad kyi gdung gi skal ba bzung ste/ so so la ngas khyed kyi gdung skal bzung nas yod/ da khyed rang gdung rten byed dam/ nga'i gdung rten du bzhugs gsungs pas/ thams cad na re/ nged kyis mi 'grub pas 'o rgyal/ slob dpon la 'bul zer nas de thams cad gdung rten der bzhugs pa la gdung mang bas/ gzungs bris pa thams cad ma shong ba lags par gda' ba'i gdung rten de la/ rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phreng ba dang*/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phreng ba du mas spel zhing brgyan pa/ zab chen gyi gdan la me long gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can gyi na bza' dang*/ srin rte'u sna dang*/ zab chen dang*/ gos chen dang*/ dar chen sna tshogs pa'i na bza' rim pa du mas gsol te/ bzhugs pa dang*/ de gnyis dang mnyam par rdo rje'i gdan nas byon pa/ byang chub kyi shing las bzhengs pa'i ma hā bo dhi/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dngos su bzhugs pa dang khyad par med gsungs pa'i bcom ldan 'das kyi sku bcag khru gang ba la/

dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can gyi gdan dang*/ gdugs dang*/ na bza' dang*/ srin rte'u sna'i na bza' dang*/ zab chen dang*/ gos chen dang*/ dar chen kha dog sna tshogs pa'i na bza' rnams gsol ba dang*/ bar bar du mchod pa rnams kyis gang bar byas te bzhugs so// bum pa'i bstod nas pad+ma'i bar du/ phyogs bzhi la/ shar phyogs mdun ngos su rje phag mo gru pa'i phyag mkhar sba gug legs par khrus gsol te/ phyag gis gur gum gyi chu gar mos gser gyi mdog ltar byugs nas dang po ling lcags ka 'dul byas pa la gser gyi yan lag bdun pa smon lam dang bcas pa tshar bdun bris pas/ ring nas ring du na bza' ltar gsol te/ dzhai k+ṣim gyis skud pas mi mngon bar dkris nas/ yang spos dang sman gsol zhing*/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi 'bras bu can gyi na bza' rim pa gcig dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstod 'bum gur kum nas drangs pa/ dbu zhabs su na bza' ltar gsol nas/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi skud pas mi mngon par dkris nas/ yang spos dang sman gsol zhing*/ zab chen rdo rje ma dbu zhabs su na bza' rim pa gcig dang*/ bkra shis kyi be'u bum gur kum nas drangs pa/ dbu zhabs su na bza' ltar gsol nas/ zab chen gyi skud pas mi mngon par dkris nas/ yang spos dang sman gsol zhing*/ zab chen gyi rim pa du ma dang*/ gos chen rim pa du ma dang*/ srin rte'u sna dang dar kha dog sna tshogs pa'i na bza' rim pa du mas gsol nas/ yar sna la gser gyi rgyan las khyad par du 'phags pa'i bai ḍūr+ya chen po ngo mtshar can mtheb chen tsam gcig btags nas/ phyag mkhar de nyid kyi rgyud bzhin du/ gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang*/ mu men dang*/ byi ru dang*/ pad+ma ra ga la sogs pa'i phreng bas brgyan pa dbu yar bstan nas bzhugs pa dang*/ bum pa'i nang gi lho ngos su rje btsun nā ro pa'i phyag ka li rje btsun mar pa la gnang ba/ phyi glang po che'i lpags pa mdog dkar po la/

blag chu ha'i ri mo can/ bar smyug ma'i lhas ma ste/ nang ras chag phran sngon po la byas pa la/ phyag nyid kyis de rnams kyi bar bar du du ru ka byugs shing*/ nang ngos su yang byugs nas dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can glan pa'i nang na/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi thugs dam rgyud rgyal gsang ba 'dus pa rtsa bshad rnams dang*/ phyag yig 'phags pa sdud pa la sogs pa bka' zab mo rnams bzhugs/ bar bar du spos dang dris mchod cing*/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi glegs thag dang*/ na bza' dang*/ gzhan zab chen dang gos chen gyi na bza' rim pa sum cu lhag tsam gsol ba dang*/ bar bar du chud tshad du tsan dan dang rin po che la sogs pas bkang nas/ dbu yar bstan nas bzhugs pa dang*/ bum pa'i nang gi nub ngos su/ thugs dam ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po dang*/ rje btsun rnam par rol pa la sogs pa'i mdo sde zab mo gser gyi glegs bam du bgyis pa/ glegs thag dang*/ na bza' thams cad dzhai k+ṣim dang gos chen las bgyis pa'i na bza' rim pa mang po dang*/ bar bar du spos dang sman gyi mchod pa dbu yar bstan nas bzhugs pa dang*/ bum pa'i nang gi byang ngos su/ rje phag mo gru pas mdzad pa'i rin chen them skas la sogs pa'i bka' 'bum ma lus pa gser gyis bzhengs pa'i po ti la/ glegs thag dang na bza' rim pa dpag tu med pa/ phyi 'brug chen po'i na bza' can/ bar bar du spos dang*/ sman dang*/ rin po che mchod nas dbu yar bstan te bzhugs pa dang*/ yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan mdo sde mtha' dag na bzhugs pa gser gyis bris pa'i glegs bam na bza' mang po dang mchod par bcas pa dang*/ de rnams kyi bar du jo bo chen po rje'i phyag mtshan gsil byed/ spos dang sman gyis bsgos pa dzhai k+ṣim dang*/ gos chen gyi na bza' du ma dang bcas pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i sku 'bag bzhugs tshad rnams dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i zhabs rjes bkod pa bris pa dang*/

rje phag mo gru pa'i bris sku bzhugs tshad thams cad la rab gnas du ma bzhugs pa rnams zhal kheb dang*/ na bza' gsar pa dang*/ bar bar du dris spos kyis bsgos nas/ phyogs gcig tu bzhugs te g.yon phyogs nas dril nas/ dzhai k+ṣim dang*/ gzhan zab chen dang*/ gos chen du ma'i na bza' phul te bzhugs so// //bum smad kyi nang du rje phag mo gru pa'i chags zon phrugs gcig la/ nang du tsan dan la sogs pa'i dri dang*/ gser la sogs pa'i rin po che rnams dang*/ 'bras bu gsum gur kum nas ston pa'i sman rnams kyis brdzangs nas/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can dang*/ gos chen dang dar chen gyi na bza' du ma gsol ba dang*/ phyag mkhar gyi rting pa'i sne mo pad+ma la reg la khad na/ dngul gyi bum pa phyi pa tra dang ldum rdzings kyis g.yogs pa'i nang sman gyis bkang nas de'i nang du rting pa bzhugs su bcug nas bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang bum stod kyi gzungs dar chen la dri bzang pos bris pa dpag tu med pa tshan bzhir byas nas/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la sogs pa'i na bza' can dang*/ de bzhin du bum smad kyi gzungs dpag tu med pa tshan bzhir byas pa dang*/ pad+ma'i gzungs mang po dar chen la bris pa na bza' sna tshogs pas gsol ba tshan bzhir byas pa dang*/ yang thugs dam sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor thugs rtsis can na bza' rim pa du ma dang*/ mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod pa dang*/ de bzhin du rgyud gzhan rnams dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i phran gzhan dang mdo sde dang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa dang*/ 'phags pa sdud pa la sogs pa gser gyis bzhengs pa thams cad la/ na bza' bzang po gsar pa gsar pa rnams dang*/ glegs thag gsar pa rnams gsol zhing mchod pa thams cad kyis legs par mchod cing bzhugs pa dang*/ de thams cad kyi bar bar thams cad du bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig dang*/ mu men dang*/ byi ru dang*/ shel dang*/ me shel dang*/

chu shel dang*/ in+d+ra nī la dang*/ pad+ma rā ga dang*/ margad dang*/ g.yu la sogs pa'i rin po che rnams dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas rdo rje gdan du slob dpon 'phags pas btsugs pa'i a ru ra'i 'bras bu rnams dang*/ lho dpal gyi ri'i shing thog 'bras bu can rnams dang*/ nub phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi gdung dang*/ kar+sha pa ni rmad du byung ba rnams dang*/ a su ri'i brag phug dang*/ rje btsun mi las phyag gis btsugs pa'i snying zho sha la sogs pa'i rdzas khyad par du 'phags pa rnams dang*/ gangs ti se dang*/ mtsho ma dros pa'i sman dang*/ spos rnams dang*/ tswa ri g.yu mtsho nas byung ba'i khyad par du 'phags pa'i g.yu la sogs pa rnams dang*/ ga pur bzang po bre lnga lhag gur kum dang*/ ghi waṃ dang*/ dzā ti la sogs pa'i sman rnams dang*/ tsan dan go shir+ṣa sha dang*/ rgya nag po'i yul nas byung ba'i tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i phye ma khal phyed lhag dang*/ chab tsha zi po la sogs pa la lha rdzas kyi mchod pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu byas te/ rgya nag tong kun gyi gdan gyi rtsa ba las grub pa'i snod rin po che rnams gang ba dang*/ phur mar byas pa dang*/ ma byas pa dang*/ phye mar byas pa dang*/ phye mar ma byas pa legs par gang bar rdzangs nas/ des gang ba dang*/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can rim pa gcig dang*/ de'i bar du srin rte'u sna 'jam po rim pa gcig dang*/ spos dang sman rim pa gcig dang*/ zab chen rdo rje ma rim pa gcig dang*/ de nas dar rim pa 'ga' zhig dang*/ gos chen la du ra kas ba glang gi ko ba tsam du byugs pa rim pa gcig dang bcas pas zhabs su gsol te/ zhabs bsdom la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa'i bar du rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad dang*/ gter chen po brgyad dang*/ lha'i gos dang*/ dri'i lag ris bzang pos khyab par byugs nas gdan du phul te bzhugs pa ni dum bu gnyis pa'o// gsum pa pad+ma dang rdo rje dang ut+pal gyi phreng ba gsum nas/

lha yod pa'i bang rim bdun rdo rje'i sa gzhi la thug pa'i bar phyogs gcig tu byas pa 'di la/ bang rim gyi phyir lha'i ka ba yod pa bzhin du/ nang du tsan dan bzang po'i dri dang ldan pa'i ka ba phyi'i ka ba'i grangs dang mnyam pa btsugs nas/ dbus su tsan dan mchog tu gyur pa la nang byas shing*/ phyi dzhai k+ṣim gyi g.yogs pa'i tsan dan gyi ka ba dang ka zhu rgya gram du yod pa/ de'i steng du srin rte'u sna'i nang tshangs can gyi gdan rnams dang*/ seng ge dang glang po che la sogs pa'i ri mo can gyi gos rnams kyi gdan dang*/ rdo rje'i gsang lam la sogs pa'i gdan du ma btegs byas nas ka ba dbus ma de la bstod pa sna tshogs dang dar dpyangs kyi cod pan gyis brgyan te/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i 'og tu tsan dan gyi gzhi la rdo rje rgya gram rin po che 'bar ba bzhis brgyan pa'i lte ba la mi 'chug par bcugs nas btegs so// de'i phyi rin po che'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa/ logs thung nyi shu pa'i rnam pa/ pho brang bdun rtsegs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa la/ bar bar du du ru ka bzang po dang*/ dri spos kyi mthug srab glang gi ko ba tsam du byugs nas dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can bzang pos zhu lub tu g.yogs pa'i pho brang*/ rim pa gsum gyi nang du 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi na bza'i rgyu pong ku che rdo rje gsang lam la sogs pa'i na bza' rim pa du mas g.yogs pa'i nang zhabs su dar chen gyi gdan rim pa mang po'i steng du rten bzhugs pa la/ thog mar 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi thugs dam/ rje phag mo gru pa'i zhabs rjes bkod pa can gser gyis bzhengs pa la/ dzhai k+ṣim gyi na bza' dang*/ gos chen rnam pa du mas gsol ba mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ jo bo thugs rje chen po rje phag mo gru pa'i rab gnas brgya rtsa brgyad bzhugs pa/ e chung du bsgrub pa lo bdun mdzad pa'i tshe dbu sngas su bkram zhing*/

lha de'i spyan sngar bsnyun nad chen po dwangs ba'i sku byin rlabs can ras sngon po'i gong sham can la/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can/ gos chen gyi zhal khab dang*/ na bza'i rim pa sna tshogs pa gsol ba/ chu srin gyi rus pa'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal ldan nā ro pa chen po'i bzhugs gdan kriṣ+ṇa sa ri'i lpags pa la bzhugs nas tshad ma grub pa gsungs pa'i gdan la/ na bza' rim pa du ma dang mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ rje btsun nā ro pa la dpal ldan til+li pas gnang ba'i phyag skyogs la/ nang du gser byugs shing rje btsun ma bzhengs pa dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi phyag skyogs rje btsun ma lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ de'i nang du rje phag mo gru pa'i gdams ngag snying por gyur pa thams cad phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi phyag yig ri khrod du sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa na/ de gcig pu bsnams pas chog par dgongs pa e waṃ ma zhes bya ba gur kum nas drangs pa na bza' dang mchod pas mchod nas bzhugs pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi dho ha mgur 'bum thugs dam du bzhugs pa/ na bza' du ma dang*/ mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i phyag yig ma jo lha rje ma'i lam 'bras dang*/ slob dpon rgyal po'i lam bskor dang*/ rje btsun ma mkha' spyod ma la sogs pa re re nas smos kyis mi lang bas phyag yig bzhugs tshad dang*/ lam 'bras dpe mdzod ma dang*/ dpal bde mchog la sogs pa re re nas smos kyis mi lang bas/ rje phag mo gru pa'i phyag dpe bzhugs tshad rnams na bza' rim pa du ma dang*/ mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi phyag yig rje phag mo gru pa'i gsung sgros zin bris su mdzad pa rnams dang*/ sgrub pa mdzad pa na thugs kyi dgongs pa/ mi chos dang lha dam du mdzad pa dang*/ gdams ngag gi gnad thugs la 'khrungs pa gzhan bskul du mdzad pa la sogs pa 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi phyag yig ma lus pa/

na bza' rim pa du ma dang bcas shing mchod pa bzhugs so// yang rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu'i gdung la rje btsun ma'i sku byon pa gser gyi ga'u'i nang du spos dang sman gyis phyag gis brdzangs nas/ dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la sogs pa'i na bza' du ma gsol te dngul gyi gsol zhal gyi nang du spos dang sman sna tshogs dang bcas pas bzhugs nas/ na bza' rim pa du ma gsol ba dang*/ rdo rje gdan nas byon pa byang chub kyi shing gi ma hā bo dhi dpal chen chos ye la gnang ba'i sa gnon can dang*/ bdag la gnang ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo ma dang*/ gzhan ma hā bo dhi gcig dang gsum/ na bza' dang mchod par bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi thugs dam rje phag mo gru pa'i sku mchod pa dang na bza' ldan pa dang*/ rgya gar gyi lha a mo gha pā sha cod pan ngo mtshar can thogs pa dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma cod pan ngo mtshar can thogs pa dang*/ khro bo mi g.yo ba pus btsugs gser gyi mche ba can/ rten 'brel zab mo la dbang bsgyur ba dang*/ dngul gyi thub pa chen po'i sku na bza' dang mchod par ldan pa dang*/ byang chub kyi shing gi 'jig rten dbang phyug cod pan can dang*/ gser gyi 'jig rten dbang phyug cod pan can dang*/ dngul gyi jo bo thugs rje chen po cod pan can dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' cod pan can dang*/ rje btsun byams mgon ngo mtshar can gos chen gyi gdan dang*/ gdugs dang*/ cod pan gyis brgyan pa dang*/ mchod pa dang na bza' du mas mchod pa dang*/ mnga' bdag mai tri pa'i thugs dam rje btsun ma zhal gnyis ma zangs la bzhengs pa'i byin rlabs can/ mchod pa dang na bza' du ma dang bcas pa dang*/ dpal nā ro pa'i thugs dam bhe ra pa mchod pa dang na bzar bcas pa dang*/ dar gyi rje btsun ma lha btsun ma gser gyis bzhengs pa thugs dam byin rlabs dang*/ rgya nag gi btags sku dkyil 'khor gnyis dang*/ zhabs su dpal nag po chen po nā len+d+ra'i bkod pa dang*/

tshogs bdag dang*/ 'dzam bha la la sogs pa'i lha mang po na bza' dang*/ mchod pa thams cad kyi mchod pa bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dpal ldan nā ro pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang dril bu cod pan dang na bzar ldan pa dang*/ bram ze rin chen rdo rje'i phyag mtshan lcags kyi rdo rje cod pan dang na bzar ldan pa dang*/ mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam po'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dar dpyangs na bzar ldan pa dang*/ jo bo chen po rje'i phyag mtshan mkhar ba'i rdo rje dar dpyangs dang na bzar ldan pa dang*/ dpal rga lo'i tshangs skud na bza' dang mchod par ldan pa dang*/ dpal chen rga lo'i phyag mtshan ḍā ma ru rgya gar nas bsnams pa dar dpyangs sna tshogs pa dang*/ g.yas phyogs na mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin par gsungs pa'i bka' dang bstan bcos kyi bstod pa'i tshogs gser gyis bzhengs pa/ na bza' dang mchod par ldan pa dang*/ g.yon phyogs nas gsang sngags kyi rgyud dang bstan bcos kyi bstod pa gser gyis bzhengs pa'i tshogs na bza' dang mchod par ldan pa dang*/ thugs dam rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud na bza' sna tshogs dang mchod par ldan pa dang*/ ka ba'i mdun phyi pad+ma sna tshogs 'dab brgyad la/ steng chos 'byung nyis rtsegs rten 'brel can/ cung zad 'gul ba'am ldeg par yang mi btub pa mchod pa dang sman gyis bsgos pa na bza' rim pa du ma dang ldan pa bzhugs so// //yang chos rje rin po che gser gyis bzhengs pa'i rgyud 'bum/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgyud sha stag bcu gnyis dum gos chen gyi na bza' du ma gsar pa spos dang dri'i phur ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gser gyi mdo mangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi dum gos chen gyi na bza' gsar pa spos dang dri'i phur ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gser gyi glegs bam ngo mtshar ba re re nas smos kyis mi lang bas/ brgya lhag gos chen gyi na bza' gsar pa spos dang dri'i phur ma dang bcas pa dang*/ gser gyi mdo bran gzhan dang*/

gser gyi 'phags pa sdud pa dang*/ mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i pod phran re re nas smos kyis mi lang ba gsum stong lhag /gser dngul gyi rten 'brel gyis dbu zhabs su phyag rgyas btab pa/ rab gnas su mdzad pa/ na bza' dang glegs thag rnying pa thams cad brjes nas thams cad gsar pa byas pa'i gos chen dang dar gyis spras pa/ spos dang sman gyi phur ma dang bcas pa bzhugs pa dang*/ yang re re nas smos kyis mi lang ba'i rgya gar gyi bka'i po ti mang po na bza' dang mchod pa'i phur ma dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bar bar du re re nas smos kyis mi lang bas/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig dang*/ mu men la sogs pa rin po che sna tshogs pa'i phur ma rnams dang*/ tsan dan go shir+ṣa dang*/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po la sogs pa'i dri'i phye ma'i phur ma rnams dang*/ a ru ra la sogs pa 'bras bu bzang po thams cad gur kum nas ston pa rnam pa mang po'i phur ma rnams dang*/ chab tsha zi po lo la sogs pa dngos po bzang po rnams kyi phur ma rnams dang*/ nas dang 'bras la sogs pa'i 'bru gur kum nas bton pa'i phur ma rnams dang*/ maṇ+ḍal dang*/ ting dang*/ phor pa la sogs pa dngos po bzang po'i mchod pa'i phur mas bkang ba rnams kyis gang bar brdzangs nas bzhugs so// //de'i phyi rol du bzhugs pa'i lha'i bang rim rnams kyi lha zhabs sdom du nyan tshad rnams/ re re'i nang na/ rin po che dang*/ zab chen gyi pho brang gsum gsum du byas pa'i nang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel mdo'i ri bo ma/ mang po mang po zab chen la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje mar pa'i gdung zab chen la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i gdung zab chen la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i gdung dang*/ dbu skra dang*/ thugs dam zab chen la bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ gzungs tshad med pa dar chen la dri bzang pos bris pa dpag tu med pa dang*/ spos dang*/ sman dang*/ rin po che bsam gyis mi khyab pas mchod nas/
