zab chen dang dar gyi na bza' byas te/ re re'i nang na yang de rnams thams cad re re 'dra bar snyoms par byas nas bzhugs pa la/ khyad par du rje phag mo gru pa'i sku/ sku sham gyi sne mo la ka yod pa'i nang du rje phag mo gru pa nyid kyi tshems gcig dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ kha yod pa'i nang du tshems dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ nga yod pa'i nang la gser gyi rdo rje'i lte bar ring srel gcig dzhai k+ṣim 'bras bu can la bzhugs pa dang*/ rje sgam po pa'i sku'i nang na rje sgam po pa nyid kyi tshems mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa dang*/ rje lho brag pa'i sku'i nang du thugs dam he badz+ra zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i ngo mtshar ba bzhugs pa dang*/ jo bo chen po'i sku'i nang na/ jo bo nyid kyi rgyan drug ngo mtshar can mchod pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa dang*/ slob dpon pad+ma saṃ bha ba'i thugs ka na/ slob dpon nyid kyi rten bzhugs pa la sogs pa khyad par 'ga' zhig yod pa rnams kyang 'dir brjod par mi nus so// //'di rnams ni che long tsam yin pas/ rten phran tshegs rnams dang*/ dngos po khyad par can gzhan rnams dang*/ mchod pa'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas bgrang bar mi nus te/ spyir 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyi phyag tu rten ngo mtshar can che rim du byon pa la/ byang chub kyi shing 'dom gang ba gcig dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs rjes dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhabs rjes dang*/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i lhung bzed dang*/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i thugs dam dgyes mdzad lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor rje mar pa la gnang ba dang*/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can rje mar pa la gnang ba rnams ni gdan sa phag mo grur bzhugs su gsol/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i phyag skyogs dang*/ dpal ldan nā ro pa'i thugs dam rje btsun ma la sogs pa'i sku 'ga' zhig dang*/

byang chub kyi shing gi lha dpag tu med pa dang*/ slob dpon rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi'i thugs dam dang*/ rje phag mo gru pa'i dbu zhu dang*/ chags dang gdan la sogs pa dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma gzhan rnams kyi rten ngo mtshar can rnams ni bu slob chen po rnams la gnang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems dang*/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu'i gdung la sogs pa phyag tu byon pa mang po ni/ yul so so na yod pa'i 'gro don can la dgongs nas/ yul so sor bzhugs su gsol/ de ma gtogs pa dus der phyag tu bzhugs tshad la/ tshogs kyi ma hā bo dhi dang*/ thugs dam dngul sku dang*/ dge bshes sha ra ba ba'i tshogs dung dang*/ rngog lo tsā ba chen po'i gsol zhal dang*/ mnga' bdag ral pa can gyi bsang sder dang*/ bse dang*/ srong btsan sgam po'i rdo rje gnyis pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad bkra shis sgo mang du bzhugs nas/ rab tu gnas pa khyad par can mdzad de/ 'dzam bu gling 'di na rten ngo mtshar ba dang*/ byin rlabs 'di las che ba med pas/ thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang 'di la gsol ba btab na/ sgom rgyud la skye ba yin zhes/ rgyu mtshan mang po'i bka' rtsal rgya cher gsungs pas/ dus rgyun chad med par rten khyad par du 'phags pa 'di la/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gsol ba btab pa la brtson par bya'o// //'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin po che// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i yon tan gyis// bde legs 'byor pa kun la dbang skur ba// 'bri gung 'gro mgon byon pa ngo mtshar che// mgon po de yi thugs dgongs snying pos bsgrubs// 'dzam gling 'dir dkon sangs rgyas dngos lta bur// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan kun bskyed pa// thugs dam bkra shis sgo mang ngo mtshar che// gang gis dgos 'dod kun 'byung mchod sdong la// mchod bstod gus pas gsol ba sus 'debs pa// don mchog yid bzhin nor 'dra rnyed pa yi// skal ldan dad pa'i skyes bu ngo mtshar che// 'di ni thos pa kun kyang don ldan na// mthong ba don rnyed ngan 'gro med pa yin// gus pas dran pa bde ba thob pa'i mchog

/rtag tu mchod pa mthar phyin sa la gnas// phyi yi bzhugs tshul lha yi rnam grangs rnams// sgo mang dkar chag gong ma dag la bzhugs// nang gi bzhugs tshul cung zad smos pa 'di// rgyal sras shes rab 'byung gnas bdag gis bris// //'dis mtshon dge bas rtsa ba dri med pa// 'khor 'das kun gyis bsags dang yod pa yis// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i sems can rnams// myur du bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /thugs dam dpal bkra shis sgo mang gi nang rdzongs kyi dkar chag bsdus pa/ rin po che chen po spungs pa'i phung po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /

10) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag dang lo rgyus// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa 'gro ba'i bla ma dpal ldan rin po che 'bri gung na bzhugs pa'i chos kyi rgyal po skyob pa bla na med pa chen po de/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par byang chub pa'i phyir ye shes dpag par dka' ba zab pa dang rnam par grol ba kun tu khyab pa'i bdag nyid 'od gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla na med pa rdo rje'i thugs/ tshogs rgya chen po zad mi shes pa'i rgya mtsho las byung ba chos dbyings zhing khams thams cad du ma khyab pa med pa de nyid la snang bar mdzad pa/ bral 'bras rnam smin mtshan dpe thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od kyi tshogs bkod pas spras shing rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs pa'i dpung gis rnam par mdzes pa rdo rje'i sku/ chos kyi sgo thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ theg pa sna tshogs pa'i dbye bas the tshom gcod pa/ seṅge'i nga ro dbyangs kyi yan lag drug cus brgyan pa/ ka la ping ka'i gdangs sam tshangs pa'i gsung ltar snyan cing dang la 'jam pa'i sgras 'jig rten gyi khams phyogs bcu kun tu mtha' med cing gsal bar chos kyi rnam grangs mtha' yas pa ston par byed pa rdo rje'i gsung*/ mkhyen pa'i stobs gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang dbang po dang khams dang mos pa kun tu 'gro ba'i lam dang*/ bsam gtan la sogs pa bcu dang 'khrul ba med pa dang ca co med pa la sogs pa ma 'dres pa'i chos rnams dang*/ zag pa med pa'i yon tan 'jigs pa med pa gzungs kyi sgo cho 'phrul dang rnam 'phrul ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa la sogs pa yon tan gyi tshogs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dgongs pa thabs tshul dpag tu med pa'i sgo/ bslab pa rnam pa gsum gyi lam byang chub kyi phyogs/ chos kyi dbye ba thams cad kyang*/

'gro ba'i zhing sa mtho dman thams cad la blo'i 'jug pa dang bstun pa'i dge ba'i sa bon rim pa dag gis lam rim gyis sbyar te/ don gyi snying po byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi'i rtsa ba dang*/ sdong bu dang*/ 'dab ma rgyas par mdzad nas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi 'bras bu bskrun pas/ bde ba dge ba'i bsil gyis rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub par byed pa/ mdor bsdus na sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi tshogs rgyun chad med pa'i gter lam gsum gnas pa rnams kyis kyang phyogs dang mthun pa las dpag par mi spyod na/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis lta ci smos te/ khams gsum gyi ded dpon 'gro ba'i skyabs/ dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bar byed pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu'i bla ma rin po che la bdag cag thams cad lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing nges par skyabs su mchi'o// //gzhan yang yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed pa dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yi dam gyi lha tshogs dang*/ dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bdud rtsi dri ma dang bral ba dam pa'i chos rin po che dang*/ gang gis nyams su len par byed pa 'dus pa dge 'dun gyi tshogs la nges par skyabs su 'gro zhing phyag 'tshal te/ bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po bar chad sel zhing mthun rkyen sgrub par byed pa thams cad kyi mtshan gang gis thos pa'am/ dran pa tsam gyis kyang lam rgyud la skyed par byed pa/ yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir mtshan gyi rnam grangs 'dir rgyas par brjod par bya'o// //de la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag po/

dbang gi rgyal po bla ma rin po che dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes can/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi gtso bo/ mkha' 'gro thams cad kyi dbang phyug zhing khams thams cad kyi ston pa/ yon tan rin po che ma lus pa'i gter/ lus can thams cad kyi yab/ skyob pa mtshungs pa med pa/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan rin po che des/ sngon rgyu dge tshogs mtha' yas pa spyad pa las 'khrungs shing 'bras bu dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi 'byung gnas/ sku sna tshogs pa dang gsung mtha' yas pa dang*/ thugs ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhun gyis grub pa dang rgyun chad pa med pa'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs mod kyang*/ thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas snyigs ma dang ldan pas zhing 'dir/ rnam par 'phrul pa du ma'i sgo nas mdzad pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab cing*/ khyad par du thub pa chen po'i bstan pa lnga brgya phrag bcu las/ lhag mthong mngon du byed pa'i dus 'dir/ bdag cag tshu rol mthong ba'i bsod nams kyi 'jug pa dang sgo bstun nas thog mar shar phyogs 'bri klung chos kyi zhing khams su/ lum+bi ni'i nags tshal ltar sku bltams zhing yon tan rin po che'i mdzod phye/ lho phyogs zla sngon dpal gyi klung mo cher byin rlabs dang nus pa'i sgo nas nai rañja na'i 'gram ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsed mo dpag tu med pa mdzad/ dbus ngam shod dpal gyi phag mo grur ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i ye shes me long gi dkyil 'khor lta bu la 'og min gyi gnas ltar/ dus gsum gyi shes bya ji snyed pa mngon du brnyes/ nub e chung rdo rje'i brag phug tu byang chub kyi snying po ltar bdud kyi phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rol pa bstan/ byang dri za'i rgyal po'i gnas su/ stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mchod pa'i sprin phung bzhes/

bkod pa 'gran zla dang bral ba rgyal ba'i spyod yul gnas 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du wā rā ṇa sī ltar bdud rtsi dri ma dang bral ba dam pa'i chos rin po che'i 'khor lo/ bsdu ba'i dngos po thams cad kyis yongs su bsdus shing lus can ma lus pa bla na med pa'i khang bzang du khrid nas gnas skabs kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can/ phrin las rgya che bar mdzad pa nges don mngon du bstan pa'i phyir/ chos rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid/ ma lus pa bla na med pa'i khang bzang du khrid nas gnas skabs kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can/ phrin las rgya che bar mdzad pa nges don mngon du bstan pa'i phyir/ chos rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid/ bdag cag spyi mthun gyi bsod nams sprin gyi phung po lta bus bsgribs par gyur pa'i tshe/ spyan snga nyid kyi mdzad pa'i sgo/ shing rta chen po'i srol dang 'dra ba la bzhugs nas/ rigs las skyes pa rnams kyi mos gus kyi snang ba 'phrin las tha mi dad cing bsod nams bsags pa'i rten mchog tu gyur pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi mgon dang*/ skyabs dang gnas dang dpung gnyen du gyur cing*/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che ltar bzhugs pa rgyu rin po che rmad du byung ba las grub cing spyan snga nyid dang dbye ba med pa'i gdung rten chen po/ de nyid las mi zhan pa'i bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgo khyud dang rtsig pa dang*/ pan tsa ra ga dang*/ chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs kyis phug pa dang*/ ri dwags dar dpyangs kyis mdzes par byas pa dang*/ dar dpyangs chen po 'phan rings kyis legs par brgyan pa dang*/ rigs kyi phyag mtshan tha dad pas rnam par phye ba dang*/ sdong bu yal ga lo 'dab dang me tog snying po dang 'bras bu'i tshogs rnam par bkra ba dang*/

chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po phrin las rnam pa bzhis 'gro ba thams cad smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba'i rten khyad par can gcig bla ma rin po che'i sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya ba'i ched du/ phyogs bcu'i zhing nas lhags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu rnams kyi 'bad pa dang rtsol ba/ dad pa dang 'dun pa/ dga' ba dang rgyu rkyen/ mdor na mos gus kyi shugs mi phyed pa'i stobs bskyed du med pas gzhi gzung*/ phyogs gcig pa nyi tshe ba'i spyod pa lhur len cing rgyu rkyen chen po dang ldan pa/ mnyam pa nyid kyi kun tu spyod pa la gnas pa snying po'i sras dpon sgom pa dang*/ khur chen po bsnams shing mtho dman thams cad la thugs brtse bas don chen po bsgrub par byed pa sgom pa byang chub sku 'khor dang bcas pas bdag mdzad/ che ba'i yon tan tshad bzung med pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i sras/ mnyes pa'i sgo mtha' yas pas mnyes par mdzad pa yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug zhal rnam pa bdun la sogs pa bdag cag bla ma dam pa'i nye gnas sku gsung thugs kyi sras su gyur pa rnams kyi 'bad pa dang go cha/ bzod pa dang brtul zhugs le los dben zhing brtson 'grus kyis stobs mgo la me shor ba gsod pa'am/ pang du sbrul zhugs pa skyur ba'am/ gzhu bdungs pa'am/ khab mig tu skud pa 'dzud pa ltar mos gus kyi mthu chen pos legs par bsgrubs pa'i dpal bkra shis sgo mang zhes yongs su grags pa/ rgyu rin po che gser sa le sbram dang*/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ zangs dang*/ rin po che rdo rje pha lam dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya dang*/ shel dang*/ shel 'be dul dang*/ me shel dang*/ mu tig dang*/

mu men dang*/ mu sa ra ga dang*/ pad+ma ra ga dang*/ so'u ghan+dhe margad dang*/ ju ne dang*/ g.yu dang*/ byi ru dang*/ dung dang*/ sbur sdud la sogs pa rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs pa las grub pa/ rgyar mtho lnga bcu rtsa lnga yod pa/ mtho dman gyi dpangs su mtho bdun cu tham pa yod pa/ nang gi khog pa yang rin po che las grub pa/ bar gyi ling tshe mnyam zhing 'tsham pa/ tshad phun sum tshogs pa/ phyi gzhal yas kyi khang mdzes pa/ 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ dper na dwang ba'i mtsho chen po dang 'dra ba'i phyogs bzhir pad+ma'i sdong po chen po bskrun pa las phyogs bcu kun tu pad+ma chen po'i 'dab mas khebs pa/ lo 'bras kyi tshogs kyi g.yur za bas spud pa/ yal ga kun tu gyes pa'i 'khyil rnams la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol mchod pa'i lha mo rnams dang*/ pad+ma dang bum pa bzang po dpag bsam gyi shing rigs rnam pa lngas btab pa'i ka ba rnams dang*/ de'i phyi rol khro bo'i rgyal po rnam par 'khrugs shing rngams pa sgo srung ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i sprin phung gi mchod pa'i bkod pas mchod pa lha phrug nam mkha' lding zhes grags pa dang*/ phyi nang du rim pa lnga'i rang bzhin du gnas pa'i dbus nas 'od kyi tshogs rnam par bkram pa'i tshul du rgyab yol chen mo 'ja' 'od kyi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba 'od 'bar ba me ri'i dra ba dang bcas pa las/ dbus rdo rje rin po che'i pad+ma'i sdong po chen po la lha bzhugs pa'i bang rim drug de'i steng du ut+pa la rgyas pa dang*/ gser gyi pad+ma chen po 'dab ma lnga bcu pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ gong du smos pa'i chos rje rin po che'i gdung rten bzhugs pa de ni rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa/ byin gyis brlabs las byung zhing chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo bo/ tshogs chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi dad pa'i snang ba/

dge ba'i sa bon 'debs pa'i zhing sa bla na med pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bzhugs gnas dri ma med pa'i pho brang*/ 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser g.ya' dang bral ba'i kha dog can/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar 'od kyi dra bas phyogs kun gsal bar byed pa/ mtshan mo ri bo'i spo la me 'bar ba ltar ma 'dres la yongs su rdzogs pa/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya rgyas pa ltar mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ lhun po'i rgyal po ltar blta bas chog mi shes pa de'i nyi zla'i dbus na/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang chos rje de nyid kyi mtshan gyi rnam grangs las mi zhan cing nyid kyi 'phrul bar bstan pa'i phyir chos rje rin po che'i sku/ mtshan dpe thams cad kyis spras shing rgyan rnam pa bzhi dang ldan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dpal/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi yon tan ma lus pa bskyed par mdzad pa'i gter chen por gyur pa de nyid bzhugs so// gdung rten gyi bum pa'i thad ka rgyab yol gyi logs bstan pa'i rten 'brel 'od bkram pa'i nang g.yas logs na/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig dang*/ dbang po'i tog dang*/ don thams cad grub pa dang*/ mar me mdzad la sogs pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang chos rje nyid las mi gzhan pa'i phyir/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i sku ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba bzhugs/ de bzhin du bum pa'i thad ka 'od bkram pa'i nang g.yon logs na ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig byon pa de thams cad kyang 'gro ba'i bla ma de nyid 'byon par bstan pa'i phyir/ bla ma rin po che'i sku rgyu sna tshogs las grub pa gcig bzhugs so// //gdung rten gyi dbu rgyab yol gyi rtse/ steng gi drang thad kyi nam mkha' la gser gdugs dge ba 'khyil ba zhes bya ba rgyar mtho bzhi bcu zhe brgyad yod pa/ mar gyi sham bu phyi nang rim pa gnyis su gnas pa las/

nang gi sham bu la rin po che'i sbu gu'i 'khyil pad+ma'i snying po rnams la lha bzhugs pa sum cu rtsa gnyis/ gzhan thams cad kyang bzo'i rgyu ngo mtshar bas spras pa sum cu rtsa gnyis dang drug cu rtsa bzhi 'phyang*/ phyi'i sham bu rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rigs/ pa tra'i bzo rgyud legs par sbyangs pa rnams kyis yid 'dzin par byed cing*/ lta bas mi ngoms pa drug cu rtsa bzhi ste spyir rin po che'i chun 'phyang che chung spel ma brgya nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnam par 'phyang ba/ yar gyi rin po che'i ze'u hrog lha bzhugs pa bcu gnyis/ gzhan rin po che'i 'bar 'od la sogs pa'i rin po che'i hrog che chung lnga bcu rtsa gnyis te drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa/ mar gyi sham dang mar gyi hrog gnyis kyi bar du rdo rje gdung rgyud kyi phreng bas rnam par 'khor ba/ 'gyogs kyi mtha' bskor du mtho bco brgyad yod pa/ kun tu 'khyil ba legs par phub pa las bcom ldan 'das lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa rgyas par bzhugs pa ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ gnas la sogs pas bcu'i bdag nyid dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams kyis yongs su bltams pa'i zhing*/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ 'khor lo lnga'i bdag nyid/ he ru ka'i grong khyer chen po/ bla na med pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ de ni gzhi rdo rje rgya gram la gnas pa'i mthar me 'od kyi ra ba dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rdo rje'i phreng ba dang dur khrod brgyad kyis rnam par bskor ba/ chos kyi 'khor lo ri dwags kyis mdzes pa/ gdugs kyi phub dang*/ rta babs rim pa rnam pa bzhi dang*/ dar bu kad dang*/ ba so bum pa dang*/ dra ba phyed pa dang*/ rin chen pha gu dang*/ 'dod yon snam bu lha mos rnam par spras pa dang*/ pañca ra ga'i rtsig pa dang*/ phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa/ bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa gru bzhi pa ste/

mtshan nyid thams cad kyis legs par brgyan pa'i ngo bo gzhal yas khang chen po de'i dbus/ rnam pa 'gyogs kyi lte ba la bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang gnyis su med pa lha chen po yab yum gyi gdan la dgyes pa'i gar gyi rol pa bzhugs so// pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad las shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhir mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir rigs kyi yum bzhi sbas pa'i tshul du byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa bzhi/ mu khyud gri gug gi phreng ba dang ldan pa'i bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i phyi rol thugs gsung sku'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum las 'khor lo re re la lha bzhugs pa'i gnas rtsibs brgyad brgyad/ rtsibs re re la dpa' bo khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rab tu gtum mo la sogs pa yab yum zung re ste/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi mu khyud rdo rje dang pad+ma dang 'khor lo'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bzhugs/ de'i phyi rol gdugs kyi phibs dam tshig gi 'khor lo la kā ka s+ye la sogs pa sgo mtshams ma brgyad bzhugs te/ de dag ni pho brang nang gi rnam grangs so// gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa ngos re la bcu gnyis bcu gnyis te bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bzhugs/ de'i phyi rol gdugs kyi mtha' bskor la nye ba na dur khrod chen po brgyad la/ shar la sogs pa phyogs mtshams rnams su rim pa bzhin du/ slob dpon pad+ma badz+ra dang*/ slob dpon 'phags pa dang*/ slob dpon rgyal po dang*/ slob dpon lu hi pa dang*/ slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi ba dang*/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu dang*/ slob dpon ku ku ri pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po ste rnal 'byor pa brgyad bzhugs/ yang slob dpon nag po spyod pa ba dang*/ slob dpon klu'i byang chub dang*/

slob dpon la wa pa dang*/ slob dpon nā ro pa dang*/ slob dpon bir+wa pa dang*/ slob dpon zhi ba lha dang*/ slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang*/ slob dpon sha wa ri pa ste/ spyir rnal 'byor pa bcu drug bzhugs/ gzhan yang brgya byin la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba brgyad dang*/ glang po'i gdong la sogs pa zhing skyong brgyad dang*/ nor rgyas la sogs pa klu brgyad dang*/ byang chub kyi shing brgyad dang*/ chu bo brgyad dang*/ sprin brgyad dang*/ me brgyad dang*/ mchod rten brgyad dang*/ dbugs dang bral ba'i dngos po la longs spyod pa la sogs pa dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis kun tu mdzes pa rgyas par bskor nas bzhugs te/ de dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs dang mthu+un pa las/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu gang du bstan pas shes so// yar gyi hrog 'ga' zhig la rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku bcu gnyis bzhugs/ mar gyi nang gi sham bu la/ nub gzims spyil gyi phyogs na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po la slob dpon til+li pa dang*/ dpal ldan nā ro pa gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ byang brag gi phyogs na chos rje rin po che la rje sgam po pa dang rje phag mo gru pa gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ shar bla dbye'i phyogs na bstan pa'i bdag po la jo bo chen po rje lha gcig dang*/ slob dpon thogs med gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ lho sgo'i phyogs su rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la slob dpon zhi ba lha dang slob dpon ye shes zhabs kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ nub byang la sogs pa mtshams rnams su rim pa bzhin du/ rje btsun mar pa dang*/ rje btsun mi la dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma dang*/ rje btsun kha sar+pa ṇi bzhugs/ byang shar nas bzung ste g.yon bskor du phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bcu drug bzhugs te/ de dag ni gling bzhi'i phyogs dang mthun pa las/ thugs dam snga ma la sogs pa ni gral gyi rim pa la/

dpal rdo rje 'chang nas bzung nas nub dang por smos pa'o// de ltar na dkyil 'khor gyi shar dang sgo mang gi shar gnyis ni mthun la/ gling bzhi'i shar dang g.yas bskor phyogs gcig gis mi mthun no// de ltar pho brang nang na lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ phyi rol na lha brgyad cu rtsa brgyad/ sham bu rnams la lha sum cu rtsa gnyis/ hrog rnams la lha bcu gnyis te/ spyir lha brgya dang dgu bcu rtsa bzhi bzhugs te/ bar skabs su steng gi rnam grangs brjod pa'o// //lha bzhugs pa'i bang rim gong ma'i shar phyogs kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po bzhugs/ de'i g.yas g.yon na chos rje rin po che'i sku rigs rnam pa lnga rdo rje 'chang chen po dang bcas pa'am/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug dbye ba med pas bsdus pa'i sku drug bzhugs pa la/ stobs bcu mtshon pa'i phyir glang po che myos pa stobs kyi rtsal zhes bya ba dang*/ glang po che'i rgyal po 'byor ba'i yan lag zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ snying rje chen po mtshon pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i ri dwags sha ra bhi'i gzugs 'dzin pa gnyis dang*/ ma 'dres pa'i chos rnams mtshon pa'i phyir klu'i rgyal po brtse med 'bar ba dang*/ klu'i rgyal po gtum po rab 'jigs gnyis/ klu'i srin po'i lus su sprul pa gnyis dang*/ sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa la bsrung ba med pa gsum mtshon pa'i phyir nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po steng na rtse ba ste rgyan sna bzhi bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang chags pa med pa'i phyir gdan pad+ma dang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i phyir/ nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ sku la 'od kyi dra ba 'phros pas phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i tshul du 'ja' 'od kyi phreng bas bskor ba rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes pa bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon chen po til+li pa bzhugs/

de'i g.yas na rje btsun chen po mar pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na jo bo chen po lha gcig bzhugs/ bcom ldan 'das lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yon na rje btsun chen po nā ro pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rje btsun chen po mi la rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rje btsun sgam po pa chen po bzhugs/ de nas nub phyogs kyi dbus na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi yum lha lcam legs smin dang gnyis su med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na gcan gzan khro bo'i steng na slob dpon ḍoṃ bi he ru ka bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub mi zad gter la slob dpon ār+ya de ba dang slob dpon klu'i byang chub gnyis kyis bskor ba bzhugs/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yon na/ slob dpon chen po bram ze chen po la yum khaṇ+ḍa ro he gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na slob dpon ku ku ri pa yum ku ku ri la rol pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na slob dpon lu hi pa bzhugs// //de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus su bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na nus pa bsnyems pa'i slob dpon bir+wa pa mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rgyal po'i chad pa las grol ba'i slob dpon rdo rje dril bu pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na srin po'i kha gnon mdzad pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bzhugs/ dpal lhan cig skyes pa'i g.yon na rgyal po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes pa slob dpon dza lan dha ri ka yum rje btsun ma dang gnyis su med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rje yum pad+ma ni dang gnyis su med pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na mkhan po bo dhi satwa bzhugs/ de ltar bla ma brgyud pa'i bang rim gyi zur chen brgyad dang bcu gnyis su/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor las byon pa ltar mdun gyi nam mkha'i phyogs su/

dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku bcu gnyis bzhugs so// spyir bang rim gong ma la lha lnga bcu rtsa gsum bzhugs te rnam grangs dang po'o// //de nas yang bang rim gnyis pa'i shar phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum reg bya rdo rje ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ steng gi khro bo gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur ba dang*/ 'og gi khro bo gnod mdzes dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor brgyad rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad zhal gsum phyag drug pa la/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed dang*/ khro bo mi g.yo bas bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan zhal gsum phyag drug pa la lha mo ma mā ki dang mchod pa'i lha mo sgra rdo rje ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ khro bo rgyal po gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang*/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs// gtso bo'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas zhal gsum phyag drug pa la lha mo gos dkar mo dang mchod pa'i lha mo dri rdo rje ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dbang po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dbyangs dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dang*/ khro bo dbyug pa sngon pos bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das don yon grub pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa la/

lha mo sgrol ma dang mchod pa'i lha mo ro rdo rje ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang*/ khro bo stobs po ches bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa bzhugs te/ spyir lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi yod pa las phyag dang po gnyis na rdo rje dang ril ba bring ka ra ba bsnams pa/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis rin po che'i pad+ma rnam par 'degs pa bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rin po che'i phreng ba thogs pa bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ shar lho'i zur la jo bo thugs rje chen po yi ge drug pa la sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ yum yig drug rig ma dang gnyis kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor gsum bzhugs/ spyir shar gyi ngos la lha dgu bcu rtsa gcig bzhugs so// //de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu yum 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ sras mchog badz+ra kī la ya dang*/ khro bo chen po hūṃ kā ra dang*/ yum rdo rje sgra 'byin ma dang*/ khro bo chen po rnam rgyal dang*/ yum rdo rje snyegs ma dang*/ khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po dang*/ yum rdo rje sder ma dang*/ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed dang*/ yum rdo rje dur khrod bdag mo dang*/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba dang*/ yum rdo rje gtun khung ma dang*/

khro bo chen po rta mgrin dang*/ yum rdo rje gtum mo dang*/ khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang*/ yum rdo rje rab bsnyems ma dang*/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang*/ yum rdo rje rlung 'dzin ma dang*/ khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ yum rdo rje gsod ma dang*/ khro bo stobs po che dang*/ yum rdo rje bskyod ma dang gnyis su med pas bskor ba lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum sna tshogs sde ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa dang*/ lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ lha mo mā ma kī dang*/ lha mo gos dkar mo dang*/ lha mo sgrol ma ste/ brgyad kyis bskor ba lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po zhal gsum phyag drug pa la yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma dang bcas pa la yab khro bo bdud las rgyal byed dang*/ yum lha mo 'od zer can dang*/ khro bo gzi brjid 'bar ba dang*/ lha mo mdangs ldan ma dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rngam pa'i sgra sgrog dang*/ yum sgra gcan ma dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ yum rlung 'byin ma dang*/ sgo ba rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ sgo ba rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ sgo ba rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ sgo ba rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba dang bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba lha bcu bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de nas g.yon phyogs na bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum ro langs khro mo dang gnyis su med pa la/ bcom ldan 'das zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dang*/ 'dod chags gshin rje gshed dang*/

nga rgyal gshin rje gshed dang*/ phrag dog gshin rje gshed dang*/ yum phag mo dang*/ dbyangs can ma dang*/ ke'u ri ma dang*/ tsa rtsi ka dang brgyad kyis bskor ba lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das dpal 'jigs byed chen po zhal dgu phyag sum bcu rtsa bzhi pa rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa gti mug dag pa'i phyir rtsa zhal phyugs kyi gdong pa can/ zhe sdang dag pa'i phyir phyag rnams su mtshon cha sna tshogs/ 'dod chags dag pa'i phyir gsang ba chen po nam mkhar bzhengs pa ste/ rngam pa'i cha byad can dpa' bo'i thugs dam bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ lho nub kyi zur la/ jo bo thugs rje chen po yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ khro bo kri ta mgrin sngon dang*/ ha ya gṛ ba dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*/ lha mo khro gnyer can dang bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ spyir lho ngos na lha brgyad cu tham pa bzhugs so// //de nas nub phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dgyes mdzad rdo rje zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ yum bdag med rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ gau ri ma dang*/ tsau ri ma dang*/ bai ta lī dang*/ puk+ka sī dang*/ ghasma rī dang*/ sha ba rī dang*/ tsan dha lī dang*/ g.yung mo dang*/ ḍoṃ bhi ni dang brgyad kyis bskor ba phyag mtshan gyi lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa/ lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das ma hā ma ya zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa rigs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang gnyis su med pa la/

rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma dang bzhis bskor ba lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ dum skyes ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang bzhis bskor ba lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ gtso bo'i g.yon na dpal lha mo gdan bzhi ye shes dbang phyug ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma la rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dang*/ stag gi gdong can ma dang*/ khra'i gdong can ma dang*/ lce spyang gi gdong can ma dang*/ chu'i mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ dbang phyug ma dang*/ drag mo dang bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba lha bcu gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la/ gshin rje ma dang*/ rmongs byed ma dang*/ sreg byed ma dang*/ skrod byed ma dang*/ gtum mo dang*/ tsan+ḍi ka dang drug gis bskor ba lha bdun gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ ka pa la bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs// zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ nub byang gi zur la jo bo thugs rje chen po a mo gha pā sha la/ rje btsun don yod zhags pa dang*/ lha mo e ka dza ti dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dang*/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma dang bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/

spyir nub kyi ngos na lha bdun cu rtsa gcig bzhugs so// de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ snying po'i yum mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ lā ma dang*/ dum skyes ma dang*/ gzugs can ma dang bzhi/ sbas pa'i rang bzhin ka pā las mtshan pa bzhi ste/ gri gug gi phreng bas yongs su bskor ba bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i phyi rim 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnam pa brgyad la/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rab gtum ma dang*/ dpa' bo keng rus chen po dang*/ rnal 'byor ma gtum pa'i mig can ma dang*/ dpa' bo keng rus dang*/ rnal 'byor ma 'od ldan ma dang*/ dpa' bo mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma sna chen ma dang*/ dpa' bo su ra bai ri dang*/ rnal 'byor ma brtan pa'i blo can ma dang*/ dpa' bo 'od dpag med dang*/ rnal 'byor ma mi'u thung ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje 'od dang*/ rnal 'byor ma lang ka'i dbang phyug ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje'i sku dang*/ rnal 'byor ma shing grib ma ste rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba thugs kyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i phyi rim gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnam pa brgyad la/ dpa' bo myu gu can dang*/ yum sa bsrung ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje ral pa dang*/ yum 'jigs byed chen mo dang*/ dpa' bo chen po dang*/ yum rlung gi shugs can ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dang*/ yum chang 'thung ma dang*/ dpa' bo rab tu bzang po dang*/ yum sngo bsangs ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje bzang po dang*/ yum shin tu bzang mo dang*/ dpa' bo 'jigs byed chen po dang*/ yum rta sna ma dang*/ dpa' bo mig mi bzang dang*/ yum bya'i gdong can ma ste pad+ma'i phreng bas bskor ba gsung gi 'khor lo bzhugs// de'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnam pa brgyad la dpa' bo stobs po che dang*/

mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo'i shugs can ma dang*/ dpa' bo chen po rdo rje ral pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dum skyes ma dang*/ dpa' bo rta mgrin dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma chang 'tshong ma dang*/ dpa' bo nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo'i go cha dang*/ dpa' bo he ru ka dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma shin tu dpa' mo dang*/ dpa' bo pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma stobs chen ma dang*/ dpa' bo rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma 'khor lo sgyur ma dang*/ dpa' bo rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma stobs chen ma ste/ 'khor lo'i phreng bas bskor ba sku'i 'khor lo bzhugs// de'i phyi rol du sgo ba khwa gdong ma dang*/ 'ug gdong ma dang*/ khyi gdong ma dang*/ phag gdong ma dang sgo ba rnam pa bzhi/ gshin rje brtan ma dang*/ bsreg ma dang*/ mche ba ma dang*/ 'joms ma ste mtshams ma bzhi dang brgyad/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo spyir 'khor lo rim pa lnga'i phyi rol tu/ dur khrod chen po drag tu gtum pa dang*/ tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dang*/ 'ur 'ur 'bar bas khyab pa dang*/ 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ ha ha rgod pa dang*/ nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ mun pa mi zad pa dang*/ ki li ki la sgrogs pa dang*/ dur khrod chen po brgyad du shi ra ṣa'i shing dang*/ a shwata tha dang*/ kang ka la dang*/ tsut+ta'i shing dang*/ n+ya gro dha dang*/ ka rañja dang*/ la tā dza ti dang*/ bar ti ba ste shing chen po brgyad kyi gseb na/ shing bdag zhing skyong chen po glang po'i gdong dang*/ ma he'i gdong can dang*/ ra'i mgo can dang*/ seṅge'i gdong can dang*/ phag gi gdong can dang*/ rta'i gdong can dang*/ bya'i gdong can dang*/ srin po'i gdong can ste/ mgo brnyan can lus phyed thon du gnas pa brgyad dang*/ dbang po dang*/ sbyin bdag dang*/ klu'i dbang po dang*/ ya ma dang*/ dbang ldan dang*/ byin za dang*/ srin po'i dbang po dang*/ rlung lha ste phyogs skyong ba chen po brgyad dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/

'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ hu lun ta dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ dung skyong ste klu chen po brgyad dang*/ sgra sgrogs pa dang*/ rmugs pa dang*/ mun pa can dang*/ kun tu 'khyil pa dang*/ 'khrigs pa dang*/ gang ba dang*/ 'bab pa dang*/ drag po sprin gyi bdag po ste sprin chen po brgyad dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rgyal po in+d+ra bo dhi dang*/ rnal 'byor pa ku ku ri pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa pad+ma badz+ra dang*/ rnal 'byor pa 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bram ze chen po dang*/ rnal 'byor pa ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka dang*/ rnal 'byor pa rdo rje dril bu pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa lu hi pa ste/ rnal 'byor pa chen po brgyad dang*/ ma hā bo dhi dang*/ cho 'phrul bstan pa dang*/ lha las babs pa dang*/ bkra shis rtsegs pa dang*/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ bdud 'dul chen po dang*/ gtsug phud bregs pa dang*/ sa 'dzin chos kyi 'khor lo dang brgyad de/ chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin mchod rten brgyad dang*/ 'bar bas mtshan pa'i me brgyad dang*/ thugs rje'i rang bzhin chu bo brgyad dang*/ dngos grub can gyi gter brgyad ste/ dur khrod kyi mtshan nyid thams cad kyis legs par brgyan pa/ pho brang nang na lha drug cu rtsa gnyis/ phyi rol na lha sum cu rtsa gnyis te spyir lha dgu bcu rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo shin tu rgyas par bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ byang shar gyi zur la jo bo thugs rje chen po zhal bcu gnyis pa la/

khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin dang*/ rje btsun sgrol mas bskor ba gtso 'khor gsum bzhugs/ spyir byang gi ngos na lha brgya dang bcu gsum bzhugs so// spyir bang rim gnyis pa la lha sum brgya lnga bcu rtsa dgu bzhugs te rnam grangs gnyis pa'o// //de nas bang rim gsum pa'i shar phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad kun tu zhal byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can bzhugs pa la/ 'jig rten na grags pa brgyan bzhis mdzes shing rigs kyi yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/ lha mo mā ma kī dang*/ lha mo gos dkar mo dang*/ dam tshig sgrol ma rnams sbas pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa la/ mchod pa'i lha mo rdo rje sgeg ma dang*/ phreng ba ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu gsum bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das mi bskyod pa la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ rdo rje rgyal po dang*/ rdo rje chags pa dang*/ rdo rje legs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang*/ mthong ba don yod dang*/ ngan song kun 'dren dang*/ mya ngan dang mun pa thams cad rab tu 'joms pa'i blo gros dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje rin chen dang*/ rdo rje gzi brjid dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang*/ rdo rje bzhad pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po dang*/ dpa' bar 'gro ba dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod dang*/ ye shes tog dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ gtso bo g.yon na bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas la/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje chos dang*/ rdo rje rnon po dang*/ rdo rje rgyud pa dang*/ rdo rje smra ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' 'od dpag med dang*/ zla ba can gyi 'od dang*/

bzang skyong dang*/ dra ba can gyi 'od dang*/ brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs// //de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das don yod grub pa la byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje las dang*/ rdo rje srung ba dang*/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ rdo rje zhi ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje snying po dang*/ spobs pa brtsegs pa dang*/ blo gros mi zad pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la lha bzhi bcu zhe dgu bzhugs so// //shar lho'i zur la khro bo'i rgyal po pus btsugs dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ spyir shar gyi ngos la lha drug cu rtsa bdun bzhugs so// //de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ dpal sangs rgyas bde skyong zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ yum sna tshogs rdo rje ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ rdo rje mche ba ma dang*/ rdo rje pho nya mo dang*/ rdo rje gdong mo dang*/ rdo rje grags chen ma dang*/ rdo rje gzigs ma dang*/ rdo rje lte ba ma dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs ma dang*/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma dang*/ lha mo 'dod can ma dang*/ lha mo rab bzang mo dang*/ lha mo mdog sngon ma dang*/ lha mo grags chen ma dang*/ lha mo chang 'tshong ma dang*/ lha mo 'byung po ma dang*/ lha mo bzhin bzang ma dang*/

lha mo nam mkha' 'gro ma ste bcu drug gis bskor ba lha bco brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs// //de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po rgyal ba sprul pa'i sku la/ 'khor rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po dang*/ khye'u mtha' yas dang*/ bu mo mtha' med pa dang bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par byed pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la/ mchod pa'i lha mo me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang brgyad kyis bskor ba lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ gtso bo'i g.yon na 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa sman pa'i rgyal po la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan med mchog dpal dang*/ mtshan legs par yongs grags dpal gyi rgyal po dang*/ chos grags rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang*/ sgra dbyangs rgyal po dang*/ mngon mkhyen rgyal po dang*/ gser bzang dri med dang drug gis bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal smra ba'i seṅge la/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa me tog yang dag par skyes pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang*/ lha'i bu dag pa dang*/ rnam par dag pa dang gnyis drug gis bskor ba gtso 'khor bdun bzhugs/ lho nub kyi zur la khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/

glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ spyir lho ngos na lha drug cu rtsa bzhi bzhugs so// //de nas nub phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ yon tan bral ba dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu rgyan sna bzhi la sogs pas brgyan pa la/ rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo so sor 'brang ma chen mo dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje mi pham ma dang*/ sdig pa thams cad spong ba dang*/ 'dul dka' ba dang*/ bdud thams cad 'joms ma dang*/ sgo mtha' yas pa dang*/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang*/ bskul byed ma dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' byams pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ kun tu bzang po dang*/ sa'i snying po dang*/ sgrib pa rnam sel dang brgyad kyi phyag mtshan dang bcas pa lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs// de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba las sprul pa'i khro bo rdo rje shugs can dang*/ rdo rje chags can dang*/ rdo rje rnon po dang*/ rdo rje 'bar ba dang*/ rdo rje khro bo dang*/ rdo rje gtum po dang*/ rdo rje thabs bdag dang*/ rdo rje stobs chen dang*/ khro bo rdo rje rgyu stobs pus btsugs dang*/ khro bo rdo rje 'bar byed pus btsugs dang bcus bskor ba lha bcu gcig gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das gtsug gtor 'khor lo bsgyur ba la 'khor dam pa sbyin pa dang drug gis bskor ba lha bdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs// de nas g.yas ngos na mgon po tshe ye shes dpag tu med pa la rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang*/

mgon po rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ don thams cad grub pa dang dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la/ sras nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ yum yig drug rig ma dang*/ mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ mar me ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang bcus bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu gcig bzhugs/ nub byang gi zur la khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu zang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ spyir nub kyi ngos la lha drug cu rtsa dgu bzhugs so// //de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gtsug gi nor bu zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa la/ mkha' 'gro ma ma tang gī dang*/ ḍoṃ bi nī dang*/ ra dza gī dang*/ pu ka sī dang*/ ba dha kī dang*/ sa ha dza rī dang*/ bud+dha tsa rī dang*/ sha ba rī dang*/ khrag 'thung 'od ma dang*/ rdo rje gtum mo dang*/ rdo rje srin mo dang*/ rdo rje 'jigs byed ma dang bcu gnyis kyis bskor ba lha bcu bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das yang dag he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa yum kro ti shwa ri ma dang gnyis su med pa la/

lha mo kau rī ma dang*/ tsau rī ma dang*/ pra mo ha dang*/ be ta li dang*/ puk+ka si dang*/ ghas ma rī dang*/ sme sha ni dang*/ tsan+ḍa lī dang brgyad kyis bskor ba lha bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs// de'i g.yas na bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la/ mgon po mi bskyod pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ don thams cad grub pa dang bzhis bskor ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor lha lnga bzhugs so// //gtso bo'i g.yon phyogs na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum du gyur pa rje btsun ma 'phags ma phyag brgyad sgrol ma dang*/ 'phags ma me'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ seng ge'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ glang po che'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ rgyal po'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ sbrul gyi 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob pa dang*/ mi rgod kyi 'jigs pa skyob pa dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mgrin zhal gsum phyag drug pa la lha mo rdo rje las byed ma dang*/ gshin rje las byed ma dang*/ klu'i las byed ma dang*/ gnod sbyin las byed ma dang bzhis bskor ba lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bzhugs/ byang shar gyi zur la khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba pus btsugs dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dag gnyis bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ma rgyal ba las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba gnyis dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/

spyir byang ngos na lha drug cu re gcig bzhugs so// spyir bang rim gsum pa la lha gnyis brgya drug cu re gcig bzhugs te rnam grangs gsum pa'o// //de nas bang rim bzhi pa'i shar phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa mtshan dang dpe byad thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa la/ g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' byams pa klu shing gi steng na ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyag na rdo rjes mtshan pa bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po rin po che'i khang bu bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba mda' gzhu bsnams pa dang bzhis bskor ba gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs/ de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe la/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa'i rigs sa gnon gyi phyag rgya can/ thugs phyag mtshan gyis kha bskangs pa dang nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs so// //shar lho'i zur la sgo ba rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ spyir shar ngos na lha nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po shākya'i rgyal po la/ g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje ut+pal shin tu rgyas pa'i steng na/ rdo rje bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po mi g.yo ba ral gri bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying po ral gri bsnams pa dang*/

khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba la rdo rje rgya gram bsnams pa dang gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs mchod sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ thugs phyag mtshan gyis kha bskangs pa dang*/ nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ lho nub kyi zur la sgo ba rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ spyir lho ngos na lha gnyis brgya bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// //de nas nub phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po shākya seng ge la/ g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal shin tu rgyas pa'i steng na rdo rje bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed tho ba bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs phyag na pad+ma bzang po bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin phyag na dbyug to bsnams pa dang gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas kyi rigs mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi kha bskangs pa dang nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/

nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ nub byang gi zur la sgo ba rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs so// //spyir nub ngos na lha nyis brgya dang bdun cu rtsa gsum bzhugs so// //de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ gtso bo bstan pa'i bdag po shākya skyes mchog la/ g.yas na byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po rin po che'i myu gu bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo chen po dbyug pa sngon po phyag na rdo rje dbyug pa bsnams pa dang*/ g.yon na byang chub sems dpa' sgrib pa rnam sel phyag na po ti bsnams pa dang*/ khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po phyag na lcags kyu bsnams pa dang gtso 'khor lnga bzhugs so// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i rigs skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya can thugs phyag mtshan gyis kha bskangs pa dang*/ nyis brgya lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma dang glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang brgyad bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ byang shar gyi zur la sgo ba rdo rje dril bu 'khrol ba dang*/ lha'i bu nam mkha' lding kun tu bzang po mchod pa'i sprin phung gi char chen po rab tu 'bebs par byed pa dang gnyis bzhugs/ spyir byang ngos na lha nyis brgya dang bdun cu don gsum bzhugs so// //de nas phyogs bzhi na bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po bzhi po de dag la/ glang po la sogs pas rgyan sna bzhi bzhi dang*/ gter chen po'i bum pa bzang po'i nang nas dpag bsam gyi shing chen po 'khrungs pa las/

rin po che sna tshogs kyi yal ga dang*/ lo ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis klubs pa ngo mtshar bas spras shing*/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad po de dag ni/ rje btsun phyag na rdo rje dang*/ rje btsun sems bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ma 'debs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa la/ khro bo brgyad po de dag ni gter chen po'i bum pa bsrung ba'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o// de la spyir bang rim bzhi pa la lha stong phrag gcig dang dgu bcu go gnyis bzhugs te rnam grangs bzhi pa'o/// /de nas bang rim lnga pa'i shar phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ bcom ldan 'das dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum/ 'gro ba'i nad dang gnod pa sel bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lo ma can zhal gsum phyag drug ma bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na 'jigs pa dang nyam nga ba thams cad las skyob par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma lha mo 'od zer can zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rgyal ba rigs rnam pa lngas dbu brgyan pa bzhugs/ g.yon na nyon mongs pa'i dug thams cad sel bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i lha mo dug sel ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa bzhugs/ de nas g.yas phyogs na mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang bzhi bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na mchod pa'i lha mo gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos dbyings rdo rje ma dang bzhi bzhugs/ g.yon phyogs na mchod pa'i lha mo rdo rje bzhad ma dang*/ rdo rje sgeg ma dang*/ rdo rje glu ma dang*/ rdo rje gar ma dang bzhi bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na mchod pa'i lha mo rdo rje me tog ma dang*/ rdo rje bdug spos ma dang*/ rdo rje snang gsal ma dang*/ rdo rje dri chab ma dang bzhi bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi/

nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la phyi nang gi mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa bzhugs/ shar lho'i zur la phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi las lha'i drang srong chen po me tog phyag na ut+pal shin tu rgyas pa bsnams pa bzhugs so// spyir shar ngos na lha bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bzhugs so// //de nas lho phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum 'gro ba ma lus pa 'jigs pa brgyad las skyob pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma phyag brgyad sgrol ma bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na gzhan gyi rigs sngags dang byad stems dang mthu thams cad phyir zlog par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma gdugs dkar mo can zhal gsum phyag drug ma bzhugs/ g.yon ngos na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bskul bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma bskul byed ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bzhugs/ de nas g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang bcu drug bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa bzhugs/ lho nub kyi zur la phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong bzhi las/ gnod sbyin gyi drang srong chen po lhun po phyag na shing thog bsnams pa bzhugs so// spyir lho ngos na lha sum cu so drug bzhugs so// de nas nub phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/

dgra dang chom rkun dang dang pha rol gyi dpung thams cad rab tu 'joms par byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan can zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na srid pa gsum gyi 'jig rten la mnga' brnyes pas ma rungs pa thams cad tshar gcod par byed cing bkra shis dang bde legs thams cad 'byung ba gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma e ka dza ti zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma bzhugs/ g.yon ngos na gdon chen po dang bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad zhi bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma bzhugs// de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang*/ bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang bcu drug bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa bzhi dang brgyad thugs phyag mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa bzhugs/ nub byang gi zur la phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi las/ klu'i drang srong chen po me sgron zhes bya ba phyag na me thab bsnams pa bzhugs so// spyir nub ngos na lha sum cu so drug bzhugs so// //de nas byang phyogs kyi dbus kyi ling tshe la/ 'gro ba'i dbul ba dang phongs pa thams cad sel bar byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma nor rgyun ma zhal gcig phyag drug ma bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na sems can dmyal ba dang ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i rigs pa dang*/

bgegs dang log 'dren zhi bar mdzad pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma so sor 'brang ma chen mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad ma bzhugs// g.yon ngos na pad+ma'i mda' stangs kyis 'gro ba thams cad dbang du byed pa gtsor gyur pa'i rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma bzhugs/ de nas g.yas g.yon gyi ling tshe rnams la/ mchod pa'i lha mo pi wang ma dang*/ gling bu ma dang*/ rdza rnga ma dang*/ rdza rnga chen po ma dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma dang*/ ro rdo rje ma dang*/ reg rdo rje ma dang*/ chos rdo rje ma dang*/ bzhad ma dang*/ sgeg ma dang*/ glu ma dang*/ gar ma dang*/ me tog ma dang*/ bdug spos ma dang*/ snang gsal ma dang*/ dri chab ma dang bcu drug bzhugs te/ de ltar phyogs gsum po de'i g.yas g.yon du bzhi tshan gyi rim pa ni shar phyogs su ji lta bar bzhugs/ ka ba bzhi la zhal phyir gzigs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bzhi dang*/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo bzhi dang brgyad bzhugs/ zur thung bzhi la mchod pa'i lha mo bzhad ma la sogs pa bzhi dang*/ me tog ma la sogs pa bzhi dang brgyad thugs mtshan gyi ngo bor gyur pa bzhugs/ byang shar gyi zur la phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i thub pa drang srong chen po bzhi las mi'i drang srong chen po ri byi phyag na ril ba spyi blugs bsnams pa bzhugs/ de la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu gnyis po de dag ni zhal gsum phyag drug ma la sogs pa zhal phyag tha dad par bzhugs la/ 'khor drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag ni nges par brjod pa'i rgyud bla ma'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi mar bzhugs shing zur thung spyi la bzhugs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo brgya dang nyi shu rtsa brgyad po de dag ni rnal 'byor ma kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brangs nas zhal gcig phyag gnyis mar bzhugs so// de ltar mchod lha'i bang rim dang stong sku'i bang rim gnyis kyi ka ba rnams la bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi mtshan ni rdo rje dbyings dang*/

gsang 'dus kyi bang rim gnyis las smos pa dang khyad med do// spyir byang ngos na lha sum cu so drug bzhugs so// spyir bang rim lnga pa la lha brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa bzhugs te rnam grangs lnga pa'o/ /de nas pad+ma chen po 'dab ma nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa drug pa'i 'og bang rim drug pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams kyi bzhugs gnas ldum rdzings kyi yal ga phyogs kun tu 'khyil ba rnams la/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshad med pa'i snying rje chen po las 'khrungs pa/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs kyi bar du phrin las mtha' yas pas dgongs pa thams cad bsgrub par mdzad pa/ mthu dang nus pa dang rdzu 'phrul dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po sha stag la/ phyogs re re na ma mgon zung re/ gnod sbyin rgyal po zung re/ klu'i rgyal po zung re ste gtso bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi bzhugs pa las/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad po de dag ni rin po che'i pad+ma la rtsol sgrub med pa'i rnam par brtse bas gyad kyi tshul du 'degs shing zhal nang du lta ba las cung zad thad zhal du gzigs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ chos rje rin po che'i bzhed kyis/ mgo dgu pa zhi ba'i rnam pa can sprin chen po them nyer du 'khrigs pa/ 'brug gi mgo bo skad 'byin pa'i stang ka can/ kha nas glog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ rin po che rnam pa sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs shing bar du gcod pa thams cad sel bar mdzad pa'i tshul du gnas shing*/ 'khor klu'i rgyal po brgyad brgyad kyis bskor ba ste gtso 'khor bdun cu rtsa gnyis so// de la shar phyogs kyi pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yas phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa gnyan po srung bar mdzad pa ye shes kyi mgon po dpal bya rog ming can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa bzhugs pa la/

'phags pa phyogs skyong ba chen po brgya byin dang*/ me lha dang*/ gshin rje dang*/ srin po dang*/ chu lha dang*/ rlung lha dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dbang ldan dang*/ sa bdag dang*/ skar ma'i rgyal po dang bcus bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu gcig bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rin po che'i gter la mnga' brnyes pas dgos 'dod thams cad bsgrub par byed pa gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang*/ nor bu bzang po dang*/ 'dzam bha la dang*/ rta bdag ku be ra dang*/ yang dag shes dang*/ 'brog gnas dang*/ lnga rtsen dang*/ sred spong dang*/ rgyal ba khyu mchog dang dgus bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas la/ klu'i rgyal po rigs ldan dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog pa dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yon phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la dpal ldan lha mo srog sgrub ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la 'khor lha mo gri thod bsnams pa rigs mthun brgyad/ klu mo chu srin gdong dang dgus bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na rin po che'i gter thams cad kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur pa sa'i lha mo brtan ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma la/ 'khor bum pa dang bum pa chen po dang*/ dung dang dung chen po dang*/ pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po dang*/ rin po che dang rin po che chen po ste gter gyi lha mo brgyad dang*/ jo mo lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma dang*/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma dang*/ mi g.yo glo bzang ma dang*/ gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang*/ gcod pan mgrin bzang ma dang bcu gsum gyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhi bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na klu'i rgyal po pad+ma chen po la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/

'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ spyir ldum rdzings kyi shar ngos na lha drug cu re bzhi bzhugs so// //de nas lho phyogs kyi pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yas phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po dpal mgon po gtsug gtor rten zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ 'khor lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang*/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po thag bzang ris dang*/ mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa dang*/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu dang*/ dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig 'khyil ba dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po 'brog gnas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na rin po che'i gter la mnga' brnyes pa'i gnod sbyin 'brog gnas 'jigs 'jigs lta bu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag pos dbu brgyan pa la rgyun bcad glang po che'i gzugs dang*/ shes pa'i sgron ma spre'u yi mgo can dang*/ sred spong ra'i mgo can dang*/ yang dag sha ba'i mgo can dang*/ gang ba bzang po rta'i mgo can dang*/ nor bu bzang po lug gi mgo can dang*/ lnga rtsen phyugs kyi mgo can dang*/ ljon pa rta'i mgo can dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na klu'i rgyal po pad+ma la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yon phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ dpal ldan ma lha mo dud sol ma zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma la 'khor lha mo gri thod bsnams pa rigs mthun bcus bskor ba dang gtso 'khor bcu gcig bzhugs/

de'i g.yon na 'dzam bu'i gling la sogs par char chu dus su 'bebs shing 'gro ba'i lo tog smin par mdzad pa/ drang srong chen po khyab 'jug zhal dgu phyag bzhi pa/ bcom ldan 'das rje btsun phyag na rdo rjes brgyan pa la drang srong chen po nyi ma dang zla ba dang sa skyes dang lag pa dang*/ bla ma dang*/ pa wa sangs nyi ma'i bu dang*/ du ba mjug ring dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na klu'i rgyal po dung skyong la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ spyir ldum rdzings kyi lho ngos na lnga bcu nga dgu bzhugs so// //de nas nub phyogs kyi pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yas phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ dpal legs ldan nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la 'khor lha'i dgra lha chen po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rigs mthun brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na 'gro ba'i dgos 'dod bsgrub pa/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa la/ 'khor tshogs bdag rang dang 'dra ba zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa rigs mthun brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na klu'i rgyal po 'jog po la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yon phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ dpal lha mo gcer bu bong zhon ma shan pa nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma la dbyar gyi rgyal mo re ma ti dang*/ dgun gyi rgyal mo dang*/ ston gyi rgyal mo dang*/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo dang*/ klu mo chu srin gdong dang lngas bskor ba gtso 'khor drug bzhugs/

de'i g.yon na sems can thams cad la nor gyi char pa chen po 'bebs par byed pa'i mgon po dzam bha la la/ gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po dang*/ gang ba bzang po dang*/ gter 'dzin dang*/ rnam thos sras dang*/ phur bu'i phreng ba dang*/ lkog ma 'khyil pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i dbang po dang*/ spyod pa'i dbang po dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na klu'i rgyal po stobs kyi rgyu la/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ nor rgyas dang*/ brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ spyir ldum rdzings kyi nub phyogs na lha lnga bcu nga gnyis bzhugs so// //de nas byang phyogs kyi pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yas phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po dpal mgon po mchog sred zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa la/ mgon po rta mang dang*/ srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu dang*/ gsung gi ngo bo rta mgrin gyi rgyud bskul sbo mgon dang*/ sras legs ldan nag po dang*/ gur mgon dang*/ zhing skyong mgon po k+ṣe tra pa la dang*/ byin rlabs kyi mgon po dang bdun gyis bskor ba gtso 'khor brgyad bzhugs/ de'i g.yas na mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag na bir+wa rgyud mang sbreng ba la 'khor sras mdzes pa dang*/ btsun mo mdangs ldan ma dang*/ bu mo yid 'phrog ma dang*/ 'byung po'i rgyal po dge ba dang*/ rje'i mgur lha chen po bcu gsum la/ gnyan chen po thang lha dang*/ yar lha sham po dang*/ dwags lha sgam po dang*/ 'od de gung rgyal dang*/ gnyags lha byar ma dang*/ mchims lha than tsho dang*/ spyi lha sbyar ma dang*/ sgyog chen ldong ra dang*/ rma chen spom ra dang*/ 'dzam po klu brug dang*/ lha btsun mu le dang*/ ming gi tha ma ra dang brten pa gnyis dang bcu bdun gyis bskor ba la gtso 'khor bco brgyad bzhugs/

de'i g.yas na klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas la/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ ma dros pa dang*/ rigs ldan dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ pad+ma'i sdong po'i g.yon phyogs kyi ldum rdzings kyi 'khyil la/ srung ma chen po dpal ldan ma ke'u ri ma dang*/ tse'u ri ma la sogs pa gnas kyi ma mo brgyad/ sing nga dang bya gh+ri la sogs pa yul gyi phra men ma brgyad dang bcu drug rtsa ba'i zhal dang dbu bcu bdun ma la/ rdo rje ya sbyin dang*/ rdo rje bse sbyin dang*/ rdo rje sde sbyin dang*/ rdo rje phag sbyin dang*/ bse'i lha mo mched bzhi dang*/ rdo rje g.yu bun ma dang*/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong dang*/ rdo rje dpal gyi yum dang*/ rdo rje bod khams skyong dang*/ rdo rje 'khor 'bul ma dang*/ rdo rje dbyar mo sil dang*/ rdo rje si le ma dang*/ rdo rje la ro sman dang*/ rdo rje yi ge ri dang*/ rdo rje gau ti shag dang*/ rdo rje kun grags ma dang*/ rdo rje ting nge 'dzin ma dang*/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ klu mo chu srin gdong dang bcu bdun gyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bco brgyad bzhugs so// de'i g.yon na gnod sbyin rgyal po a pa ra tsi ta zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa phyag na rin po che'i bum pa bsnams pa la gnod sbyin ma phug gnas ma dang*/ mi'i dpa' mo dang gzhon nu ma 'jig rten rnam par grags pa dang*/ mna' ma gnod sbyin ma dang*/ yid du 'ong ma dang*/ lha mdzes ma dang*/ nam gru ma dang*/ mun nag chen po na gnas pa zhes bya ba'i gnod sbyin ma dang*/ gnod sbyin ma brgyad/ rgyal ma dang*/ rnam par rgyal ma dang*/ skra can ma dang*/ skra mthar byed ma dang sring mo bzhi/ rtsi'i lha mo grub pa'i blo gros ma bcu gsum gyis bskor ba gtso 'khor bcu bzhi bzhugs/ de'i g.yon na klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa la klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/

dung skyong dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ pad+ma chen po dang*/ 'jog po dang*/ stobs kyi rgyu dang*/ rigs ldan dang*/ nor rgyas dang brgyad kyis bskor ba gtso 'khor dgu bzhugs/ spyir ldum rdzings kyi byang phyogs na lha bdun cu don bdun bzhugs so// spyir ldum rdzings la lha nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe bdun rgyal po bzhi bcu zhe bdun rgyal po bzhi lnga bcu nga gcig bzhugs te rnam grangs tha ma'o// de nas rdo rje sa gzhi'i steng ri rgyal lhun po zur bzhi pa'i steng na/ phyogs bzhi'i rgyal po chen po bzhi las/ shar lho'i mtshams na dri za'i rgyal po yul 'khor skyong phyag na rin po che'i pi wang rgyud mang bsnams pa bzhugs/ lho nub kyi mtshams na grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes po phyag na phas kyi rgol ba thams cad 'joms par byed pa'i rin po che'i ral gri bsnams pa bzhugs/ nub byang gi mtshams na klu'i rgyal po spyan mi bzang phyag na de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten dang sbrul zhags bsnams pa bzhugs/ byang shar gyi mtshams na gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po rnam thos sras phyag na rin po che sna tshogs 'byung ba'i ne'u le'i rkyal ba dang*/ pha rol gyi dpung bzlog par byed pa'i mdung dar bsnams pa bzhugs so// //spyir bang rim de dag la ka ba brgyad cu tham pa yod pa las/ rigs lnga'i ka ba phyag mtshan gyis spras pa bcu drug lha bzhugs pa'i ka ba drug cu rtsa bzhi yod pa las/ nang du gzigs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag la mtshan med de phyag na rin po che'i do shal thogs pa sha stag go// bang rim du phye ba'i lha'i rnam grangs ni dkyus nyid na gsal lo// phyogs phyogs su rnam par phye na shar phyogs na grangs lnga brgya bzhi bcu zhe brgyad bzhugs so// //lho phyogs na lnga brgya nyer gsum bzhugs so// nub phyogs na lnga brgya bcu bdun bzhugs so// byang phyogs na lha lnga brgya bdun cu don gsum bzhugs so//

spyi'i rnam pa la bltas na logs bzhi zur bzhi dang ldan pa ste spyi bsdus rin po che'i za ma tog chen pos mdzes pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang chen po 'dra'o// de nas phyogs rnams la bltas pa'i tshe phyogs re re logs bzhi logs thung brgyad dang ldan pa/ yar pad+ma chen po gyen du bskor ba ltar yod pa'i steng na lha bzhugs pa de rnams ni ze hrog gi tshul du brgyan pa'i dbus na gdung khang chen po rgyab yol gdugs dang bcas pas mdzes shing*/ logs la bzhugs pa'i lha rnams ni zhal phyag tha dad pa/ bzhugs tshul rigs mi 'dra ba/ gzigs tshul mtha' yas pa re re la yang blta bas ngoms mi shes te/ spyi'i rnam pa la bltas na rin po che'i khri khyad par du 'phags pa rmad du 'byung ba rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa la/ chos kyi rgyal po de nyid 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i cha lugs su cod pan spyi bor bcings te/ rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i rnam par bzhugs pa 'dra'o// de nas zur rnams la bltas pa'i tshe/ zur bzhi zur thung brgyad dang ldan pa las logs dang zur rnams phyed phyed gong 'og rim pa ma 'dres par gsal ba'i dbus na bum pa yan chad tha la mngon par 'phags pas dpal lha las babs pa'i mchod rten 'dra la/ zur la bzhugs pa'i lha rnams nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sprul pa 'gyed pa ltar mngon te/ rje btsun ma rnams ni skad cig gis mdun du byon pa dang 'dra la/ rje btsun spyan ras gzigs rnams ni/ su ni skal ba dang ldan/ su ni ngan song las bton/ su ni mya ngan las 'das pa la gzhol snyam du nyin mtshan dus drug tu dgongs pa ltar bzhugs so// khro bo'i rgyal po rnams ni bar chad bsrung ba'i tshul gyis zhum pa med par gnas la/ lha'i bu rnams ni tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis nye bar bskul ba 'dra zhing*/ thub pa drang srong chen po rnams ni shis pa brjod pa'i tshul can du bzhugs pa/

rgyal po bzhi po de dag ni rin po che'i rigs thams cad kyis sku la brgyan pa/ pha rol gyi dmag gi dpung bzlog pa ltar chas su zhugs shing 'gying stabs dang ldan pa/ dar gyi gos rnam pa mang po'i lhab lhub can rlung gis cung zad bskyod pa'i tshul du yod pa/ dar dpyangs kyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ sku la 'od 'bar zhing gzi brjid chen po dang ldan te zhum pa med pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o/// /bad gdong de dag la rin po che pad+ma rā ga'i phra btab pa rnams ni/ me'i phung po chen po 'bar ba dang 'dra la/ gzhan rin po che'i phra'i rigs rnams ni bgrang ba las 'das te/ dper na nam mkha' dag pa la skar ma'i tshogs kyi spras pa dang 'dra'o// lho byang gi tshangs thig dang 'gros gcig tu/ 'od 'bar ba lta bu'i rgyab yol mchis shing*/ thams cad kyang 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi kha dog du 'dug pas/ rin po che'i ri bo chen po ltar gsal lo// //bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis/ dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig// /

11) ༄// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bsil byed tsan dan gyi phreng ba// na mo rat+na gu ru/ rgyal ba 'jig rten rnam 'dren rin po che// yon tan rab rdzogs bsod nams ye shes mdzod// mtha' bral 'od gsal rnam dag chos kyi sku// mnyam med 'gro mgon zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud// mgon po des gsungs bde gshegs dri med lam// byang chub sems gsum rgyal sras kyis bsten pa// 'khor 'das bde legs dpag med 'byung gnas 'di// mi dbang bka' bzhin deng 'dir bri bar bya/ /'di ltar bdag gis mngon sum du mthong zhing thos pas/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbus kyi sa'i sgang*/ ma ga dha'i byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs/ thub pa'i 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i rten gnas/ rdo rje gdan gnyis pa/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du/ 'jig rten du sangs rgyas dngos su byon pa'i bla ma dam pa/ chos kyi sku mnyam pa nyid la rtag tu bzhugs pa/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel mngon du gyur pa/ 'jig rten tshangs pa dang lhar bcas pas zhabs la btud pa/ thub pa'i bstan pa 'di la thugs rje chen po tshad med pas ma 'ongs pa na 'byon pa/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi 'khor 'dus pa dang po dang mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin pa dang grol bar mdzad pa/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i de'i spyan sngar phyogs tha dad pa nas lhag pa'i skye bo 'bum phrag du ma 'dus nas/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi bcud kyi snying po rdzas dang yo byad phyi dang nang gi mchod pa lus dang longs spyod dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bcas pas mchod nas/ dad pa dang gus pa'i shugs chen pos byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhus pa la/ brtse ba chen po'i spyan gyis gzigs te/ gdul bya de dag gi don gnyis 'grub pa la thugs dgyes par gnang nas/ nyid kyi gdan seng ge'i khri chen po shin tu brtan pa bla re dang gdugs kyis phub cing dar gyi lda ldi dpyangs pa/
