gdan nang tshangs can reg na bde ba/ rnam pa du ma bting ba la ston pa'i sku mtshan dpes brgyan pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can mngon du mdzad de/ phyag dang mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas sku drang por bsrang te skyil mo krung gis bzhugs nas gdul bya de dag gi khams dang dbang po la gzigs te/ zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dung gi tshems bar nas ljags kyi dbang po bkram ste 'di skad du gsungs so// rten gyi gang zag sems bskyed par 'dod pas/ gnas khang phyag dar dang brkyang nul byas la bla re bres/ jo bo byang chub chen po'i rten bkram/ mchod pa rgya chen po bshams/ gtor ma chen po dang*/ gtor chung gnyis bca'/ slob dpon gdan mthon po la bzhugs la/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ 'thor nas dang*/ yon gyi me tog tshags bya/ slob dpon gyis gtor ma chen po de chos skyong ba'i srung ma zur bsngos shig byas la/ gtor chung de gnas de la yod pa'i mi ma yin pa dang gnod byed la byin la/ gnod pa ma byed par stong grogs gyis shig par bka' bsgo/ spyir zab mo ston pa la srung ba'i 'khor lo dgos pas mtshan nyid pa rnams rgyal ba'i yum rgyas par/ de bzhin gshegs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsungs pa la/ bdud sdig can gyis dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi sprul nas bar du gcod pa'i phyir 'ongs pas/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis rig ste shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yid la byas pas/ gnod pa med par de nyid nas phyir log par gsungs pa de'i rjes su 'brangs nas chos thun gyi mgor shes rab snying po tshar gsum gsum 'don pa dang*/ gsang sngags su khro bcu rol pa'i mtshams dang*/ 'bru drug mtshon drug gi mtshams dang*/ yum lnga khrag 'thung ma lnga'i mtshams dang*/ rdo rje gur dang me ri 'bar ba la sogs pa gsungs pa yin mod kyi/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i zhal snga nas/

'dir bcom ldan 'das kyis srung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang*/ rnal 'byor srung ba dang*/ bar chad srung ba gnyis las/ rnal 'byor srung ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas theg pa dman pa las skyob pa dang*/ bar chad srung ba mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pa 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dam bcu drug las bsrung ba dang skyob par byed pa yin te/ de gnyis ka'i srung ba mchog tu gyur pa byang chub kyi sems lags gsungs pas/ yang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhig mdzad par zhu 'tshal lags/ bdag cag thams cad la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod pa byed pa thams cad bdag gi ma yin/ sems can thams cad kyang bdag gi ma yin/ ma gnod par byed pa 'di dag gis gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum po dge ba la bkol snyam pa'i dam bca' re re mdzod/ de nas yul ris dang rgyal khams 'di thams cad jo bo thugs rje chen po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi sku shin tu che ba zhig tu bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i sku che ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rang nyid so so'i yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ 'di'i ming la gtum po sum brtsegs kyi man ngag bgyi ba lags/ de ltar srung 'khor 'di ma bsgoms na bar gcod 'byung bas/ sngon dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pas bla gab med par sems bskyed byas par grwa pa gces pa bdun dus gcig la shi skad/

nga 'bus kyang gong slad du bla gab med par sems bskyed ma phod nas yol bas 'gebs pa tshun chad bgyis te/ dus phyis srung 'khor 'di byas nas bla gab med par yang byas te legs par byung bas khyed kyis kyang de bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ de nas so so'i thugs dam la mnyam par bzhag de nas chos gsan par zhu 'tshal lags/ bu kun nged rang pha spad kyi shi tshig gsang gtam du/ 'jig rten 'dir yun ring du mi sdod/ myur du 'chi ba'i chos can yin/ 'o na shi ba gcig pus chog gam snyam na des mi chog ste/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas las kyi 'bras bus khams gsum gyi 'khor bar 'khor yang bde ba dang skyid pa'i gnas ma rnyed pas dus gtan du bde ba dang skyid pa'i thabs gcig btsal dgos/ gtan du bde ba dang skyid pa de yang sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa gzhan med pas/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu yin te/ de ltar yang*/ theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes gsungs pas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par mi bya ba'i thabs med/ sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu nges pa med na mi 'byung ba'i rgyu 'bras byang chub kyi sems lags pas/ 'di yod na gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde skyid dang yon tan thams cad 'byung zhing*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par nges pa lags pas de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems de bskyed pa'i don du bla ma la gsol ba gdab pas/ khyed kyis bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig ji snyed su dag tshar gcig dang rol chen bya/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par sing gis dbul/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/

ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ slob dpon gyis bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ 'thor ba'i dus su bla ma'i dbu gtsug gi steng du me tog gi gdugs chen por gyur par bsgoms te/ de ltar yang me tog gang gis khyod la mngon gtor bas// phyogs kun tu yang de dag gdugs gyur te// dus kun bde ba'i 'byung gnas zhing du ni// rkang gnyis mchog gi dbu la gdugs su shog /ces gsungs pa ltar bsgom la so so'i spyi bor gtor/ de la spyir byang chub kyi sems skye bar byed pa la rgyu rkyen rnam pa gnyis 'dzoms dgos/ sems skye byed kyi rgyu thub pa'i gsung rab tu/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing*// sangs rgyas sras kyi spyod la dad byed la// byang chub bla na med pa dad gyur na// skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o// zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan mthong ba dang thos pa la bsten nas de lta bu thob par 'dod pas sems skye ba dang*/ chos la brten pa dang*/ dge 'dun la brten pa skye ba dang*/ sems can rnams kyi nyes pa dang sdug bsngal mthong ba la brten nas byang chub sems skye ba/ sngon bcom ldan 'das dmyal ba'i me'i shing rta 'dren pa'i gyad du skye ba bzhes pa na/ grogs pos shing rta 'dren par ma nus pa la snying rje chen po skyes pas sum cu rtsa gsum du skyes pa lta bu dpag tu med pa gsungs kyang*/ jo bo chen pos mdor bsdus pa rnam pa bzhir gsungs pas de yang bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/

skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhis blos sbyangs pa dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa dang bzhi yin pa la/ khyed la rgyu bzhi po ma tshang ba med de/ 'dir 'bras bus rgyu dpag na/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes phyag rgya'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas brgya stong la mchod dang bsnyen bkur ba ni da ltar sems bskyed par mi 'gyur gyi/ sangs rgyas 'bum phrag mang po la mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur bas da lta sems bskyed pa thob par 'gyur bar gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// de las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun// dge ba'i bshes kyis mgon byas pas// 'di nyan pa yi snod yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ khyed gong du bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags bsags pa lags/ skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du ma byas na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi sgra thos par yang dka' bas/ sangs rgyas grangs med sngon mchod pas// da ltar bcom ldan 'das mtshan thos so// zhes gsungs pas rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can yang ji bzhin du byas pa lags/ tshad med pa rnam pa bzhis blos sbyangs pa 'di yang*/ bod theg pa chen po'i rigs can rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ lha mo dri ma med pa'i 'od kyis zhus pa'i mdor bod yul du skyes pa'i mi thams cad phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpar gsungs pas 'di yang ji bzhin du yod pa lags/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes ma skyes na da ltar gces par bskyangs pa'i bu dang 'bad pas bsags pa'i zas nor thams cad dus gcig la phul nas bsod snyoms byed par ga la nus te/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes gzhi bzhag tu yod kyang*/ 'dir cho ga lag len gyi dbang du bgyis pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsog pa yan lag bdun pa mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa thun gcig bsgom tshar bas thugs gzhan du ma yengs par mdzod la/

'di ltar gsal thob cig mdun 'dir mtsho shin tu sngo ba/ 'jam pa/ 'bol ba yid du 'ong ba zhig bsam/ mtsho de'i nang na yar la pad+ma'i sdong po shin tu che ba zhig skyes par bsam/ pad+ma de yang rgyu tshogs gnyis las grub pa'i nor bu rin po che sdong po dang yal ga dang 'dab ma dang ze 'bru dang snying po thams cad rdo rje rin po che las grub pa/ rtsa ba ye shes kyi rdo rje mthu bo che chen po dang ldan pa/ 'phags pa dkon mchog rtsegs par rgya cher gsungs pa lta bur bsgom/ de yang rtsa ba dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi la thug par bsgoms pas pad+ma mi 'jigs pa yin/ de ltar min na pad+ma mi rtag pas myur du 'jig ste/ mdo smad du glog skya a rgod kyis pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa'i gzhal med khang zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pas/ rtsis pa zhig gis 'di la dar ba zhig 'ong ste myur du 'jig zer skad pas de kho na bzhin du byung bar gda'/ de la de'i dus su bcos byed na/ ming de rdo rje rin po che'i pad+ma la sogs par btags pas bcos su 'gro ba yin/ de lta bu'i pad+ma'i sdong po de'i dbus kyi pad+ma chen po la slob dpon bzhugs par bsam na de ci 'dra na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya thub pa mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'od 'dom gang ba/ 'od dang 'od zer gyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par byed pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das su bsam/ bla ma'i mdun drang po'i pad+ma rnams la khyed rang so so'i yi dam gyi lha bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma'i sku phrag pa'i gong yan chod kyi pad+ma rnams la/ khyed rang so so'i bla ma dang*/ mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon du gyur tshad thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma'i spyi gtsug yan chad kyi pad+ma rnams la nga 'bu'i rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams bzhugs par bsam/

bla ma'i sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi thad so'i pad+ma phyogs bcur rnam par rgyas pa thams cad la 'das ma byon da ltar phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ mtsho chen po las skyes pa mtshams kyi pad+ma rnams la chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po dpal mgon po dang dpal lha mo la sogs pa phyogs skyong ba bcu bdun/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'phrog ma ma bu'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ mdor na thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ de ltar bzhugs pa de rnams thams cad la rgyal ba thams cad yid kyis mngon sum du zhes pas yid kyis gcer gyis bltas la/ bdag bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad dang zhal mjal ba re dga' snyam pa'i dga' ba re re bsgom/ de sku lta ba'i mchod pa lags/ de nas/ zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas rang gi lus zhing gi rdul snyed du sprul la/ lus de dag gis bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs la gtug gtug gtugs nas phyag dpag tu med pa 'tshal bar bsam/ de phyag 'tshal ba'i mchod pa lags/ de nas/ dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// zhes pas ngag tu/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog nyid la ni skyabs su mchi// zhes bgyi la sogs pa bstod pa dpag tu med pas bstod pa byas par bsam/

de bstod pa'i mchod pa lags/ 'di man chad kyi mchod pa 'di rnams thams cad rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa zhing chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ yun 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du 'byung ba/ byed pa'i las dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad mchod pa dang*/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa'i yon chab kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas mchod gsol cig de bzhin du me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me dang dri dang zhal zas kyi tshogs dpag tu med pas mchod gsol cig gzhan yang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang bla re dang rol mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod gsol cig gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ nyes pa'i skyon med cing legs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis gang bas kyang mchod gsol cig gzhan yang lha'i gzhal med kyi khang gi nang na lha'i bu dang bu mo mang po la la ni glu len/ la la ni gar byed/ la la ni khrus kyi bum pas phyag zhabs bkru ba dang bstod pa dang rol mo dkrol ba mang pos gang bas kyang mchod gsol cig de bzhin du tshe ring zhing mi 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ nad thams cad las rab tu thar bar bya ba'i phyir sman gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dang*/ dbul ba sel ba nam mkha' mdzod thob par bya ba'i phyir nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po dang*/ phas kyi rgol ba 'joms pa'i phyir rdo rje mthu bo che dang*/ dngos grub thams cad thob par bya ba'i phyir dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams dang*/ gti mug gi mun pa thams cad sel ba'i phyir 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas kyang mchod de/ de lta bu re re yang sems bskyed pa'i yon du phul bas sems bskyed pa de'i khyad par gyi chos su 'gyur bas/

lam gyi gnas skabs su yang rgyal po bsod nams stobs ltar yon phul ba de chos de'i khyad par gyi chos su 'ong la/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i dus su yang de re re'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur te dper bgyis na/ rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud kyis 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pas de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la phul nas sems bskyed pas de bzhin gshegs pa 'od dpag med pa gyur pa lta bu yin/ shin tu rgyas par byed na rang gi snying ga nas yon chab kyi lha mo dkar mo phyag na rin po che'i gzhong pa yon chab kyis bkang ba thogs pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa/ de re re yang chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i yon chab kyi char rgyun 'bebs par bsam la mchod de/ tshul de dang 'dra bar mchod pa thams cad la sbyar la/ phyi'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa nang gi mchod pa lnga dang*/ gsang ba'i mchod pa bde ba dang stong pa dang*/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa skye ba med pa'i don gyis mchod do// de kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul lam sprin phung gi mchod pa lags/ de la sprin phung ni/ me tog la sogs pa dngos po gcig la yang de kho na'i sprin phung du bsam pa yin la/ rnam 'phrul ni dngos po de lta bu gcig la yang*/ rigs tha dad pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par dbul ba yin te/ de la kun tu bzang po zhes zer bas/ de ltar yang*/ kun tu bzang po'i lus ni nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// thams cad zhing la mi gnas de bzhin nyid la gnas// zhes gsungs/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams chos kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad na/ bdag pos yongs su bzung ba med pa'i chu gtsang gi rnam pa ji snyed cig yod pa dang*/ de bzhin du me tog dang bdug pa dang mar me dang dri dang zhal zas kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa thams cad 'di rang nyid kyis bdag tu cag gis bzung la phul gsol cig

gzhan yang rin po che'i ri bo/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog phu chu'i rgyun sgra/ ar mo li ka'i rdo leb/ dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa chen po/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po la sogs pa mchod par 'os pa mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad bdag tu cag gis bzung la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du phul gsol cig gzhan yang rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun dang*/ de dang nye ba'i rin po che bdun yang dbul/ 'gro ba'i mgon po phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas/ dang po gsang sngags kyi mchod pa ltar ma byed gsung ba'i bka' rgya byung*/ de'i rjes la byas kyang gtub gsung ba'i bka' rgya glod pa dang*/ de'i rjes la cis kyang gyis gsung ba'i bka' gnang byung bas/ nga 'bus kyang de ltar byas pas/ 'dir rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yo ga'i rjes su 'brangs nas/ gang yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'am gang yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyi klas par thams cad na lha dang mi thams cad kyi dga' ba dang dgod pa dang*/ rtsed 'jo'i bde ba'i bye brag ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyang bdag tu bzung la dbul/ gzhan yang gzugs sdug gu/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro mngar ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ mdor na mchod par 'os pa mchod pa'i bkod pa ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad rang nyid kyis bdag tu bzung la sems bskyed pa'i yon du dbul/ de la yongs su bzung ba med pa 'di la/ kha cig shing byas bzung*/ chu nyas bzung ba la sogs brtag dpyad byed de/ de ltar byas na dbul rgyu'i dngos po mi rnyed pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba med pas thams cad dbul du gtub pa yin/ gzhan yang mchod khang gong 'og 'di dag thams cad na ji ltar bshams pa'i mchod pa kha che gur gum gyi yon chab dang me tog bdug pa/ mar me dri dang zhal zas gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan bla re la sogs pa mchod pa'i bkod pa thams cad dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten ji snyed cig bzhugs pa thams cad nga 'bus khyed la byin pa yin pas/

de thams cad bdag tu gzung la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i yon du phul gsol zhig gtor ma 'di yang chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la dbul/ gzhan yang khyed rang thams cad kyis thog mtha' bar gsum du bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ bla na med pa'i dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi phyogs su zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog bsnyen bkur ba ji ltar byas pa thams cad dran par mdzod la so sor phul gsol cig gzhan yang nga 'bu 'bri gung 'dir phyin nas de sngon phan chad 'bul ba dang zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog ji snyed cig phul ba dang*/ phyin chad ji snyed cig 'bul ba dang*/ da ltar khyed rang gis ji ltar phul ba thams cad blos phyogs gcig tu bsdus la phul gsol cig /de rdzas rim par bshams pa'i mchod pa lags/ gzhan yang rang gi lus 'bul ba 'di gal che ste/ lus ma phul kyang myur du 'jig pa yin pas phul na bsod nams dpag tu med pa 'byung la/ de yang bran g.yog tu phul na rje dpon la sogs thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rang gi lus phul na mnyes/ zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi lus po 'di bla ma dam pa dang bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gi bran dang g.yog tu 'bul/ lus de la nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas yo byad khar rje dbang thang mthu dang nus pa dang mnga' ris dang phyogs ris bsod nams ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad kyang sems bskyed pa'i yon du dbul/ gzhan yang yul ris dang rgyal khams so so rang nyid kyis bdag tu bzung ba gang yin pa de yang dbul/ 'di shin tu gal che bas nged pha spad la phun sum tshogs pa 'di snyed cig yod kyang gnas 'di dog pos sun pas 'di yang sngon yul ma phul ba'i skyon yin/ yul ris dang rgyal khams phul na phul ba dang longs spyod pa'i bsod nams gnyis ka thob ste/ de yang sngon rgyal po lus mi bde bas mtshams med pa'i las byas pas/

'chi ka'i dus su drang srong dgos pa med par byams pa la nga'i yul ris dang rgyal khams thams cad khyod la dbul/ khyod kyi chos gang yin pa de la skyabs su mchi'o byas pas/ lha'i bu nor bu snying po dri ma med par skyes pa/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud du gsungs pa lta bu yin pas 'di bsod nams shin tu che ba yin pas bsam pa rgya che ba yul 'khor rgya chen po phul na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'am sprul pa'i sku'i zhing khams sam/ longs spyod rdzogs pa sku'i zhing khams 'thob pa'i rgyu yin/ de lus 'bul ba'i mchod pa bgyi ba lags te/ kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa yi// mchod pa rnam pa bdun dag bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i don lags/ da ni sdig pa bshags pa zhig bgyi bas/ de yang thar pa chen po las/ rgyal bu dge mthong zhes bya bas mi sum stong gi sdig pa yang phyogs gcig tu bshags pa byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyal rigs dra ma chen mo legs so legs so// khyod bdag nyid kyi sdig pa bshags pa'i steng du sems can thams cad kyang sdig pa dang bral bar byas pa rgyal rigs dra ma chen po khyod kyang legs so// da ni khyod rnams byang chub sems dpar gyur te/ mthar rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya'o// zhes gsungs pas 'di lag len du bgyi bas/ rang nyid dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus ngag yid gsum la brten te sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis pa thams cad shin tu ma legs so snyam du 'gyod pa drag po re re bskyed/ sdig pa mi dge ba de dag thams cad bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar so sor bshags pas so sor bshags so snyam du bshags pa re re bya/ da phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi dge ba gtan du mi bya'o snyam du shes pa la gnag

sdig pa mi dge ba mi byed pa la bsten pa bla ma dam pa dang*/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la bsten par bya'o snyam du dam bca'o// de ltar stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pas rtsa ba nas 'dag par gsungs pa la/ gnyen po la the tshom zos pas ma dag snyam na de nyid nyes pa che ba yin/ spyir bshags pa 'di la yang*/ 'dul ba la dge 'dun gtso bor gyur pas bshags pa dang las thams cad dge 'dun gyis byed/ gsang sngags la sangs rgyas gtso bor gyur pas zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum sangs rgyas gcig tu byas pas 'dag 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa chos gtso bor gyur pas/ snying brtser ldan zhing byams phyir dang*// sems dge ba la nyes pa med// ces pas byams snying rje dang ma bral na nyes ltung gis ma gos pa dang*/ nyes ltung byung yang byang chub kyi sems gcig pus 'joms te/ des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig pa rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par bsreg par byed// ces gsungs so// yang rjes su yi rang ba 'di bsod nams che ste phrag dog med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan gyis byas pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam pa dang lhag par 'thob pa rgyal po gsal rgyal la mu to ba rjes su yi rang ba thob pa dang 'dra ste 'di gal che bas 'di ltar dus gsum gyi 'phags pa thams cad kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dang*/ rang gzhan thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mdor na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsod nams thams cad la bdag dga' zhing rjes su yi rang ngo snyam du rjes su yi rang ba re re dbul/ rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas btugs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa rnams kyi spyan sngar rang nyid tshangs pa'i rgyal po chen po ni byas/

khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad ni khrid/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med pa bskor bar mdzad du gsol zhes bskul ma gdab/ sangs rgyas nas chos mi gsung ba la bskul ma gdab zer te/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas nas chos mi gsung ba ni mi srid mod kyi/ 'on kyang bskul ma dang gsol ba btab nas ji srid du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i bsod nams 'thob pa dang*/ dngos su tshangs pa'i rgyal por gyur nas gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ rang nyid kyis 'chi ba med pa'i bdud rtsi thob pa'i rgyu yang da ltar gyi skul ma 'debs pa dang*/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di yin pas/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad la bskul ma dang gsol ba gdab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar bzhed pa rnams kyi spyan sngar/ rang nyid 'chi ba med pa'i zhal zas bdud rtsi ni thogs/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad ni khrid/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de ltar rang nyid dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces bsngo bar mdzad/ de bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa las byang chub kyi sems skye bgyi ba lags pas yan lag bdun pa 'di tshar gsum gsung bar zhu/ ji snyed su dag sogs tshar re re la rol mo re bya/ gnyis pa skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can bgyi bas/ yang 'di ltar sems can thams cad bdag gi ma yin snyam du bsam/ bdag gi ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam du bsam/

snying rje bar gyur pa'i ma 'di dag thams cad bdag gi bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis sangs rgyas la ston par bya/ theg pa chen po dam pa'i chos la lam du bya/ sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs su bya/ bdag nges par jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi'o snyam du bsam la/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang sogs rol chen/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par phul la/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas gzung nas ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ slob dpon gyis/ thabs yin no// slob mas/ legs so// zhes brjod/ de skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can lags te/ de'i phan yon dang bslab bya thams cad rgyas par gzhan du shes par mdzod/ bsdus na skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba dang khyad par ba'i khyad par/ yul dang*/ dus dang*/ bsam pa'i ched du bya ba gsum las/ dang po thun mong ba'i skyabs gnas yul dkon mchog gsum ni/ chos kyi sku las dang nyon mongs pa dang bral tsam gyis 'gog pa'i bden pa/

longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po mchog gi sprul pa nyan thos mchog brgyad/ dman pa'i sprul pa stag dang ri bong la sogs pa ste de ltar sku gsum mo// lung gi chos gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ rtogs pa'i chos 'gog pa dang lam gyi bden pa/ dge 'dun gsol ba dang gzhi'i las kyis bsnyen par rdzogs pa yan chad nas/ skyes bu zung bzhi/ gang zag ya brgyad man chad/ dus ji srid 'tsho/ bsam pa ched du bya ba rang nyid zhi bde'i thar pa thob par 'dod pa'o// khyad par skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum la/ chos sku ni khams rang bzhin gyis dag pa dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma dag pa/ dag pa gnyis ldan dri ma med pa chos kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ye shes kyi sku can/ sku la zhing khams thams cad snang zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad/ mchog gi sprul pa bcom ldan 'das bstan pa'i bdag po/ dman pa'i sprul pa nyan thos mchog brgyad/ skye ba'i sprul pa stag dang ri bong la sogs pas sems can gyi don byed pa'o// dam pa'i chos zhes don dam pa byang chub kyi sems/ dge 'dun dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'/ dus snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar/ bsam pa ched du bya ba byang chub kyi sems kyis 'gro ba thams cad byang chub la 'god pa'o// phan yon dang bslab bya ni thun mong dang gzhan 'dra ba las/ khyad par ni thun mong ba rang nyid gcig pu nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud pas/ 'dir khyad par bas/ rang nyid nang pa sangs rgyas par tshud par mi tshad/ 'gro ba gzhan thams cad kyang sangs rgyas par 'dzud pa dang*/ theg pa chen po la sogs pa sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa dang*/ sdig pa thams cad zad cing srab par 'gyur ba dang*/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po 'phel bar 'gyur ba dang*/

shi nas ngan song ngan 'gro log par mi ltung ba dang*/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba dang*/ mthar rang gzhan thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang brgyad do// bslab bya ni/ dang po thun mong gi bslab bya srog dang bya dga'i ched du yang lha dkon mchog gsum mi spang ba dang*/ dgos pa gal chen po la thabs gzhan mi btsal ba dang*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab par bya ba dang*/ phyogs gang dang gang du 'gro ba de'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab pa lnga'o// bye brag so so'i bslab bya drug ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song nas lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal ba dang*/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spang ba dang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song nas mi mu stegs can mi bsten pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la ma gus pa spang zhing gus pa bsgrub pa gsum dang drug go// yang skyabs 'gro khyad par can byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas/ sems bskyed dang rgyu dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gang gis 'byed na/ sems can gyi don du skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pas 'byed pas/ gnad 'dis rgyu dang 'bras bur 'ong ba yin no// gsum pa tshad med pa bzhis blo sbyang ba bgyi bas/ yang 'di ltar sems can thams cad bdag gi ma yin snyam du bsam/ de byams pa yin/ bdag gi ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad skye ba gnas bzhi 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa 'di rnams snying re rje snyam du bsam/ de snying rje yin/ snying rje bar gyur pa'i ma 'di rnams bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung snyam du bde ba ldan par dga' ba dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar dga' ba bsgom/ de dga' ba yin/ de bde ba dang ldan par dga'/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar dga' yang bde ba ni med/

sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por 'khyams pa'i ma 'di rnams bdag gis bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar bya/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya'o snyam du bsam/ de chags pa med par gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa byang chub kyi sems btang snyoms bya ba yin/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la/ sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu nges pa byang chub kyi sems yin pas/ bdag gi bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di la byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du bsam la/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pas/ khyod kyis bla ma la bdag gi bla ma 'di yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin nges snyam du yang dang yang du 'du shes bskyed/ bla ma la so so skye bo'i 'du shes skyes na byang chub kyi sems gtan du mi skye/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'du shes skyes na skye'am mi skye the tshom za ste mi skye/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes na byang chub kyi sems skye bar jo bo chen pos gsungs pas/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu dang rol chen/ skabs 'dir ji ltar 'byor ba'i sems bskyed yon me tog phul nas/ 'dir nga 'bus shin tu zab pa'i chos thun gcig bshad pas khyed thams cad kyis de go// de go bas rdzas dang yo byad rang gi gces pa'i bu tshun chad slob dpon la phul bas/ chos 'dis mi snying yang 'khrul/ snum snying yang thon/ 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'byung*/ rtsa ba'i chos 'di go ba'i dus su thub pa'i chos ma lus pa thams cad kyang lag pa'i mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa ltar mngon du gyur nas/ sbrul la mdud pa bor ba bzhin du rang grol du 'gro bas spyir chos 'di go dgos/

go rgyu'i chos de gang yin na/ 'di ltar nged rang thams cad skyes zin/ slan chad 'chi 'am mi 'chi snyam du bsam/ de 'chi bar nges so// shi nas pha rol tu skye'am mi skye snyam du brtag par bya ste skye bar nges so// skye na lus 'di pha rol tu skye'am sems skye snyam du bsam/ de lus 'byung ba bzhis bsdus pa 'di mi skye ste/ 'dir 'jog pas ro zhes zer ba yin/ sems dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyis ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur bas de yang mi skye/ 'o na gang skye na/ rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa 'di skye bas/ 'dir zhe sdang la mtshon na/ rgyu rang la zhe sdang gi bag chags kyi sa bon yod pa/ de rkyen pha bsad pa'i lag dmar ba mthong na zhe sdang gi rtog pa thol gyis skye/ de la goms shing 'dris par byas pas shi khar zhe sdang gi mtshams sbyar na dmyal bar skye ste/ de yang zhe sdang de shi bas dmyal bar skyes pa min/ zhe sdang de nyid kyi rang gzugs dmyal ba yin/ de ltar yang*/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs de dag gang las byung*// de 'dra de dag thams cad ni// sdig sems byung bar thub pas gsungs// zhes gsungs pas des na 'chi kha'i bsam sbyor gang skyes pa de nyid kyi lus su gyur pa la thogs pa med de/ chos kyi rgyal po mya ngan med kyang shi khar g.yog mos nor bu'i yu ba can gyi bsil yab kyis brang du phog pas/ de la zhe sdang phra mo byung bas sbrul du skyes pa lta bu yin/ de dang 'dra bar chags pas yi dwags dang*/ rmongs pas dud 'gro'i rang gzugs su 'gyur ba lags/ de bzhin du da lta khyed kyi rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye byed kyi rgyu bzhi ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ rkyen bla ma dam pas byas nas/ rgyu rkyen 'dzoms pa las byang chub kyi sems skye/ skyes pa de la goms shing 'dris par byas pas/ shi khar byang chub kyi sems kyis mtshams sbyar na/

pha rol tu nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ byang chub thob par byed pa'i lus su 'grub ste/ de yang byang chub kyi sems shi bas sangs rgyas su skyes pa min/ byang chub kyi sems de'i rang gzugs la sangs rgyas zer bas/ de ltar yang*/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin sku// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// zhes gsungs pa yin/ des na byang chub kyi sems ci tsam skyes pa'i kha tshon du/ rab sangs rgyas/ 'bring byang chub sems dpa'/ tha ma yang dkon mchog gsum dang mi 'bral ba zhig 'ong ste/ 'dir byams pa gcig pu la mtshon na/ wā rā ṇa sīr rgyal po tshangs byin gyi bran mo'i bu chung ngu chus khyer ba la byams pa skyes pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten du skyes pa lta bu yin/ de dang 'dra bar byang chub kyi sems las sangs rgyas 'byung bar nges te/ de mi 'ong na zhe sdang las kyang dmyal ba mi 'byung bar rigs pas/ 'di mtshungs par 'grel ba lags/ de lta bu'i rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa sa bon rnam par shes pa re res lus 'grub pa 'di la rten 'brel zer bas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sā lu ljang pa'i mdor/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di rtag pa ma yin/ chad pa ma yin/ 'pho ba ma yin/ rgyu chung ngu las 'bras bu chen po 'byung ba/ de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud du gtogs pa/ zhes gsungs/ rgyu mtshan des sems rtag pa med/ de rtag na skyer mi gtub/ des na rtag pa ma yin/ sems chad pa med de chad na skye ba'i rgyu med/ des na chad pa ma yin/ sems tshur rol na yod pa zhig pha rol tu 'phos pa ma yin/ rgyu chung ngu las kyang 'bras bu chen po 'byung*/ byung ba de yang de dang 'dra ba'i rgyud du gtogs pa yin pas de tshogs pa las byung ba rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel yin/ rgyu 'bras de nyid spros pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i stong nyid du gnas te/

de ltar yang*/ gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// de la skye ba'i rang bzhin yod ma yin// rkyen las gang skyes de ni stong nyid gsungs// stong nyid shes te rab tu bag yod pa'o// zhes gsungs pas de rtogs shing mngon du byas pa'ang sangs rgyas yin/ des na thub pa'i chos rnams kyi rten 'brel 'di kho na yin pas/ slob dpon 'phags pas kyang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi// gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// 'di ni gang gis yang dag mthong ba des// sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnam mchog mthong*// zhes gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rten 'brel du go dgos rten 'brel 'di las 'das nas nam mthar lhung ba na mu stegs byed yin te rtag chad du lta ba la sogs pa lta log sum brgya drug cu rgya gar la yod/ bod la mu stegs byed med zer yang bon po 'di ni mu stegs byed kyi bye brag yin pas/ dang po ye med stong pa las/ de las ye yod cung zad tsam srid/ zer ba chad lta yin/ mi shi ba mir skye/ rta shi ba rtar skye zer nas/ rta gsod pa dang*/ lug gsod pa la sogs pa 'di rnams rtag lta yin te log par lta ba yin/ de yang sngon mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyi blon po ngan lam rta ra glu gong shi bas/ bon pos shid byas shing*/ rtag par lta ba bzung ba la/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis lta ba log pa thams cad bshig ste dkon mchog gi zhabs tog tu bsgyur bas/ de lta bu yang bsam pa skad cig ma'i rten 'brel tshogs pa las 'grub pa 'di ma go ba bstan pa yin/ de ltar rten 'brel bzang ngan bde sdug thams cad bsam pa'i rang gzugs su mthong ba'i dus su rgyu rkyen las skyes pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis sangs rgyas 'grub par mngon sum du mthong ste/ bskal pa bgrang mi dgos/ shin tu zhan pa la bzhad gad dam g.yo sgyus kyang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sangs rgya bar nges pa lags/

de yang bcom ldan 'das kyis dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo gsungs pa'i tshe bdud sdig can gyis bar chad brtsams pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis zhags pa'i bcing ba rnam pa lnga bcings pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pas/ sdig can khyod byang chub sems bskyed cig dang*/ zhags pa'i 'ching ba las grol bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pas/ khos sems bskyed pas zhags pa'i 'ching ba las grol ba dang bcom ldan 'das kyis/ sdig can khyod ma 'ongs pa'i dus rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan pas/ bdud kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ni sems las ni las/ las las las kyi 'bras bu rnam par smin pa zhes ma bshad dam/ nga la byang chub 'dod pa'i bsam pa med pas lung ston pa mi rigs so zhes zhus pas/ sdig can khyod du ma zad ma 'ongs pa na khyod 'dra ba sems bskyed pa mang po 'byung ste de dag kyang 'tshang rgya bar de nyid lung ston to zhes gsungs pas/ g.yo dang sgyus sems bskyed pa yang sangs rgya na/ khyed zhe thag pa nas byang chub 'dod pa ci'i phyir sangs mi rgya/ 'di lta bu'i phan yon mthong nas sems bskyed kyis byas pa la/ kha cig na re sems lta ngas bskyed na bslab pa sus bsrung zer bar gda' ste/ sems bskyed pa po bdag rtag pa cig yod nas/ sems de de'i khyad par gyi chos bdag gi rgyan nam thod bzhin du 'ong ba min/ bslab bya yang sems bskyed pa de nyid kyis bsrung ba ma gtogs pa bdag bsrung mkhan cig yod pa ma lags/ des na bdag med pas na rten 'brel rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ skad cig ma bsam pa'i rang gzugs 'di las med/ rgyu mtshan des byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas kyi rgyu nges pa lags pas/ khyed kyis bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu ji snyed sogs tshar gcig dang rol chen bya/

lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par phul la/ dang por rang nyid byang chub sems dpa' par khas blang bar bgyi bas me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon byang chub sems dpa'/ bdag byang chub sems dpar gzung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ des byang chub sems dpar khas blangs nas/ da byang chub kyi sems la dam bca' ba bgyi bas/ yang snga ma rten sprul pa bzhin du/ bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang bcas pa thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu sogs dang rol chen/ rang gi lus dang longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par sing gis dbul/ de nas de rnams dpang por bzhag nas bdag gi phung po bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bya ba dang nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las ma dgrol ba rnams dgrol bar bya ba dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa las dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bya ba dang*/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa'i sems can thams cad mya ngan las 'das pa chen pos yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya'o snyam du dam bca' mdzod la/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/

ji ltar thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o// ma dgrol ba rnams dgrol ba bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ des khyed kyis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob pa lags/ thob pa'i sems de gang yin na/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya snyam pa de lags/ byang chub kyi sems de rdzogs par byed pa la bslab bya 'di rnams la slob dgos pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa la bslab/ phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba la bslab/ spel zhing sbyang ba la bslab/ sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos rnam pa bzhi la bslab par bya ste/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par mdzod/ de la mdor bsdu na bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa 'di smon pa skyed byed kyi rgyu/ smon pa'i sems bskyed nas bslab bya/ 'jug pa'i sdom pa'i ngo bo/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi dam tshig sangs rgyas pa'i dus su sku gsum dbye ba med pa/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun chad med par sems can thams cad byang chub la 'god par 'gyur bas bsod nams kyi tshogs pha rol tu phyin pa drug nyams su blang ste/ de yang sbyin pa'i dngos po shin tu phra ba zhig kyang byang chub kyi sems kyi dbang byas pas/ 'bras bu nam mkha' dang mnyam par sems can ma zad kyi bar du 'byung*/ tshul de dang 'dra bar tshul khrims nas shes rab kyi bar du thams cad kyang rgya chen por 'gyur bas de ltar bslab/

de yang thams cad mkhyen pa ni rgyu gcig gis ma yin/ rkyen gcig gis ma yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig gis ma yin zhes gsungs pas dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag la chog shes pa med par 'bad pa chen po gal che/ gnyis pa phan yon ni/ spyir byang chub kyi sems la phan yon dpag tu med kyang*/ mdor bsdus na thog ma dang bar dang tha mar dge ba gsum yin te/ thog mar dge ba tshe 'di'i bde ba dang skyid pa'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang 'byung bas/ de ltar yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten na yod na/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba nas/ 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad yod par gsungs te/ thog mar dge ba nga 'bu lta bu yin pas ngas byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pa las/ 'khor 'di snyed dang grags pa dang snyan pa 'di tsam pa byung ba yin/ bar du dge ba ngan song gsum du mi 'gro zhing*/ sa dang lam gyi yon tan thams cad 'byung ste/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang gis bla ma rnams kyi rnam par thar pa ltar kha zas phru ba re res kyang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mchod pa dang*/ sems can thams cad smin par nus pas dge bsnyen ma phul du phyin pa lta bu lags/ tha mar dge ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyang 'thob ste/ de ltar yang byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas byang chub kyi sems med na sangs rgyas mi 'byung ba yin/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi bde legs ji snyed pa byang chub kyi sems las 'byung bas/ rgya cher stug po bkod pa dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa la sogs pa ji ltar gsungs pa thams cad dran par bya/ spel zhing sbyang ba ni/ nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/ces yang dang yang du sbyang*/ gong ma rnams gsung*/ nga 'bu ltar na de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs pa'i smon lam bzhin du/ gom pa 'degs 'jog gi bar du yang byang chub kyi sems mi brjed par/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub dam pa thob par gyur cig ces/ dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis spel/ sdig pa mi dge ba dang nyes pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis sbyang bar bya/ mdor na bya byed ci byed pa thams cad byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral bas chog pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ sems bskyed pa thams cad la byang chub kyi sems sngon du 'gro ste tha na nyon mongs pa'i sems la yang rung na dge ba'i sems la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ bskal pa'i me'i dpes sdig pa zad cing*/ byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin par mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen por de nyid kyis 'gyur te/ deng sang rngon pa thams cad kyang sems can bsad pa'i rgyu lto dang*/ zar mi rung ba bya khyi la byin nas sangs rgyas thob gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod na nag po'i chos yin te/ de ltar yang bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi// sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs// legs spyad gang yin de kun yang*// khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed// ces gsungs pas tshig gi rkang pa la ring thung med/ tshig lhug pa yin kyang spang*/ de'i steng du byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang bsngags pa brjod de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blangs/ gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa rang gzhan gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba la khyod kyis 'di ma legs zhes zhes 'gyod pa bskyed na nag po'i chos yin te/ de ltar yang*/ gang zhig dge ba byed mthong nas// 'phya zhing bkur te ma mos na/

dkon mchog gsum gyi rigs kyang gcod// mtshams med pas kyang dmyal bar 'gro// zhes gsungs pas 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa spang*/ de'i steng du dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba bsgom/ de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blangs/ sems can la g.yo sgyu dang bslu brid kyis gnod pa byed na nag po'i chos yin te/ de ltar yang*/ drang po'i chos kyis 'jig rten kun tu bde// g.yo sgyu gya gyus mdza' bshes sun par byed// phrad na lha 'dra 'grogs na sha za 'dra// g.yo dang sgyus ni srid pa gsum yang phung*// zhes pas sems can la g.yo sgyus spyod pa spang*/ de'i steng du phan pa dang bde ba rgya chen po bsgrub pa de dkar po'i chos yin pas nyams su blang*/ de nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos rnam pa bzhi la bslab pa lags/ de la nag po'i chos bzhi po 'di spyad nas thun tshod las 'das na sdom pa 'chor bar 'dod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyis 'phags pa dkon mchog rtsegs pa la sogs par brjed pa'i rgyur gsungs pa dang*/ bsod nams thams cad bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mdo las/ tshan po che dri ma med pa'i gtam rgyud las kyang brjed pa'i rgyur gsungs pas de ltar shes par bya/ byang chub kyi sems lan cig bskyed pa de yang*/ rdo rje rin po che 'dra ba las dang nyon mongs pa'i mes zhu bar mi nus te/ mthar sangs rgyas kyi sar 'byung bar gsungs pas rtsa ba nas 'chor bar mi nus pa yin/ des khyed kyi smon pa sems bskyed pa'i cho ga phan yon bslab bya dang bcas pa tshar bar lags// //da 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhu ba la maṇ+ḍal/ sa gzhi spos byug ji snyed su dag sogs rol chen/ yang khyed la 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yang bgyi bas/ 'jug pa 'di la dpon slob phyogs gcig tu smon lam btab pas/ slob mas khas blangs ni che/

nyams blangs ni chung bas nyes pa spyad na be'u sbrel g.yang la lhung ba bzhin du dpon slob gnyis ka dmyal bar 'gro zer nas mkhas pa chen po rnams rtsag par gda'/ 'on kyang 'di ltar mchi bas/ sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis pa dang*/ bgyid du stsal ba dang*/ bgyis pa la rjes su yi rang ba gsum gyis sbrel na ngan song du 'brel bas 'gro la/ 'dir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa dge ba'i rtsa ba dang sbrel bas bya rgod kyi sbu gseb tu pha wang nyal ba dang 'dra bas/ dgung tud dang yang tud du 'ong bas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pas chog pa yin/ de yang dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po don stengs pa de mtho dman med pa thams cad la 'jug pa sems bskyed mdzad pa la/ khong gi slob dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen ya gad pa bya ba des/ khyod su snang snang la 'jug pa sems bskyed ma byed gsungs pas/ 'di mi byed kha med pa cig byung bas rmi lam na rje btsun byams pa srid pa'i 'khor lha ma srin sde brgyad la sogs pa 'khor dpag tu med pa la sems bskyed mdzad pa la/ khong gi lag na lcam pa'i me tog ngan ne ba tshan cig 'dug pa gtor nas sems bskyed zhus pas/ me tog de dag dbu gtsug gi drang thad kyi nam mkha' la gdugs chen po zhig tu gyur pas de la dga' ba skyes/ de'i dus su rje btsun gyi zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis thams cad la sems bskyed gyis shig dang*/ thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs nas/ de ltar bgyis pa lags zhes zhus pas/ 'o na khyed rang gi a ka ma rnams kyang bos/ nga yang zhu gsung nas khong gis kyang zhus pa yin/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen don stengs pa de la/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pas zhus pa lags/ gnyis par na sems bskyed nas nyes pa spyad pas ngan 'gror ltung yang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma des/ de nyid la brten nas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal thams cad sbyang zhing*/

yon tan rgya chen po thob par byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos 'khor lnga brgya sems bskyed la bkod pas/ de dag gi nyes pa spyad pas rta lnga brgyar skyes pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' nyi ma'i snying pos rta'i rgyal po cang shes su skye ba bzhes te/ yul sgra mthar bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas pa rang rang gi phyag gi skal pa phyed phyed phul nas bshags pa byas pas nyes pa dag nas tshe 'phos te byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob pa lta bur 'ong bas/ nga 'bu yang rang nyid bde ba dang skyid pa'i sar bsdad snyam pa med/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ci byas pa yang sems can la bsngos shing 'gro ba'i don du dmyal bar 'jug par yang spro bas/ da lta nga'i drung du sems bskyed byed dgos pa yin/ gsum pa rang nyid kyis 'dren par mi nus na yang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon du byas nas/ mchod pa rgya chen po phul zhing sems bskyed nas smon lam btab pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'od zer bkye bas ngan 'gro'i gnas stongs par mdzad par 'ong ste/ de'i rgyud lta sems bskyed pa la sogs pa dge ba'i sa bon med na 'od zer gyis smin par mi nus pas/ rgyu 'di lta bu la bsten nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las 'jug pa/ thub pa chen po dga' ldan nas lhums su 'jug pa'i dus su 'od zer bkye bas/ bsam pa bzang po sad par gyur te ngan 'gro'i gnas stongs par byas nas lam gyi rten la bkod par gsungs pa lta bu yin/ de lta bu'i 'jug pa sems bskyed pa 'di yang rgyu rkyen rnam pa gnyis las skye bas/ rkyen bla ma dam pas byas nas rgyu smon pa brtan pa dang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyes pa gnyis yin/ smon pa brtan pa lags te gong du bgyis nas nyes pas ma gos/ bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed pa gal che bas/

yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod cig me tog 'bras bu ji snyed sogs rol chen/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par dbul la/ 'jug pa'i chos bcu yin pas/ sbyor ba gsol ba gdab pa/ bskul ba/ bar chad dri ba/ spro ba bskyed pa/ bslab pa'i gzhi mdorabasdus brjod pa dang lnga/ dngos gzhi sdom pa sbyin pa dang drug rjes mkhyen par gsol ba/ phan yon bshad pa/ bslab bya bstan pa/ gya tshom du mi brjod pa dang bzhi ste bcu yin pa las thog mar gsol ba gdab pas rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon khyed las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len par 'tshal gyis/ gnod pa ma mchis na myur du stsal cing gnang bar rigs so// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ de ltar gsol ba btab kyang ma bskul na/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa myur du mi 'thob pas/ yang myur du gnang ba'i phyir sdom pa bskul bas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu sogs dang rol chen/ lus longs spyod thams cad kyang dbul/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon gyis bdag la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blang ba myur du stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ de ltar myur du bskul yang bar chad dang bcas na mi 'ong bas bar chad dri bas/ rigs kyi bu/ khyed byang chub sems dpa' yin nam yin lags bya/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/ btab lags bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la bslabs sam/ bslabs lags bya/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la slob bam/ slob lags bya/ des bar chad med pa yin/

de yang khyed byang chub sems dpa' yin nam bya ba de/ gong du smon pa'i sems thob bam bya ba yin/ smon lam btab bam bya ba de dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad du byang chub tu bsngos sam bya ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod la bslabs sam bya ba gong du bslabs pa dang*/ ma bslabs su zin kyang phyin chad slob par khas blangs pas bar chad dang bral ba yin no// de ltar bar chad dang bral ba de la slob dpon gyis spro ba bskyed pas/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mi zad pa'i gter mdzod byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa de/ bdag gi bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'di las ring por mi thogs par thob par 'dug ang snyam pa'i dga' ba re re bsgom/ dga' ba dang bcas pa de la sdom pa thob par 'dod dam zhes dri bas yang bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu ji snyed sogs dang rol chen/ lus longs spyod thams cad dbul/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la thugs ma yengs bar dung nge mdzod/ rjes zlos bya mi dgos/ rigs kyi bu khyed bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa len par 'dod dam zhes lan gsum dang*/ slob mas/ 'dod lags/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ de ltar dris nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len par 'dod pa de la bslab pa'i gzhi mdor bsdus pa brjod pas/ 'dul bar ni sdom pa sngon la phog nas bslab bya rjes la ston par gsungs la byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la ni bslab par bya ba sngon du btang nas/ rjes la sdom pa sbyin par gsungs pas/ 'dir de la thob rgyu'i sdom pa de gang yin snyam na/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag byed pa'i sdom pa dang*/

sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims sems can thams cad kyi don byed pa'i sdom pa dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi sdom pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi bsam pa sdom pa dam 'cha' ba lags pas/ yang khyed kyis bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu sogs dang rol chen/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par sing gis dbul/ skabs 'dir yon ci 'byor pa dbul/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la yid dung nge mdzod/ rjes zlos bya mi dgos/ nga 'bus lan gsum brjod cing khyed kyis lan gsum dam bca' ba'i cha tha ma la khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thob pa lags/ rigs kyi bu khyed bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa dang*/ da ltar phyogs bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ tshul khrims gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi gang dag dang*/ tshul khrims gang dag la 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bslabs pa dang*/ ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob pa dang*/ da ltar bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob par mdzad pa'i bslab pa'i gzhi rnams dang*/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang*/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dang*/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims rnams len par 'dod dam/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ 'dod lags zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ des khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thob pa lags pas/

thob pa la thob par shes par mdzod/ bar 'dir smon lam gdab cing mkhyen par gsol ba bgyi bas/ yang mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod cig me tog 'bras bu sogs dang rol chen/ lus longs spyod ltos pa med par sing gis dbul/ de nas bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis phyag brkyang nas/ khyed rang gi srin lag dang phyogs gcig tu sbrel nas/ dus da nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems dang skad cig kyang mi 'bral ba dang khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyal mtsho las dbugs 'byin pa'i smon lam gdab pas rjes zlos mdzod cig ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po ma stongs kyi bar du byang chub kyi sems dang de ston pa'i bla ma dang nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig khams gsum gyi 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las dbugs 'byin par gyur cig ces brjod cing 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho nas then par bsgom zhing langs/ nyung na slob dpon gyis re re nas smon lam gdab cing then la bslang la snyim pa nas kyi bkang thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ slob dpon gyis/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di rnams kyis bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blangs pa yang dag par blangs pa lan gsum gyi bar du blangs pa las/ 'phags pa'i chos lkog tu gyur kyang phyogs bcu 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ thams cad na ches lkog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo// zhes lan gsum brjod cing phyogs bcur me tog gtor zhing phyag 'tshal lo// da ni phan yon bshad pas/

de ltar khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blangs/ nga 'bus phog pa'i bar der sangs rgyas thams cad dang chos nyid gcig pas rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams thams cad du sa chen po rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba dang*/ 'ja'i tshogs 'khrugs pa dang*/ spos kyi ngad ldang ba dang*/ me tog gi char 'bab pa la sogs pa 'byung ba lags par gda'/ da lta 'dir khyed kyis mchod pa ji ltar phul ba 'di thams cad dbri bskyed med par 'byung gzhan dag zer te/ ras yug dang dpag tu med par 'phel nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyan sngar 'byung bas/ bdud kyi gnas nas bdud kyi bu mo lnga sangs rgyas 'od ma'i tshal na bzhugs pa'i dus su me tog gtor bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la gdugs su gyur pa dang*/ grong khyer chen po dge bar pha rol tu 'gro bar khyim bdag phya mkhan gza' mi gnyis kyis bcom ldan 'das spyan drangs pa'i phyir/ spos bsregs pas rgyal byed kyi tshul du sprin gyi phung po lta bur gyur pa dang*/ me tog gtor bas me tog gi char dang chu sbrengs pa bai ḍūr+ya'i phur ma lta bur gyur pa dang 'dra bar khyed kyi mchod pa thams cad 'byung ba yin/ de lta bu byung ba'i dus su so so sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na dbang thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' re res bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das sngar ma mthong ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma 'di dag 'byung ba'i rgyu gang lags/ rkyen gang lags zhu ba zhus pas/ rigs kyi bu da ltar mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams na bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di zhes bya ba la/ byang chub sems dpa' 'di dang 'di rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blangs so zhes mkhyen par 'gyur te/ de ltar yang*/ deng 'dir bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su da gyur to// zhes gsungs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sras dam par dgongs/

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni spun drung por dgongs te de ltar yang*/ de tshe de la dge ba'i phyir// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// dge ba'i thugs kyis rtag par yang*// bu sdug 'dra bar dgongs par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas khyed kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni pha'i 'du shes bzhag byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni spun drung po'i 'du shes bzhag byang chub kyi sems la ni mi zad pa'i gter mdzod kyi 'du shes bzhag ste/ de ring nas gsung rab thams cad du kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bya ba de yang khyed rang rnams la zer ba yin/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo bya ba de yang khyed rang rnams la zer ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa dang*/ rab tu byung ba dang*/ khye'u dang bu mo'i gzugs su 'dug pa bya ba de yang khyed rang rnams la zer ba yin pas/ byang chub kyi sems yod med ma gtogs pa med/ de yang slong mo ba rgyal ba srung dang khye'u pa rgyal ba srung ltar byis pa dang sprang por gyur kyang byang chub tu sems bskyed pas byang chub sems dpar gyur pa dang 'dra bas/ khyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs kyi khur khur la 'bad pa chen po bya/ bslab bya ji lta bu la bslabs na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod mtha' dag dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi don bsdus pa slob dpon chen po thogs med kyi byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ de bsdus pa sdom pa nyi shu par gsungs pa'i pham pa dang 'dra ba'i ltung ba bzhi dang nyes byas bzhi bcu rtsa drug la sogs pa dang*/ slob dpon shan+ta de wa'i rjes su 'brangs pa byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i phyogs bstan pa mtha' dag gsungs pa de dag thams cad la bslab par bya/ 'dir gdams ngag mdor bsdus na/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims dkar po phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba pha rol tu phyin pa drug la sogs pa mtha' dag thams cad la dam bcas pas nus tshad lcogs tshad la 'bad/

sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can gyi don lcogs tshad du byas/ de yang 'tshams po la 'tshams po/ rgyal po la dkar yol/ sprang po la pha 'bab/ long sprang la yon/ khyi la khrud ma/ ba lang la gzar rtswa/ bu spad la bza' btung ste sems can gyi don du 'gyur tshad bya/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sems sdom pa dang*/ so so thar pa ris bdun gang yang rung ba 'dir byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom par 'gyur bas/ khyed rab tu byung ba sdom pa la nyams chags yod pa yod na/ de ring nga la 'jug pa'i sdom pa blangs pas khyed kyi sdom pa sor chud pa yin pas nga 'bu mkhan por yang 'os/ des na so so thar pa'i sdom pa ji ltar khas blangs shing bsrung ba dang*/ sdig pa mi dge ba mtha' dag nus tshad dang lcogs tshad du bsrung ba bslab bya lags/ de la 'ga' zhig gi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa gsum po mtha' dag bsrung bar bcas pas gcig tsam ma thub na sdom pa 'chor bar 'dod pa yang yod de/ de ltar thams cad ni sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpas kyang bsrung bar mi nus pas/ nor bzang gi bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa so so re re bstan nas/ gzhan shes par nus re skan/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ dpal dbyig gis zhus pa las kyang*/ sems bskyed pas mi dge ba bcu spong ba dang*/ de mi nus na yang bslab bya'i gzhi lnga bsrung ba dang*/ de tsam mi nus na yang gcig bsrung ba dang*/ de mi nus na yang nam zhig na bsrung ngo snyam du dam bca'/ zhes gsungs pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod du/ tshong dpon mes sbyin zhes bya bas/ bu dang chung ma dang 'khor dang bcas pas byang chub tu sems bskyed cing phyir mi ldog pa thob nas bcom ldan 'das bdag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i bslab pa srog gcod pa spong ngo zhes gsungs pas/ sdom pa gsum po mtha' dag la spyir dam bcas nas nus tshad dang lcogs tshad bsrung ba 'dis 'jug pa'i sdom par 'ong ba yin/

de yang khyed yon bdag pho mo la mtshon na khyi la khrud ma lhud pa gcig pu la yang sdom pa gsum po ma tshang ba med de/ khyi sems can yin pas de'i don du 'gyur bas sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims/ khrud ma ster ba de sbyin pa yin pas dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ khrud ma la ser sna dang chags pa med pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin te/ de ltar gyur pas dus su byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom par ma song ba med pas khyim pa rnams kyang rang gi rgyab leb cig dang lto 'grangs cig ma gtogs pa thams cad 'gro ba gzhan gyi don byed pa yin/ rang nyid lto 'grangs gcig za ba de yang*/ 'dul ba ltar na/ bza'o snyam pa'i sems kyis bza'/ zhes gsungs pas rten lus 'di gnas pa'i phyir bza' bar gsungs/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i dbang du byas na/ lus la srin bu'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa de dag zas ma zos na 'chi bar 'gyur bas de rnams bde bar gnas pa'i phyir za ste sbyin pa yin/ gsang sngags ltar na lus jo bo thugs rje chen por bsgoms nas mchod pa phul bas bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs te/ de dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ de'i nyes pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs spangs pa sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de sems can gyi don du spyod pa sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims yin pas/ de ltar gyur pa'i dus su lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya byed thams cad 'jug pa'i sdom par 'ong bas bsod nams rgyun chags su 'byung ba'i rgyu yang de yin/ 'di lta bu don go ba'i dus su shin tu sla la phan yon che bas/ jo bo chen po'i zhal nas/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni phan yon chung la nyes dmigs che/ gsang sngags ni phan yon yang che nyes dmigs kyang che/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni phan yon che la nyes dmigs chung gsung*/ so so thar pa ni rdza chag pa dang 'dra ste nyams na bcos su med la/

byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ni rin po che'i snod zhom pa dang 'dra bar nyams na bcos pas bzang du 'gro bar gsungs pas bslab pa 'di la 'bad par bya/ yang 'jug pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa 'di gya tshom du mi brjod pa gal che te/ kha cig na re/ sems bskyed nas sbyin pa gtong dgos pas/ gzhan dag mgo dang lag pa dang snying dang mig la sogs pa mi 'tshams pa slong du 'ong bas/ de ma byin na byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang 'gal bas de'i phyir gsang zer te/ de ni dus la ma bab par sbyin par bcom ldan 'das kyis ma gnang bas/ nam mkha' mdzod kyis zhus pa las/ ji ltar sman shing ljon pa lta sdug pa// rtsa ba la sogs sa bon spyad 'os ni// byin yang dus min spyad las bsrung bya ba// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman shing de bzhin no// zhes pa dang*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba dus gsum skyes pa rnams// sems can kun la btang ba dang*// de bsrung dag pa spel ba'o// zhes gsungs pas nam dga' dgar sbyin par ma gnang ngo*// dus nam mkha' mdzod thob nas mgo gcig byin te/ yang skye bar gyur cig ces smon pa tsam gyis 'byung ba'i dus su 'gro ba'i don rgya chen por 'gyur bas sbyin pa yin no// des na 'dir ni 'gro ba ma dad pa gzhan gyis thos na byang chub kyi sems la ma dad pas spong ste/ khyed kyi bla ma la yang byang chub kyi sems med na khyod la lta smos kyang ci dgos zer nas chos dang gang zag gnyis ka la smad pas ngan 'gro'i skye gnas su 'gro bas gzhan bsrung ba'i phyir gsang bar bya/ des 'jug pa sems bskyed pa'i cho ga phan yon bslab bya dang bcas pa thal ba lags/ da don dam byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal/ sa gzhi spos byug sogs dang*/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang mchog sogs gser khang ma dang rol chen/ yang don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa yang bgyi bas/

'dir theg pa chen po gsang gsang sngags kyi dbang bzhi pa yin/ yon du gser 'bul dgos/ phyag mar me mdzad kyi brkyang phyag 'tshal dgos/ bla ma la sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed dgos te/ de yang sngon bcom ldan 'das bram ze'i khye'u sprin du skye ba bzhes pa na/ mgon po mar me mdzad la chos kyi skur mthong nas/ mar me mdzad kyi brkyang phyag 'tshal zhing*/ ral pa gser btso ma'i kha dog lta bu la zhabs bzhag pas/ dus der don dam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pas mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob nas lung bstan pa thob pa lags/ de la don dam pa sems bskyed pa 'di bskyed du yod pa dang*/ bskyed du med pa'i brtags pa yod kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid skye ba med pa/ sus kyang byas pa ma yin par lhun gyis grub par gsungs pa la dgongs nas/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtog min pa/ zhes gsungs pas bskyed du med la lhun gyi grub pa de thabs mkhas pa'i rgyu rkyen gyis rtogs shing khong du chud pas/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam ni/ dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin/ zhes gsungs pas bskyed du yod pas mi 'gal ba yin/ 'o na bskyed pa'i cho ga 'di gar bzhugs snyam na/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang*/ spang kong phyag rgya pa nas 'byung ste/ de yang lha tho tho ri snyan shal mkhar yum bu bla mkhar na bzhugs pa'i dus su/ shel gyi mtshod rten khru gang pa cig mu dra'i phyag rgya sla nga tsam cig spang kong phyag rgya pa dang gsum byon te/ bod yul du dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa de yang don dam pa sems bskyed pa 'di nyid bsten pas/ rang gi sems nyid 'od gsal dri ma med pa'i brdar shel gyi mchod rten/ de bsgoms pas rtogs par 'gyur bas mu dra'i phyag rgya/ de bsgoms pa'i thabs sam cho ga spang kong phyag rgya pa dang gsum yin pas/

don dam sems bskyed pa 'di byas na gang zag dbang po rab de nyid du sems kyi 'od gsal rtogs nas skad cig gis sangs rgya ba yang yod de/ de ltar yang*/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zhes gsungs/ 'bring la rtogs pa skye ba'i nus pa bzhag tha ma stong nyid zab mo rna bar thos pas/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs stong nyid ston pa'i mkhas pa/ sngon chos smra ba rgyal ba'i blo gros su gyur pa na/ stong pa nyid thos pa'i rgyu las byung ba dang 'dra ste/ phan yon dpag tu med pas 'di la the tshom skye ba ni shin tu dka' ba byed pas te/ lan cig the tshom skyes pas kyang*// srid pa hrul por btang ba yin// zhes gsungs pas des na khyed kyis don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa bgyi bas/ bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par dbul/ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi pho brang sogs gser khang ma dang rol chen/ yang na sku gsum yongs rdzogs dang rol chen bya/ brkyang phyag 'tshal bcug mar me mdzad kyi brkyang phyag 'tshal/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la mchog gi skyabs su 'gro ba bgyi bas/ mchog bya ba tshe 'dir rang byung lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes don dam pa'i bden pa rtogs par byed pa bla ma yin te/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni ma rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' brten pa dang*// rang gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes gsungs pa dang*// gang gi drin gyi bde chen ni// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad+mor 'dud// ces gsungs pas bla ma dam pa'i sku gsung thugs sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo la 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du skyabs su mchi'o snyam du sems la rjes zlos mdzod cig

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bo gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i gsung la skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma dam pa'i thugs la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor// thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ de ltar mchog gi skyabs su 'gro ba bgyis nas/ de snang ba 'di thams cad sems su ngo sprad 'tshal bas/ yang khyed kyis bla ma la chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod thams cad dbul/ gser khang ma'am/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs/ rol chen brkyang phyag 'tshal bcug /mar me mdzad kyi brkyang phyag 'tshal/ de nas rang gi lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ snang ba thams cad kyang yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ yi dam gyi lha ngos bzung med pa rnams nga'i yi dam gyi lha rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu bsgom/ de ltar lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa'i dus su yi dam gyi lhar snang*/ de'i dus su tha mal gyi lus gar yang song ba med/ yi dam gyi lha gang nas kyang 'ong ba med/ tha mal gyi lus su bltas pa'i dus su yi dam gyi lha gar yang song ba med/ tha mal gyi lus gang nas kyang 'ong ba med/ de bzhin du snang ba 'di thams cad kyang 'gro 'ong med de/ rang gis ji ltar bltas pa de ltar snang ba/ de ltar yang*/ rang bzhin gcig tu ma nges pas// gang ltar bltas pa de ltar snang*// zhes gsungs pas phyi rol gyi snang ba dgra dang gnyen// 'khor 'das thams cad de ltar rang gi sems su go bar bya/ de yang sngon 'dir nga 'bu mtshams byas nas 'dug pa'i dus su/

'dam pa'i nad pa gcong can lo du mar na ba zhig phyin pas/ zhag bdun jo bo thugs rje chen po bsgoms pas/ kho'i nad 'dre de mngon sum du 'ong nas/ khyod jo bo thugs rje chen po ma bsgom/ gshin rje be wa sa ta bsgoms zer nas ngu zhing lta bar mi phod/ mthar je ring je ring la song nas phan pa lta bu yin te/ sems yi dam gyi lhar gyur pa'i dus su// sems de'i lus su gyur nas tha mal pa'i lus kyang 'dag na/ de'i khyad par gyi chos nad dang sdug bsngal 'dag pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ nga'i mdze 'ur 'ded kyi gdams ngag kyang 'di yin/ de bzhin du snang thams cad kyang go bar bya/ de snang ba sems kyi ngo sprod bgyi ba lags/ 'o na sems de nyid ji lta bu yin snyam na/ yang khyed kyis bla ma la chos kyi sku'i 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par dbul/ gser khang ma'am bsdu na sku gsum yongs rdzogs dang rol chen/ brkyang phyag gsum/ skabs 'di yon me tog kyang dbul/ me tog re re phyag tu snoms la rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phung po dang khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin pa thams cad rnam par spangs pa chos bdag med pa/ mnyam pa nyid rang gi sems gdod ma nas ma skyes pa/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo nyid du thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor ro// thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ des don dam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa thob pa lags/ thob pa'i sems de ci 'dra na/ rang gi sems 'di la phung por grub pa med/ de bzhin du khams dang skye mched dang gzung ba dang 'dzin par grub pa med pa yin te/

de ltar yang dngos po thams cad dang bral zhing*/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*/ gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam spangs pa// chos bdag med pas mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes gsungs pas chos thams cad gdod nas gang du yang grub pa med pa'i sems de don dam pa yin pas/ 'di bla ma byin rlabs che bas stong par gtang ba min/ slob ma mos gus che bas kyang stong par byas pa min te/ gshis grub pa med pa lags pas/ de mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis rtogs pa de la don dam pa byang chub kyi sems zer ba lags/ de lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis po de dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i bla ma dam pa 'jig rten mgon po rin po che dang mi 'bral pa'i smon lam gdab pas/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa thams cad kyis mchod/ gser khang ma'am/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs dang rol chen/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par phul la/ rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ nam zhig tshe rabs thams cad du byang chub kyi sems mi gtong zhing*/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla ma rin po che dang nam du yang mi 'bral bar gyur cig ces lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ thabs yin no// legs so// zhes brjod/ des sems bskyed pa'i cho ga gdams ngag dang bcas pa thal ba lags/ da byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gsum gyi dus rgyun gyi nyams len ji ltar bya na/ 'di ltar du bsgom pas/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya snyam du bsam/ de smon pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dge ba la bkol/

ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung ste sang nyi ma da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol snyam du bsam/ de 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems yin/ de nas rang gi lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam gyi lha ngos bzung med na/ nga'i yi dam gyi lha jo bo thugs rje chen po rje btsun spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu bsgom/ bla ma dam pa thugs kar bsgom/ de theg pa chen po gsang sngags yin/ de nas rang gi rig pa rig rig po tur tur po slob dpon la nyan mkhan gyi sems 'di la cer gyis bltas pas/ rang gi sems 'di cir yang grub pa med pa yin te/ de ltar yang*/ sems 'di 'das pa dang*/ ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang ma gzigs mi gzigs/ gzigs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pas sems ma grub pa de nyid kyi ngang la bzang ba dang ngan pa'i rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la mi byed par bzhag yid la mi byed pa 'di la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya ba'am/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems sam phyag rgya chen po bya ba zer bas/ de ltar yang slob dpon bram ze chen po'i zhal snga nas/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku/ 'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa/ zhes gsungs pas/ yid la ma byed pa de/ khyed kyis de kho na bzhin du skyong gsol cig nga 'bus gtor ma chen po 'di chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la phul la/ khyed byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa rnams kyi stong grogs gyis shig ces bka' bsgo bya ste zhes mtshams sbyar ba/ de nas gtor ma gtang dril bu bsil yi ge brgya pa tshar bdun bdun brjod la bsngo ba bya/ phyag gsum gsum btsal la me tog gtor zhing bka' drin che zhes brjod gsung*/ de la 'di ni phal cher gsung sgros skyus ma yin la/ bye brag tha dad pa gdul bya'i rigs kyi dbang gis rgyas par byed pa'i mtha' bsam gyis mi khyab ste/

'di la yang gsung sgros rgyas 'bring gsum du dbyer rung ngo*// de lta bu'i sems bskyed pa re re mdzad pas kyang*/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de rnams thams cad phal cher zab mo sems nyid kyi don rtogs pa dang*/ kun kyang byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur nas/ sems dga' ba dang*/ rjes su yi rang ste 'jig rten mgon po de nyid la mchod cing mngon par bstod pa lags so// byang chub sems bskyed cho ga gdams par bcas// gsung sgros phyogs gcig bkod pa'i yi ge la// lhag cing ma tshang 'khrul pa mchis gyur na// skyes mchog gong ma rnams la bzod par gsol// dri med dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen 'dis// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun lam mchog 'dir zhugs nas// sgrib gsum rnam dag sku gsum mthar phyin pa// bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba/ mtsho chen po ma dros pa'i 'gram srin po'i rgyal po lang ka mgrin bcu btul ba'i yul/ mdo sde lang kar gshegs pa gsungs pa'i gnas/ thub pas zhabs kyis bcags pa'i gdan sa der/ chos kyi rgyal po jo bo'i bkas bskul nas/ dge sbyong ri khrod pa shes rab 'byung gnas kyis/ sems bskyed pa'i cho ga legs par bris pa nyon mongs 'khor ba'i gdung ba sel zhing*/ srid pa gsum du grags shing mthong bar dka' ba gangs dkar ti se lta bu bsil byed tsan dan gyi gter zhes bya ba rdzogs so// //thugs bskyed chen mo'i brgyud pa ni/ ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ rgyal tshab mgon po ma pham/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen don stengs pa/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ snubs ston chen po/ bla ma rin chen/ bla ma blo gros rin chen/ dbon po chos yes/ dbon po byang brtson/ de gnyis ka la bla ma kun dga' rin chen/ slob dpon sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ slob dpon tshul rgyal ba/ chos rje grags pa byang chub/
